About the opportunity
We are looking for a dynamic AFC Analyst to join our AFC Department to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and relevant company policies related to Anti-Financial Crime. Our target in AFC is to lead and shape the industry by creating a culture of compliance within N26 that authorities, customers and stakeholders can trust. This role is crucial to achieve this goal.

In this role, you will:
As AFC Analyst, you will support all Anti-Financial Crime tasks including AML, terrorism financing, sanctions, KYC, and fraud. You’ll detect Money Laundering typologies and Financial Crime patterns, while handling external and internal requests to detect potential financial crime. 
Your responsibilities will include:
• Review and improve the investigation/assessments escalated by the Investigators, ensuring quality Investigations of complex Financial Crime escalations or cases of suspicious activities identified.
• Ensuring quality and suggesting better ways of working when difficulties are identified and /or for gaining efficiency.
• Enhancing our analysis, and expanding the processes in our procedures and rulebook, as well as identifying improvements related to our internal transaction monitoring systems.
• Draft and submit Suspicious Activity Reports/Authority requests to SEPBLAC and the corresponding authorities, prior escalation to the Associate/TL.

• About 4 years with relevant banking experience in Anti Financial Crime (money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, tax evasion).
• Experience on Spanish AML/CTF regulation and handling reporting (ie. SARs, FTF) to SEPBLAC.
• Experience dealing with Spanish AML authorities will be a plus.
• Bachelor’s degree (ideally in law, business or finance) is preferred.
• Advanced use of MS Office (G suits) skills for Excel and Word. Salesforce experience is a plus.

Skills:

• You should enjoy a fast paced working environment, show high willingness to learn and work autonomously to grasp new topics.

Traits:

• Think globally, act locally.
• Strong bias for action.

 What’s in it for you:

jobs.title: Associate Manager – Quality & Training (Collections)
jobs.description:
About PhonePe Limited:

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Key Responsibilities
1. Training Framework Compliance Management
• New Hire Onboarding: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive onboarding training programs for all new hires across tele-calling and field collections.
• Code of Conduct: Ensure 100% adherence to regulatory guidelines and PhonePe’s strict internal collection code of conduct. Deliver exhaustive training to mitigate reputational and operational risks.
• Refresher Programs: Plan and execute monthly refresher training sessions to update teams on process changes, new lending products, and updated negotiation or compliance strategies.
2. Quality Assurance Agency Governance
• Agency Monitoring: Partner with external Telecalling (TC) agencies to ensure they perform timely and accurate call quality evaluations as per agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Performance Calibration: Conduct regular calibration sessions with agency quality auditors to ensure alignment on evaluation parameters and scoring standards.
• Performance Correction: Identify agents not meeting minimum quality standards and mandate targeted refresher programs to address specific skill gaps.
• Disciplinary Framework: Implement a strict consequence management matrix, including the issuance of L1 and L2 warnings for repetitive compliance or quality offenders.
3. AI-Driven Analytics Insight Implementation
• Speech Text Analytics: Leverage our advanced AI-enabled call evaluation solution to analyze speech and text interactions at scale.
• Insight Extraction: Transform raw data and automated metrics from the AI tool into actionable, workable insights regarding customer sentiment, objection handling, and agent behavior.
• Core Training Integration: Feed AI-driven suggestions directly back into the core training curriculum to continuously optimize scripts, rebuttals, and collection methodologies.
• Efficiency Optimization: Measure the direct impact of training interventions on overall collection efficiency, recovery rates, and customer experience.
4. Reporting Stakeholder Presentation
• Data Presentation: Synthesize quality scores, training completion rates, and AI insights into executive dashboards. Present findings clearly to the Collection Strategy Head and senior leadership. This would include tracking the performance of collection agents based on vintage/Hiring dates etc.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Business and external vendors to align training objectives with business targets.

 

Required Qualifications Skills
• Experience:

Minimum of 5 years of proven experience explicitly managing Quality Assurance/Training operations within a lending or banking collections environment (Telecalling Field).
• Education: A relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree from a recognized institution.
• Languages Known: Should know Kannada, Tamil, Telugu Malayalam.
• Communication

Skills:

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Candidate must be capable of delivering high-impact training and managing difficult compliance conversations.
• Analytical Presentation

Skills:

Good analytics and and presentation skills
• Technical Tech-Savviness: Prior exposure to or experience working with AI-enabled call monitoring systems, speech analytics tools, or automated QA platforms will be a plus.

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
• Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
• Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
• Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
• Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
• Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
• Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

 

Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. What You’ll Need:

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Up)
jobs.description:
About Ferocia

We're the team behind Up, but under the hood, we're Ferocia - a passionate tech company driven by financial inclusion. Since 2011, we've been crafting innovative financial tools, starting with the digital platform for Bendigo Bank. We believe technology can empower everyone, from the advantaged to the disadvantaged, which is why Up was born.

Now, as part of the Bendigo and Adelaide Bank family, we combine the agility of a small company with the reach and stability of a major player. Together, we're carbon neutral, community-focused, and dedicated to high standards of corporate governance. Our mission? To leverage technology to help Australians move from financial stress and anxiety to a place of confidence and empowerment.

Want to join us? We'd love to hear from you

The role

We're looking for 2 experienced Senior Product Designers to lead the work on our savings and home loan experiences. This is a rare opportunity to join a small team and have a real impact on people's lives by helping Australians build savings habits and feel in control of their home ownership journey.

Our designers wear many hats and own projects from start to finish — from idea to successfully shipped. Sometimes it's just a few days on a fun feature, sometimes it's months on a new financial product. So on a normal day, you could be:
• Finding and exploring opportunities for every step of the user journey — whether it's reviewing user feedback, conducting interviews, analysing data, playing with a random idea, reinventing the wheel, refining existing concepts, or fixing tiny bugs.
• Solving financial problems with a unique approach by focusing on how people feel and what's uniquely "Up". This takes real craftsmanship and attention to detail to make a simple feature feel like a game-changer (interactions, visuals and copy) and a genuine understanding of how people manage their money and use our app.
• Building new financial products. This takes deep systems thinking to map complex interactions and dependencies and create a holistic experience across many touchpoints. You'll need to be comfortable with complex technical problems and know how to approach big projects strategically.
• Working closely with our creative (Product, Design, Brand) and leadership teams to discuss ideas, review work in progress, help define our roadmap, and shape our long-term strategy. You’ll have to be comfortable designing concepts and interactive prototypes at various levels of fidelity to be able to clearly communicate your ideas to the right audience.
• Collaborating with engineering teams to ship high-quality features to our users within our delivery timeframes — by helping scope, prioritise, review, and adapt concepts as necessary. As well as working with our Marketing and Support teams to ensure a great user experience at any touchpoint.

What we're looking for
• Experience designing and delivering end to end projects (from idea to successfully launched) — with at least 5 years working with product teams (ideally on a SaaS or consumer product, and even better if it's in Fin-Tech), or within a digital agency.
• Creativity and craftsmanship — strong interaction and visual skills, with a keen eye for detail to achieve visually pleasing aesthetics — from tiny micro-interactions, to complex multi-step experiences, and the ability to think outside of conventional approaches. We really pride ourselves in the way we present experiences and the emotional responses we seek from our users.
• Problem solving skills and a strong product lens — the ability to understand customer needs, motivations and behaviours, and to know how to translate this understanding into product opportunities. Being able to think holistically about end to end experiences, and design solutions that fit into an ecosystem.
• Collaboration and communication skills — the ability to articulate ideas effectively and provide sound reasoning for decisions, and to use storytelling to inform and influence.
• Passion — harder to define, but we're looking for people who have a desire to push the limits, break the status quo, and be at the forefront of where technology is leading us. An eagerness to learn, expand your skills, and do the best work possible.
• Technical knowledge, especially front-end, and a general understanding of an agile engineering development process.
• Ability to work with a certain level of ambiguity, and "get shit done" autonomously — we operate like a start-up and things can often be messy, undefined, or change at the last minute. We're looking for someone who enjoys innovative fast paced work environments and tackling all sort of problems.

 

Interview process

More details will be provided on application, but all applicants will go through the same stages:
• Intro chat and career review with Sylvain (Head of Design) — 30min
• Presentation of 2-3 case studies to Sylvain (Head of Design) and 2 Product Design Leads, for a deep dive into your work and your design skills — 60min
• Interview with a cross-functional team (EM, Front-end developer, Product Designer) with a critique of an app of your choice, to understand how you think, and get a feel for what it would be like working together — 60min
• References check
• Offer!

When applying, make sure to attach a portfolio or provide a link to an online portfolio (including any needed passwords) to demonstrate your skills and some examples of work you’ve produced.

#LI-Hybrid

Estimated salary range

$135,000 $165,000 AUD

Working at Ferocia

We are currently only hiring in Melbourne (or adjacent areas, including Bendigo) as we still value physically getting together in person.

We offer:
• A small team of passionate people
• Generous leave and parental policy
• Great city office and perks (rooftop, gym and personal trainer, games…)
• Budget for personal development, training, and conferences
• Employee Assistance Program
• Home loan rebates for our loans (conditions apply)

Not quite ticking every box? Throw your hat in the ring anyway! At Ferocia, we're all about shaking things up and rewriting the rules. We thrive on diversity and inclusion, and we wholeheartedly encourage you to step up and shine. Let us be the judge of your qualifications for this role – you just might surprise yourself!

jobs.title: FinCrime Investigator - AML Investigations
jobs.description:
As a FinCrime Operations Investigator, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Wise and its customers from financial crime. You will be responsible for investigating and analyzing customer accounts, transactions and activities on our platform to detect and prevent money laundering, fraud, and other illicit activities. You will leverage your expertise to identify suspicious patterns, conduct thorough investigations, and ensure compliance with AML/CTF regulations and internal policies and procedures, all while adhering to Wise’s risk appetite. This role offers a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in the FinCrime domain, contribute to a rapidly growing global company, and make a tangible impact on protecting our users and the integrity of our platform.

Job Responsibilities
• Conduct in-depth investigations of potentially suspicious activity, utilizing both internal and external data sources.
• Analyze complex financial transactions and customer behavior to identify patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or other financial crimes.
• Evaluate and assess alerts generated by transaction monitoring systems and other detection tools.
• Gather and analyze supporting documentation, including KYC information, transaction records, and other relevant data.
• Review and interpret data to identify patterns and potential risks associated with financial crime. Support the team in making informed decisions based on data insights.
• Prepare detailed and comprehensive investigation reports, documenting findings and recommendations.
• Act as a point of escalation for complex FinCrime cases from other operations teams, providing guidance and expertise.
• Mentor and train other team members on FinCrime investigation techniques and best practices.
• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve fraud detection rules, processes, and system enhancements.
• Stay up-to-date on emerging FinCrime trends, typologies, and regulatory changes.
• Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including compliance, legal, and customer support teams.
• Liaise with financial institutions and law enforcement agencies as needed.
• Participate in ad-hoc projects and initiatives related to FinCrime prevention and detection.
• Maintain accurate and complete records of all investigations and related activities.
• Provide input on process improvements and backlog exercises.
• Complete all company-assigned mandatory, refresher or ad hoc trainings on time and with diligence.
• Customer Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers via approved channels to obtain necessary details or clarifications for reviews, always upholding our high customer experience standards. A key part of this involves avoiding unnecessary customer contacts and preventing delayed case resolutions. All communication must be precisely tailored to ensure clarity and efficiency.
• KPIs: Take a proactive approach to consistently achieve individual and team targets (KPIs, SLAs, QA), demonstrating a strong commitment to both quality and speed. This includes meeting deadlines reliably, optimizing processing times, and taking full ownership and accountability for all responsibilities to deliver exceptional results.
• Other: Perform additional tasks as assigned by your lead, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach. This includes actively participating in meetings, training, and internal events to support broader team and company objectives.

jobs.title: Lead Product Analyst - WISE Platform

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Money Laundering Detection
jobs.description:
Why we think you’ll want to join us
• Meaningful team mission with huge global reach: You’ll be fighting money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation across Wise’s £145B+ annual cross-border volume. You’ll be working with global regulators and law enforcement across 65+ licenses and 160+ countries.
• Cutting edge tech: You’ll be developing state of the art systems to prevent and detect crime in real time, spanning machine learning, LLMs and anything else your team feels is needed to tackle the problem.
• Product led company: Wise lives and breathes empowerment. Our growth and progress is all down to autonomous product teams investing in what they believe will get us to our mission. You and the team have full authority to decide and the responsibility to get results.
• Learn from experienced product leadership: You’ll work directly with product management veterans who will invest in your growth and development. You’ll work with Surbhi and Susana, and learn from Gergő and Nilan.
• Beloved products: Imagine every time you tell someone you work at Wise being showered with compliments about how much they love the product. Our most recent Net Promoter Score was 65+, and over 70% of new customers come through “word-of-mouth”.

 

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Squad to make a meaningful dent in global financial crime.

Wise moves £145B+ annually across borders and customers love us for how easy and how cheap it is. You know who else loves moving money cheaply across borders? Criminals looking to launder proceeds of crime.

This is where you come in. Our vision is clean money without borders. We have made great progress in developing a general crime catching machine learning model, and now we need to dig deeper, and get a whole lot more specific. You’ll dive deep into criminal typologies, become an expert in how international crime takes place, and build advanced systems that catch hyper-targeted, regional, criminal behaviour.

 

About the team
• The AML Squad works across our offices in London and Tallinn. We are growing the Squad, and adding new teams to make faster progress in our fight against crime.
• The AML Squad owns all anti-money laundering, terrorism financing and human exploitation typologies and risks. This includes customer risk scoring, risk prevention, live risk detection, investigations and reporting to Financial Intelligence Units across the globe.
• You’ll be joining one of the cross-functional product teams in the squad focused on detection.
• We measure success by two metrics: AML Recall and Cost of Suspicious Activity Report (SAR).
• AML Recall measures how much of the crime we actually catch. We want this to be as high as possible, and are rapidly expanding our coverage of hyper specific crime detection in addition to our already strong general model.
• Cost of SAR measures how much it costs us to detect, investigate and report a criminal to the relevant authorities. We want this to be as low as possible, and are investing a lot in high precision automation including some cool stuff with LLMs.

 

You’ll own the challenge of
• Setting new standards of live detecting hyper specific and regional crime at scale, in a way that satisfies our regulatory obligations globally and works financially for our business.
• Working with regional compliance officers (known in the industry as the second line of defense) to deliver global controls that have a strong reputation with local regulators and law enforcement.
• Working with data scientists, product analysts, product designers, product compliance managers, operations leads and software engineers to ensure the team ship the best possible product.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to
• Choose your own path to success - you’ll have the freedom to define the vision and the responsibility for making it happen
• Be flexible in how and where you work, we understand everyone needs a little something different so we’ll do our best to make it happen
• Travel to work with our teams in London and Tallinn as well as meet various partners and organisations globally when needed
• Inspire teams with your ideas, knowledge and self-starting attitude

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
The Team

Wise Platform helps banks, software companies and large enterprises leverage Wise’s infrastructure to offer their customers world class payments products through their own channels. jobs.title: Creative Designer Wise Business
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Creative Designer to join our growing Wise Business Marketing team. As a midweight designer with 3-4 years of experience, you’ll play a key role in creating impactful, recognisable, and effective marketing content for one of the biggest growth areas within Wise.

The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of design and creative fundamentals, the ability to seamlessly balance big-picture campaign thinking with a sharp eye for craft, layout, and detail. We’re looking for an ambitious, assertive, and collaborative self-starter who is ready to bring fresh ideas to life, solve complex visual problems, and scale their career alongside our business marketing team.

Our mission

Wise exists to build money without borders. Over a decade ago, we challenged the way the world moves money – cutting out hidden fees and making international finance simpler and fairer. Today, we help millions of people and businesses send, spend, and manage money across countries with ease, making money simple, accessible, and smart for everyone, everywhere.

The Wise Business marketing team is focused on helping companies of all sizes operate globally without the friction and high costs of traditional banking. As a Creative Designer within our marketing content team, your mission will be to bring the Wise Business story to life with clarity and creative excellence. From high-stakes marketing campaigns and organic social content to deeply researched whitepapers, reports, and major event assets, you will make complex business finance feel simple, human, and engaging.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
• End-to-End Delivery: Play a key role in the execution of small to medium marketing projects. You will take ownership of the creative process from initial concept to final sign-off, ensuring everything is delivered on time and to a high standard.
• Multi-Channel Content Creation: Design effective, highly engaging B2B marketing collateral across a multitude of channels, including integrated marketing campaigns, organic social posts, event spaces, whitepapers, and reports.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as a dedicated team player within the marketing content team, partnering closely with copywriters, content strategists, and marketers to shape cohesive messaging and visual narratives.
• Stakeholder Management: Work directly with business stakeholders, confidently pitching your creative concepts, explaining your design rationale, and constructively navigating feedback.
• Brand Guardianship: Act as a passionate custodian of the Wise Business brand, intuitively applying and stretching our visual identity to suit the B2B audience while maintaining global consistency.
• Creative Innovation: Bring fresh ideas and inspiration to the table daily, using creativity to challenge assumptions, elevate our output, and connect our brand to the real-world needs of businesses.

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Drive Massive Growth: Wise Business is a major growth engine for the company. You will be at the forefront of shaping how businesses interact with our brand globally.
• Own Your Output: As an assertive self-starter, you’ll have the autonomy to lead your own creative, manage your own time, and see your ideas come to life.
• Refine Your Craft: Work across an incredibly diverse mix of media—from fast-moving organic social campaigns to beautifully structured, data-heavy long-form reports, explainer videos, testimonials and immersive physical event environments.

About you:
• Experienced Midweight: You have 3-4 years of professional design experience in an in-house team or reputable agency, with a proven track record in branding and marketing.
• An Assertive Self-Starter: You don’t wait for permission to make things better. You take initiative, bring bold ideas to the table, and actively advocate for great design.
• A Natural Problem Solver: You look at complex briefs, data points, or tight constraints as a puzzle to be solved, always digging into the "why" to deliver strategic creative solutions.
• Meticulously Organised: You have an exceptional eye for detail, typography, hierarchy, and layout, and you thrive in a fast-paced and demanding environment.
• Collaborative & Adaptive: You love working alongside writers and marketers to build a story, and you are comfortable navigating constructive feedback to achieve the best outcome.

Qualifications:
• A strong portfolio demonstrating high-impact branding/marketing work across both digital and print (campaigns, organic social, editorial/reports, and event collateral).
• Expert command of Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite.
• Deep understanding of layout, grid systems, and data visualisation for editorial and long-form content.
• Knowledge of formatting and design best practices for organic and paid social media channels.
• Experience with motion design (After Effects) or simple video editing is a strong plus.
• Ability to work in the UK. Sponsorship isn’t offered in this role.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead I - Consumer Onboarding
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Principal / Staff Engineer - Compliance
jobs.location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR; Singapore, Singapore
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

The Compliance team's primary objective is to ensure that OKX operates in accordance with regulatory requirements while maintaining the highest ethical and moral standards. The team owns the full compliance engineering stack: KYC onboarding and refresh, sanctions / PEP / adverse-media screening, transaction monitoring (TM) and travel-rule enforcement, case management, and regulatory reporting. We achieve this by developing compliance service solutions, integrating with KYC AML vendors, and enabling robust business growth, which ultimately strengthens user trust in our platform. Our ultimate goal is to create a culture of compliance excellence, where innovation and responsible business practices are seamlessly integrated. In compliance, a system that is mostly right is wrong — so every control we build must be deterministic in its enforcement, complete in its coverage, and explainable in its outcome.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Formulate, select, and develop technical schemes for platform projects across the compliance domain — KYC onboarding flows, identity verification and refresh, sanctions / PEP / adverse-media screening, transaction monitoring, travel-rule, case management, and regulatory reporting — including AI/ML-powered features such as intelligent screening disambiguation, document verification, anomaly detection, automated risk scoring, and analyst-assist agents.
• Organize and coordinate resources, leading project research and development, troubleshoot problems, and ensure quality and timely completion — including delivery of AI model integration work within KYC, screening, and monitoring workflows.
• Facilitate cross-team communication and promote teamwork efficiency through code quality control and collaboration, including partnering with Data Science, Risk, and Legal to productionize models and ensure reliable, auditable inference infrastructure.
• Define where probabilistic AI is appropriate versus where deterministic logic is mandatory — and design the boundary cleanly so models assist without compromising auditability or enforcement integrity.
• Undertake team tasks and cultivate technical talents in the industry, with a focus on building AI engineering best practices across the compliance engineering team — patterns for agentic coding, prompt libraries, eval suites, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated work in a regulated environment.

 

What We Look For In You
• A compliance-first systems mindset — you instinctively reach for state machines, idempotency keys, exactly-once semantics, reconciliation jobs and immutable audit logs. You understand that in compliance, false negatives cost millions and false positives cost trust, and you design accordingly. Prior experience in KYC, AML, sanctions, fraud, or payments is a strong plus; experience surviving a regulatory audit is an even stronger plus.
• Daily, fluent use of modern AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or equivalents. You can describe the specific workflows you run, the failure modes you have hit, and the guardrails you have built around AI-generated code. AI fluency is required, not nice-to-have.
• Production experience integrating AI/ML model inference into Java services — REST/gRPC-based model serving, feature engineering pipelines, latency-sensitive inference optimization, graceful degradation, and drift / rollback playbooks.
• Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns — at least one of: RAG pipelines (vector store + retrieval + grounding) for policy / KYC / case lookup, agentic workflows (tool use, multi-step reasoning, validation loops) for analyst assistance, or LLM-based classification / extraction shipped to production.
• Discipline around AI output — you do not ship LLM features without evals, hallucination tests, prompt regression suites, and human-in-the-loop review for high-stakes decisions. You have an opinion on when to reach for a frontier model vs. a fine-tuned small model vs. a deterministic rule, and can defend that trade-off to a regulator.
• Exposure to LLM integration or AI agent frameworks is a strong plus — e.g. prompt engineering at the system level, RAG pipelines, or orchestrating AI workflows within a regulated environment.
• Good understanding of software engineering basics, distributed system principles, including CAP, consistency, idempotency, and exactly-once vs at-least-once semantics.
• Clear logic, quick thinking, and good communication skills — including the ability to write clearly for non-engineers (compliance officers, auditors, regulators).

 

AI Proficiency Expectations Interview Process

AI fluency is a required engineering competency for this role, on the same level as ‘can write good Java’. We will assess it explicitly during the interview, and a strong showing here is a meaningful plus:
• AI-augmented workflow demo — walk us through how you use AI tools day-to-day. The prompts, the tasks you delegate to an agent vs. write yourself, how you review AI-generated diffs, and how you measure the impact (commit velocity, defect rate, test coverage). Concrete examples beat slogans.
• Live agentic exercise — a working session using the AI coding agent of your choice on a realistic compliance-flavoured problem. We look at how you scope, prompt, validate, and integrate AI output, not whether the agent gets it right first try.
• Design discussion with a probabilistic twist — expect at least one system-design question where the right answer involves deciding when not to use an LLM, and how to design the deterministic fallback. We hire engineers who can defend that boundary.
• Evaluation guardrails — be ready to discuss an eval suite or guardrail you have built for an AI feature in production (e.g. an LLM-assisted SAR narrative drafting tool, an AI-assisted KYC document review step, or screening-hit disambiguation). If you have not shipped one, tell us how you would design it.

 

 

Perks Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package
• L D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development — including budget for AI tools, courses, and conferences
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Regional Facilities Manager, North Central
jobs.description:
About Moniepoint

In a nutshell, we power the dreams of businesses and their customers.
Moniepoint Inc. is on a mission to deliver financial happiness to every African, everywhere, by
providing businesses, their employees, and their customers with simple financial tools. Since
2019, we’ve become Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, processing over $17 billion monthly
through our all-in-one digital financial services platform, serving 10 million businesses and
individuals. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint MFB and TeamApt Ltd., we provide seamless
payments, banking, credit, and business management tools, handling the majority of POS
transactions in Nigeria and standing strong as Africa’s second-fastest-growing fintech.

What We Are Looking For
We’re looking for dynamic and results-oriented Regional Facilities Managers to oversee the
management of our facilities across designated regions in Nigeria. If you excel in project
execution, workspace functionality, space planning, and can translate concepts into
actionable 2D/3D architectural drawings, we’d love to meet you.

All successful candidates must demonstrate strong project management capabilities and
possess a valid HSE certification. These roles are essential to supporting our growing
infrastructure with compliant, well-designed, and efficient work environments.

Role Overview
As a Regional Facilities Manager at Moniepoint, you will manage the operations of multiple
facilities in your assigned region. Your responsibilities will span property acquisition, office
development, health and safety compliance, project execution, space planning, vendor
oversight, and facility maintenance.

You will leverage your proficiency in architectural and 3D design to conceptualize and deliver
workspace layouts that align with Moniepoint’s operational and brand standards. This role
demands cross-functional collaboration, technical excellence, and the ability to deliver
cost-effective, scalable infrastructure solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Facilities Operations and Management
● Manage daily operations and maintenance of all Moniepoint facilities in the region,
including offices, branches, and repair centers.
● Ensure facilities comply with local regulations, health and safety standards, and
company policies.
● Implement preventive maintenance programs and monitor service delivery quality.
● Oversee workspace functionality, safety, and operational standards.
Space Planning and Design
● Develop detailed 2D architectural plans and 3D renderings for new and existing facilities.
● Utilize tools like AutoCAD, Revit, or SketchUp to optimize space usage and design
layouts.
● Translate business requirements into functional, efficient, and brand-aligned
workspaces.
● Review and update designs in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
Property Acquisition and Lease Management
● Lead the identification, negotiation, and acquisition of properties that meet business
needs.
● Support lease documentation, title verification, and legal review with relevant
departments.
● Manage office and employee relocation efforts, ensuring smooth transitions.
Project Management and Workspace Coordination
● Deliver end-to-end management of facility development and upgrade projects across
multiple locations.
● Coordinate project timelines, design reviews, contractor engagement, and execution.
● Ensure adherence to quality standards, budgets, and deadlines.
● Provide post-project support including snag list closure and handover documentation.
Vendor and Contractor Management
● Select, onboard, and oversee third-party vendors for construction, maintenance, and
support services.
● Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, drive compliance, and manage performance
reviews.
● Ensure timely issue resolution and maintain relationships with key service providers.
Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance
● Enforce strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations across
all facilities.
● Implement safety protocols, emergency response plans, and regular risk assessments.
● Promote environmental sustainability through energy efficiency and waste management
initiatives.
● All candidates must hold a valid HSE certification and demonstrate practical HSE
implementation experience.
Cost and Budget Management
● Prepare and manage the regional facilities budget, tracking all expenses.
● Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or safety.
● Provide monthly reports on expenditures, project costs, and budget performance.
Employee and Workspace Support
● Recommend and deliver workspace improvements that enhance employee productivity
and satisfaction.
● Oversee procurement and maintenance of office furniture, utilities, and equipment.
● Ensure clean, safe, and conducive environments through effective janitorial and utility
services.
Continuous Improvement and Reporting
● Gather feedback to assess the effectiveness of facilities services and identify
improvement opportunities.
● Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance, cost control, and
space management.
● Maintain clear and consistent communication with stakeholders to align infrastructure
plans with organizational goals.

Qualifications
Experience
● Minimum of 7 years’ experience in facilities management, infrastructure development,
and project execution.
● Proven record of managing end-to-end facility projects across multiple locations.
● Strong background in space planning and architectural design, including 2D/3D
drawings.
Education
● Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
Skills
● Proficiency in design and visualization software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, etc.).
● Strong project management and coordination capabilities.
● Solid knowledge of HSE and regulatory requirements.
● Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
● Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure.
Certifications
● Valid HSE certification (e.g., NEBOSH, OSHA, ISO 45001) is mandatory.
● Project management certifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are a strong advantage.
● Membership in a professional body (e.g., IFMA, ARCON) is a plus.

Why Join Moniepoint?
At Moniepoint, we’re building a team of world-class professionals dedicated to delivering
financial happiness across Africa. This role provides a unique opportunity to shape the
operational and physical infrastructure of one of Africa’s fastest-growing fintech companies.
You’ll be part of a team that values ownership, execution, and innovation, making a real
impact as we scale.

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. The Capacity Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. The team owns the full lifecycle of cloud cost: the data platforms that make spend transparent and attributable, the anomaly detection and forecasting systems that make it predictable, the automation that continuously rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale, and the capacity planning and commitment strategy that keep a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility and has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings. We partner closely with Data Science, Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood to turn cost insight into real financial outcomes.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the team, you will serve as the technical lead for the Capacity arm: setting engineering direction, owning the most complex systems, and raising the bar for how the team builds and operates. You will design the platforms that attribute cloud costs to their real consumers, catch spend regressions before they compound, and forecast future demand and unit economics. jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer  - Financial Cloud
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About This Role

We are building the next-generation Financial Cloud platform, enabling Bybit to deploy and operate regulated financial services across 50+ global sites, each subject to different compliance requirements (EU MiCA, APAC licenses, etc.). Each site is a unique combination of business modules, infrastructure configurations, and compliance controls — managed as versioned, reproducible units.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer for the Financial Cloud Toolchain, you will drive the end-to-end developer experience and deployment automation for this multi-site platform. You will design and build systems that ensure every deployment is reproducible, every dependency is traceable, and every site automatically and safely converges to its declared state.

What You'll Do

Build Release Engineering (40%)
• Design and implement hermetic, deterministic build pipelines that produce reproducible artifacts for all platform modules
• Build and maintain a content-addressable artifact registry with full provenance capabilities (SLSA L3+)
• Implement dependency graph analysis tooling to compute build/deploy blast radius for every change
• Own the Version Set model: define, validate, and promote locked module-version combinations ("Manifests") through environment stages
• Enforce semantic versioning governance and automated compatibility verification across 50+ independently versioned modules

Multi-Site Deployment Orchestration (30%)
• Design a GitOps-based deployment engine that reconciles each site to its target Manifest state
• Build progressive rollout capabilities: canary → regional → global, with automatic rollback on SLO violations
• Implement site-aware configuration rendering: given a site's Manifest + region + compliance tier, produce the complete deployable state
• Create an automated upgrade plan generator: compute safe upgrade paths based on dependency ordering and compatibility constraints
• Operate and evolve the Financial Cloud configuration center and module selection center

Internal Developer Platform (20%)
• Build self-service workflows for module teams: onboard new modules, publish versions, request promotion to production Manifests
• Provide real-time visibility: cross-site version drift, deployment health, dependency freshness, compliance patch coverage
• Design the "Module → Manifest" pipeline: from module selection to validated Manifest generation in ≤30 minutes
• Integrate with internal CI systems to provide selective test execution based on dependency graph analysis

Reliability Compliance Automation (10%)
• Automate compliance evidence generation for regulated deployments (audit trails, SBOMs, change records)
• Design cold-start orchestration that automatically derives correct startup ordering from the dependency graph
• Build chaos testing frameworks to validate site-level DR and failover under real module compositions
• Ensure Phase 1 infrastructure deployment automation ≥95%, Phase 2 data layer ≥90%, Phase 3 business applications ≥90%

──────

What We're Looking For

Must-Have
• 8+ years in platform engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure toolchain development, serving 500+ services or 100+ engineers
• Deep hands-on experience with build systems — you've designed or operated them, not just consumed them
• Track record of building dependency graph tooling — static analysis, runtime tracing, or both — for impact analysis and selective testing
• Experience designing and operating version governance systems: BOM/Manifest models, compatibility matrices, constraint solving
• Production GitOps deployment experience spanning multi-cluster / multi-region environments
• Solid Kubernetes expertise: custom Controllers, Operators, CRDs for platform automation
• Artifact management and supply chain security

experience:

content-addressable storage, SLSA attestation, SBOM generation, artifact signing

Strong Plus
• Experience building an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) with self-service module onboarding and promotion workflows
• Large-scale monorepo governance: code ownership, visibility boundaries, build graph optimization
• Financial or regulated industry

experience:

understanding of compliance-as-code, audit automation, multi-jurisdictional requirements
• Multi-site / multi-tenant SaaS platform experience where each site has a different module composition
• Familiarity with constraint solvers or package manager dependency resolution algorithms (SAT solvers, version unification)
• Cryptocurrency / fintech platform experience, especially exchange or trading infrastructure

Nice-to-Have
• Toolchain development experience in Rust, Go, or Python
• Familiarity with Terraform / Pulumi infrastructure-as-code
• Experience with OPA / Rego for policy-as-code in deployment pipelines
• Experience operating platforms across China / APAC / EU regions with understanding of data residency requirements

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

We are looking for a Lead Employee Relations Partner to serve as the primary advisor and escalation point for complex employee relations issues across the organization. jobs.title: Senior Manager (Controllership)
jobs.description:
About Fam
 
Fam (previously FamPay) is India's first payments app for everyone above
11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey early in their lives. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder's Capital, and angels including Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Role Overview
 
We are looking for a hands-on Chartered Accountant to own core controllership execution end-to-end – statutory
audits, financial reporting and the upcoming transition to Ind AS, month-end close, investor and MIS reporting,
taxation and compliance, treasury, and internal financial controls. This is an execution-heavy individual-
contributor role for someone who takes full ownership of deliverables, keeps every number backed by
documented inputs, and anticipates audit and governance issues before they surface.
 
Must-Haves
Chartered Accountant with 5–6 years of post-qualification experience in controllership, audit or financial
reporting.
Demonstrated experience handling statutory audits with Big 4 or comparable audit firms (either from within
industry or from practice at a Big 4 / mid-tier firm).
Strong Ind AS proficiency, with practical application to standalone and consolidated financials; exposure to a first-time Ind AS transition rom Indian GAAP is a strong advantage.
Hands-on experience handling investor relations and MIS reporting
Experience managing direct and indirect tax risk (RPT, MAT, transfer pricing, GST) and coordinating filings and
statutory / ROC compliance with external experts.
Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort building linked, self-updating trackers and models;
exposure to Zoho Books ERP.
Sharp eye for detail with the discipline to keep every number backed by a documented input.
Good to Haves
Experience in a start-up, high-growth or restructuring environment where controllership is built and scaled
rather than inherited
Exposure to IFC / IFCR implementation and to an RBI-regulated or otherwise regulated set-up.
Exposure to treasury / cash-flow management and to ROC / Companies Act and secretarial compliance.

Roles & Responsibilities
1. Statutory Audit & Assurance
• Independently handle statutory audits with Big 4 or comparable audit firms end-to-end – planning, preparing
 schedules and reconciliations, resolving queries, and driving timely, clean closure with no major escalations.
• Serve as the primary finance point of contact for auditors; pre-empt audit and governance matters that have a
 direct bearing on the financials and ensure the team is audit-ready at all times.
• Coordinate tax, GST and other statutory audits alongside the respective experts and consultants.
2. Financial Reporting & Ind AS Transition
• Prepare standalone and consolidated financial statements, including multi-period and multi-entity
 consolidations. The company currently reports under Indian GAAP (notified Accounting Standards).
• Lead the transition from Accounting Standards (Indian GAAP) to Ind AS – first-time adoption under Ind AS,
 GAAP-to-Ind AS difference analysis, restatement of comparatives, and assessment of the impact on financials
 and disclosures.
• Apply Ind AS to complex areas – revenue recognition, ESOP accounting, financial instruments, leases, expected
 credit loss and related-party disclosures.
• Track changes in accounting standards and assess their impact on the company's financials.
3. Month-End Close & Books
• Own a timely and accurate monthly close; support the transition of accounting in-house for real-time closure
 after each month-end.
• Prepare and review key reconciliations, accruals and provisions; ensure every projection and output has a

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£100,000 - £133,000 + Benefits |

We’re looking for several Product Marketing Leads to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.

Where you could join:
• Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.
• MonzOS is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.
• EU is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

You and your team will…
• Set strategy for multiple categories. You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.
• Set the market intelligence agenda. You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.
• Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.
• Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.
• Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.
• Raise the bar for Product Marketing. You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.

Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if:
• You think beyond a single product. You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.
• You own the hardest calls in your domain. You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.
• You bring senior people with you. You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.
• You're a player/coach. You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:
• Initial Call (45mins)
• Case Study Presentation (1hour)
• x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

What’s in it for you:
• £100,000 - £133,000 as a base salary
• This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK
• We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
• Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
• And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.

Where you could join:
• Core is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.
• Borrowing is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.
• Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.

Key Responsibilities
• Own Product Marketing for a Product. You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.
• Become the expert on your market. You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.
• Define positioning customers understand. You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.
• Influence Product Strategy. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.
• Shape successful launches. You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.
• Measure what matters. You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.

This is for you if:
• You enjoy owning entire products. You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning.
• You solve ambiguous problems with evidence. You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.
• You know what makes products win. You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.
• You influence through collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.
• You're always improving and helping others improve. You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.

 

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:
• Initial Call (30mins)
• Case Study Presentation (45mins)
• x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

What’s in it for you:
• £70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary
• This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK
• We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
• Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
• And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE

 

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.description:
About the opportunity:

The Global People Operations team, classically known as HR, strives to create and deliver the best possible and seamless employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle. Leading with care and empathy, we strive to develop efficient and simple people processes and systems to focus on the things that matter the most: Our people at N26.

This means you’ll not only be supported by a dedicated and passionate team, but also HR tools, such as the People Operation ticketing system to ensure nothing slips through the cracks, but there’s even more we’d love to do (which is where you come in)!

This role is based in Berlin, it's a hybrid role (minimum 3 days per week in-office), and 1 year fixed term contract. 

In This Role, You Will:
• Be responsible for the People Operations day-to-day operations throughout the entire employee lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding, within our European Countries
• Manage requests via our ticketing system (Jira) with a high focus on defined SLA’s and employee experience (e.g. employment contracts, leaves, absence, amendments, offboarding…).
• Within Workday, our HRIS, you will look after all processes and requests with high focus on data accuracy and data quality.

• 2+ years minimum of hands-on HR work experience.
• Extensive knowledge of full employee lifecycle (employment contracts, onboarding, leaves of absence, off-boarding…) ideally in the German market.
• Excellent English and ideally German written and verbal communication skills.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills with strong ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines.
• Must be diligent and persistent in follow-up and completion.
• Ability to work and build partnerships across departments.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office as well as Google docs/sheets.
• Experience working with HRIS (Workday) and ticketing systems is a big plus.
• Be based in Berlin or willing to relocate.
• We support N26ers who are based in the office so this role will mostly be based in the office but there is some flexibility for occasional hybrid working.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are: 

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all: 

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. 

We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Are you ready for your next career step? N26 is looking for a Manager Risk Controlling to further develop the risk controlling function at a cutting-edge technology-driven bank. In this role you will establish risk management and controlling tools and drive the development of risk models as well as the implementation of latest regulations. You will take a key role in assessing, controlling and reporting N26s risks.

 

In this role, you will:
• Drive the further development of N26 risk management in order to accommodate N26 growth and risk leadership aspirations.
• Ensure the implementation and adherence to regulatory requirements for risk controlling (e.g. MaRisk, ICAAP guidelines, EBA guidelines, MaSan, SAG).
• Take ownership of running and improving the risk management and risk controlling of the N26 group (incl. recovery plan, Pillar 1 RWA calculation, risk appetite, risk policies and decision making frameworks, limit setting and monitoring, internal controls).
• Drive the performance and further development of the risk inventory according to new business areas and the incorporation of ESG risks.
• Lead capital planning initiatives and the derivation of relevant stress tests and their parameters.
• Leverage a passion for and a track record of using state-of-the-art technology to simplify processes, automate risk controlling workflows, and increase overall operational efficiency.
• Further develop risk reporting at N26 group and continuously generate insights to support steering in accordance with the risk and business strategies.

 

What you need to be successful:
 

Background Skills
• Master's degree in business/economics, finance, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in risk management, financial risk controlling, or capital planning within the banking sector.
• Strong understanding of ICAAP frameworks with a focus on Pillar 1 and the normative perspective, stress testing, and regulatory requirements (e.g., MaRisk, CRR, EBA guidelines, MaSan, SAG).
• Proven experience in risk reporting and relevant risk methods (e.g., risk bearing capacity, risk inventory, capital planning, recovery plan).
• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with an ability to translate complex risk concepts into actionable insights and a technical affinity to help automate workflows and simplify risk controlling processes.
• Detail oriented and reliable with a professional attitude, as you will contribute to sensitive risk controlling topics on which management decisions are made.
