jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Runtime Platform
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Cloud Foundations team within Platform Engineering domain, Runtime Platform segment. 

The Runtime Platform segment’s mission is to provide intuitive, self-service platforms that empower product and feature engineering teams across the organization to seamlessly build, deploy, run and monitor their business applications.

As Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the core architectural bedrock of our technology platform. You will be responsible for guiding a talented group of engineers as they evolve foundational, underlying cloud systems into robust, developer-centric platform products. You will have end-to-end ownership of the team’s scope - spanning strategy, execution, and organizational design - ensuring our cloud account baselines, container orchestration, networking, and secret management scale safely, efficiently, and autonomously.

This role is a unique opportunity to define the future of our cloud ecosystem, directly impacting developer velocity, platform resilience and operational security across the entire company.

In this role, you will:
• Drive Platform Vision and Strategy: Define and execute the long-term roadmap for the Cloud Foundations segment, shifting fundamental cloud capabilities into self-service, developer-friendly products.
• Empower Engineering Teams: Enable development teams to autonomously provision infrastructure, manage secrets and deploy workloads securely through well-defined APIs, robust tooling, and automated guardrails.
• Own Core Cloud Foundations: Oversee a critical portfolio of core platform capabilities, including AWS cloud management (Account Vending Machine, Access Management, Organisation level setup Cloud Baseline), Infrastructure as Code frameworks (Terraform) and Privileged Access Platform.
• Lead and Scale People: Build, coach, and retain a high-performing team of engineers specializing in cloud architecture, infrastructure, and platform engineering, promoting a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and shared ownership.
• Evolve Operational Maturity: Elevate engineering practices around automation, observability, resiliency, and secure-by-default architecture, balancing rapid developer velocity with strict availability and security requirements.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a strategic liaison between Engineering, Product, Security and other stakeholders to align priorities, manage dependencies and advocate for platform adoption across the business.

What you need to be successful

Background
• Proven experience leading high-impact platform, cloud infrastructure, SRE or DevOps teams in a complex, scale-up or enterprise environment.
• Deep experience in AWS cloud architecture, automated multi-account management frameworks and cloud networking baselines.
• Proven track record of transforming foundational cloud infrastructure into product-led, self-service platform solutions that enhance developer experience.

Skills Expertise
• Platform Engineering Principles: Solid grasp of self-service platform design, observability, automation and secure-by-default architecture.
• People Leadership: Strong skills in coaching, performance management, team building and cultivating an inclusive, high-accountability culture.
• Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication and influence skills - able to interface effectively with Security, Architecture and Product teams to drive platform alignment without relying solely on formal authority.
• Fluent English: Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Traits
• Strategic and Systemic Thinker: You look beyond immediate quick fixes to design scalable, long-term systemic architecture and organizational models.
• Product Mindset for Platforms: You treat internal developers as customers, actively listening to their friction points to build intuitive developer platforms.
• Pragmatic Decisive: You thrive in complex environments, balancing technical debt, risk, speed and platform reliability effortlessly.
• Empowering Leader: You set high standards while providing the trust, clarity, and psychological safety your team needs to innovate autonomously.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Conversational Banking
jobs.description:
About the role

Conversational Banking is how N26 scales support without scaling headcount at the same rate. Our ambition is banking as a non-event: clients get help in their channel and language of choice, and most issues resolve before a human agent ever needs to be involved. We build the intelligence in-house — N26 owns its own orchestration and intelligence layer rather than renting it from vendors — and the programme is now shifting from an assistant that answers questions to a system that acts on them.

As Product Manager, you will own one of the highest-value capability areas within the programme end to end — from discovery through delivery to measured resolution outcomes. You will work at the intersection of applied AI, banking operations and regulation, shipping capabilities that millions of clients across Europe use without thinking about them. That is the point.

What you'll do
• Own a capability area. Take full product ownership of a defined slice of the programme — for example a set of high-volume client journeys or an agent-facing capability — including its roadmap, delivery and outcomes.
• Ground everything in evidence. Lead discovery on the contact drivers behind your area, building problem statements from real client voice and operational data rather than assumption.
• Ship agentic capabilities. Work daily with engineering and applied AI teams to move journeys from answering to acting — safe, autonomous resolution with the right guardrails and escalation paths.
• Own your numbers. Instrument your area with resolution-first metrics and the counter-metrics that prove quality isn't traded for efficiency. You should be able to defend every figure you present.
• Work the interfaces. Collaborate with operations, service partners and peer product teams so that what you ship lands in the real workflows of agents and back-office teams.
• Build for a regulated bank. Design compliance, auditability and client protection into every capability from the start.

 

What good looks like after 12 months. Your capability area has a clear, delivered roadmap. The journeys you own resolve more client problems autonomously than they did a year ago, and you can prove it — with quality metrics that hold up. Engineering, operations and design consider you the person who understands the problem best.

 

What you bring
• Three or more years in product management, with at least one shipped product or major capability you owned end to end.
• Experience with AI-powered, conversational or automation products — or a demonstrable, hands-on understanding of how LLM-based systems behave in production.
• Strong analytical fluency: comfortable defining metrics, working directly with data, and separating signal from vanity.
• The communication range to write clearly for executives and to go deep with engineers, in English.
• Bias to evidence over opinion, and comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving programme.

Nice to have
• Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry.
• Exposure to contact-centre operations, BPO environments or customer-service tooling.
• Additional European languages, given our multi-market client base.

Why this role, now

The segment has been newly formed and expanded, the platform foundations are proven, and the interesting work is just starting: taking journeys from containment to genuine autonomous resolution, on infrastructure the bank owns. You will join a small senior team with direct access to the programme's leadership and real ownership from day one.

N26 is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
About us 

N26 is Europe's leading digital bank, fully licensed in Germany and active across more than 20 markets. The mission is not simply to build another fintech product, but to build Europe's most trusted digital primary bank account — the account where people's salaries land, their bills are paid, and their financial lives are managed.

That ambition shapes how we build. As we enter a new phase of maturity, our focus is on scalability, robustness, and the kind of operational excellence that earns everyday trust — not just signups. New senior leaders have joined to drive this chapter, and we're sharpening how we ship and sustain products at scale.

We're also expanding into the moments that make a bank indispensable, from mobile connectivity to financial tools designed for families. These aren't adjacent experiments; they're part of a deliberate strategy to be embedded in daily life.

About the role 

We are making a strategic investment in Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI to redefine how customers interact with N26. We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to architect the next generation of intelligent, multi-channel conversational ecosystems and automated backend intelligence. In this role, you will support our vision for Conversational Banking powered by AI, and building seamless automation for Operations. Serving as the ultimate technical authority and productionizing partner for our Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams, your mission is delivery optimized for velocity, reliability, and modular design. You will oversee the transition of AI/ML models, LLM prototypes, and autonomous agents directly into high-traffic product infrastructure.

Your impact
• Drive Architectural Strategy Scalability: Partner across Data Science, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to design the technical architecture, data pipelines, and orchestration systems required for high-traffic AI services. Ensure the ecosystem supports highly available, low-latency APIs.
• Productionize Complex AI Prototypes: Act as the primary technical bridge transforming data science prototypes into customer-facing features. Refactor, deploy, and maintain Python and Kotlin services, including LLM-powered applications and intelligent agents, within production infrastructure.
• Design Advanced AI Agentic Frameworks: Build and optimize application logic surrounding foundational models (leveraging AWS Bedrock and Anthropic). Directly implement advanced techniques, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) orchestration.
• Establish Observability Evaluation Standards: Implement logging, tracing, and metrics frameworks tailored for LLM outputs. Design and execute real-time evaluation frameworks to measure output quality, manage prompt updates safely, and run A/B tests across different models.
• Cross-Functional Mentorship: Leverage deep system expertise to identify and recommend new AI use cases based on production feasibility and data availability. Cultivate a collaborative environment centered on mutual learning, knowledge transfer, and code quality across engineering disciplines.

What you bring
• Proven Production

Experience:

Extensive track record of building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models or LLM-based applications in high-volume production environments.
• Advanced Backend Engineering: Mastery of developing scalable microservices and designing APIs, with core proficiency in Python and Kotlin.
• Applied AI Engineering MLOps: Direct experience implementing RAG, fine-tuning methodologies, and prompt engineering. Deep familiarity with LLM frameworks, vector databases, and MLOps tooling to deploy and update models safely.
• Data Infrastructure Expertise: Practical knowledge of building data pipelines, managing feature stores, and structuring data for model consumption and evaluation. Hands-on experience with AWS, containerized services (Kubernetes, Docker), and cloud-native model serving platforms like SageMaker and Bedrock.
• Outcome-Driven Technical Leadership: A clear focus on turning technical complexity into tangible business outcomes, such as reducing financial crime investigation handling times and decreasing customer support escalation rates.

jobs.title: Product Designer - Grow & Engage
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Product Designer to join N26's UX team in our Grow and Engage domain. There are a couple of areas within the domain where we're adding design strength, and we'll match you to the right one based on your background and what you're drawn to.

In this role, you'll work in the Grow Engage domain—the heart of the customer experience ranging from the acquisition and signup to our premium membership tiers and the daily engagement of our users. You will work in teams delivering the newest and most innovative features serving our customers in the best way possible. You'll design end-to-end on important features and flows that millions of customers use every day. You'll report to our Head of UX, and work in a tight cross-functional team of product, engineering, research, and data partners. We'll back you to grow your craft on work that matters—to customers, to the business, and to your own development as a designer.

We believe our team's diversity is our strength. The more perspectives at the table, the better. Please apply regardless of your identity, experience, or background.

Please note:
• We highly encourage you to attach your most recent portfolio and CV in English to your application.
• Applications without a portfolio will not be considered

About the Work

The Grow and Engage domain is where we shape how customers get genuine, lasting value from N26. It covers a broad slice of the core product—the moments that bring customers back to their day-to-day banking, the features that build habits and surface real value, and the way our paid tiers turn into something subscribers actively feel.

The work spans the home screen, in-app discovery, recommendations and AI-powered insights, the cross-cutting patterns that pull the whole product together, and our Smart, Go, and Metal subscription tiers—where the opportunity is to weave value through the product rather than bolt it on. You'll have meaningful scope to shape both how we package what we have today and what comes next.

You'll be designing for a fintech product used by millions, in a category where customers' expectations have been shaped by some of the best digital products in the world. The bar is high, and the work matters.

In This Role, You Will:
• Design end-to-end on important features within your segment, from problem framing through research, exploration, and shipped work.
• Bring a high bar for craft—UI and interaction design that delights customers and converts.
• Frame design problems sharply: define user needs, success criteria, constraints, and tradeoffs before jumping into solutions.
• Develop user flows and interactions that hold up across the connected parts of the product, anticipating how your work affects adjacent areas.
• Contribute to our design system—using and improving the patterns the team relies on.
• Be data-informed: plan and run research that blends qualitative and quantitative methods, and proactively seek out the data you need when it isn't on the table.
• Partner closely with product, engineering, research, and data to ship work that actually lands—and to take it further once it's live.
• Use AI tools fluently as part of your design practice—for exploration, prototyping, synthesis, and to accelerate the parts of the work that benefit from acceleration.

How We Work:
• We pair tightly with PM and engineering to develop delightful, scalable solutions.
• Hands-on leadership—managers still design.
• AI is a real, ongoing part of how we work—across design tooling, prototyping, and product. We expect everyone on the team to be fluent and curious here.
• We ship, and we ship often. We learn from what's live as much as from what's in Figma.

What You Need to be Successful:

You're a good fit if you have:
• A strong portfolio showing end-to-end product design work on consumer products—ideally mobile.
• Experience taking complex feature work from problem to ship, owning the design throughout.
• Experience working with a design system—using it, contributing to it, and knowing when to push back on it.
• Experience grounding decisions in research and data—and a willingness to seek them out when they're not available.
• Strong written and verbal communication—you can explain your decisions to product, engineering, and leadership.

Traits:
• Pride in quality: You sweat the details—interaction, visual, copy, edge cases—and you treat your craft as something you're actively growing.
• Systems thinking: You see the connections between parts of a product, and you design with the wider experience in mind.
• Problem-first mindset: You're rigorous about understanding the real problem, the real user, and the real constraints before committing to a direction.
• Bias for action: You move fast, prototype to learn, and resist the pull of polishing in isolation.
• AI-curious: You're active in using AI tools to extend what you can do and reshape your design practice.
• Generous collaborator: You give and receive feedback well, and you're invested in making the work better—not just yours.

What's in it for You:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• Premium banking services: As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account, as well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Generous time off: Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• Autonomy culture: A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting-edge technologies—all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences, and family statuses.
• Relocation support: A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who We Are

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do—and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. Founded in 2013, N26 serves over 7 million customers across 24 markets. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Our UX team is part of the wider Product UX organisation. We're a multidisciplinary group of 40+ designers, researchers, content designers, and design ops practitioners (we call ourselves "UXers"), most of us embedded in cross-functional product teams. Our team is based in Berlin and Barcelona.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination.

jobs.title: Risk Controlling Manager, Liquidity Risk (ILAAP)
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a Manager Risk Controlling to help us further develop and strengthen our Risk Controlling function with a focus on the Internal Liquidity Adequacy Assessment Process (ILAAP) and overall Liquidity Risk Management.

As part of the Risk Controlling team, you will lead the development, implementation, and analysis of models for liquidity risk controlling, covering both regulatory requirements (Pillar I) and internal methodologies (Pillar II). You will ensure that N26 maintains a robust liquidity position through advanced modelling, stress testing, and expert methodological guidance.

At N26, we are redefining banking through technology and innovation. As a Risk Controlling Manager with a focus on ILAAP and liquidity risk, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of risk management in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment. Join us and be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and excellence.

In this role, you will:
• Lead the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the ILAAP framework, ensuring it accurately reflects the firm's liquidity adequacy and risk appetite.
• Develop, calibrate and continuously refine quantitative liquidity risk methodologies based on historical development data, including deposit stability models, liquidity runoff assumptions, internal liquidity maturity ladders, survival period analysis, and intraday liquidity metrics.
• Design and statistically calibrate liquidity risk model parameters using internal historical data, expert judgement and stress-testing results, ensuring that assumptions remain empirically grounded and fit for purpose.
• Translate the specific characteristics of a digital retail bank into tailored liquidity risk methodologies rather than relying solely on standard regulatory metrics and industry practices.
• Spearhead the design and calibration of comprehensive liquidity stress scenarios, identifying potential vulnerabilities and challenging qualitative assumptions.
• Ensure full compliance with relevant European and German regulatory requirements, such as MaRisk and EBA Guidelines on ILAAP, while overseeing regulatory liquidity reporting standards.
• Establish and maintain the architectural design of risk limits for liquidity and funding, providing expert advice on limit calibration and remediation strategies.
• Lead initiatives to improve the quality, governance, and lineage of core balance sheet data used in liquidity risk and ILAAP calculations.
• Act as the primary methodological expert and project lead for interactions with internal/external auditors and regulators (e.g., EBA, national central banks) regarding the adequacy and robustness of liquidity risk practices.

What you need to be successful:

Background:
• Quantitative academic background (Master's in statistics, mathematics, economics, or a similar quantitative field). Professional certifications like CFA or FRM are a plus.
• 5+ years of practical experience in a risk controlling function or a leading consultancy (Big Four), with deep expertise in Liquidity Risk and ILAAP within a regulated financial institution.

Skills:
• Strong understanding of ILAAP frameworks and liquidity risk management (Pillar I and Pillar II), including liquidity stress testing, funding risk, deposit behaviour modelling, and key metrics (e.g. survival horizon, maturity transformation).
• Experience in designing, calibrating, and validating quantitative methodologies for liquidity risk, including stress scenarios, behavioural assumptions, and model parametrisation.
• Strong understanding of statistical analysis and data-driven modelling techniques (e.g. time-series analysis, scenario modelling, calibration and backtesting).
• Strong understanding of data flows, data quality and governance of key risk inputs.
• Ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into structured analytical methodologies and algorithmic solutions.
• Extensive knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., MaRisk, CRR, ICAAP and ILAAP guidelines, EBA regulatory expectations).
• Strong expertise in risk governance frameworks, including risk appetite, policies, internal controls, and decision-making frameworks.
• Ability to work independently, form sound judgments on complex risk topics, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and regulators.
• Experience with specifying data requirements and collaborating with Data Engineering or Risk Technology teams is a strong plus.
• Fluent English is required; German language skills are a plus.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

jobs.title: Senior Atlassian Consultant
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Atlassian Consultant to join our team at N26. This role is designed for an Atlassian technical expert who thrives in a high-growth, evolving FinTech landscape. You won't just be managing tools; you will be optimizing the way our entire organization collaborates.

We are looking for a professional who enjoys conceptual ownership. At N26, we value "first-principles" thinking—the ability to take high-level business goals and translate them into elegant, scalable technical architectures. If you enjoy a role where you have the autonomy to define the "how" and "why" behind a solution, this is the place for you.

In this role, you will:
• Translate Vision into Reality: Act as a key partner to stakeholders, taking broad business objectives and refining them into sophisticated, high-impact technical solutions within the Atlassian suite.
• Drive Independent Project Life-Cycles: Lead initiatives from discovery and requirements gathering through to design, build, and global rollout. You will have full ownership of the delivery process.

• Engineer Advanced Customizations: Extend the standard capabilities of Jira and Confluence through custom scripting (Scriptrunner/Groovy) and high-level use of Atlassian APIs. You will build the "glue" that connects our processes.
• Architect Versatile Workflows: Design and implement custom Jira configurations that are robust enough for a regulated bank but flexible enough for an agile tech company.

• Technical Mentorship: Act as a subject matter expert, coaching teams on best practices and ensuring our internal documentation is a "gold standard" resource.

• Professional Seniority: 5+ years (minimum 3+) of hands-on experience in Jira, JSM, and Confluence administration within enterprise environments.
• Conceptual Agility: You are comfortable working from high-level briefs and enjoy the process of "discovery"—asking the right questions to build a clear, structured path forward.
• Financial Services Context: Experience in a regulated environment is a strong plus, helping you balance innovation with compliance and security standards.
• The Technical Edge: * Core: Deep proficiency in JQL, Automations, Atlassian APIs, Assets and Scriptrunner (Groovy).
• Communication Mastery: You can navigate conversations with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring everyone is aligned on the solution. Fluent English is a must.

jobs.title: Senior Business Audit Manager
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

The Senior Manager, Business Audit supports internal audit activities across the N26 group, including external contractors and subsidiaries, in line with professional and regulatory standards. Key responsibilities include developing and executing a comprehensive risk-based annual audit plan, managing the full audit cycle to ensure operational effectiveness, compliance, and reliability, and auditing both in-house and outsourced processes. The position requires preparing detailed audit reports, regularly communicating findings and agreed actions to management and committees, monitoring timely resolution of issues, participating in strategic projects while maintaining independence, and supervising junior auditors to ensure high-quality outputs.

In this role, you will:
• Conduct and support all business internal audit activities within the N26 group including external contractors
• Prepare and where necessary lead the full audit cycle including risk management and control management over business operations’ effectiveness, reliability and compliance with all applicable directives and regulations
• Prepare and where necessary lead a comprehensive risk-based annual audit plan for business functions, including product, customer operations, sales, marketing, and partnerships
• Audit all activities and processes, including those outsourced at appropriate intervals and of all subsidiaries performed in accordance with established professional and regulatory standards
• Prepare the internal audit reports as per requirements with strong focus on attention to details of specific boundaries of the audit/s defined scope
• Prepare written reports on each audit and submit to the responsible members of the management board and communicate the outcomes / agreed actions to specific team members, this includes regular reporting to management board and committees
• Monitor in an appropriate form whether the findings identified during the audit are remedied within the specified timeframe
• Participate in key projects, while guarding independence, avoiding conflicts of interest and maintain internal audit policies and procedures
• Supervise and review the audit outputs of junior team members enabling them to be successful in their role

What you need to be successful:

Background:
• Successfully completed degree in economics or comparable training.
• Gained at least 7 years working experience as Internal Auditor or similar responsibilities/knowledge in an international company, in a regulated environment. Preferably in a bank or other financial institution or an audit company.
• High degree of process understanding as well as profound knowledge in the areas of online banking and retail products.
• Very good insight into Banking laws requirements, and willing to become acquainted with local specific Banking laws, standard banking requirements as well as banking IT-Systems.
• Fluency in English and German is required. Any other European language is a plus.

Skills:
• Strong communication and stakeholder management with the ability to engage with cross-functional stakeholders and to withstand management pushback.
• Proficiency in audit tools, data analytics, and reporting systems

About the opportunity

Are you passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a real impact in a dynamic environment? Look no further! We are on the lookout for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer who is ready to take the lead in proactively identifying and mitigating security threats and safeguarding our sensitive data. Join forces with our Platform and Data teams and be at the forefront of safeguarding our customer and our organisation.

At N26, our Infrastructure Security team is on a mission to detect and remediate IT and cloud infrastructure security threats. We're dedicated to providing efficient and effective services that empower our N26 tech teams to thrive.

Once here you will
• Drive the Cloud Infrastructure Security function roadmap in alignment with the Product Manager, Tech Lead, and Engineering Manager.
• Own, define and drive initiatives, solutions, processes and frameworks to proactively identify and mitigate security threats within our AWS infrastructure which leads to an overall improvement of our security maturity.

About the opportunity

We’re looking for a German-language Senior Copywriter to join the N26 Creative Studio in Berlin or Barcelona.

You’ll play a key role in shaping how N26 speaks to millions of customers across Europe — turning complex financial topics into communication that’s attention-grabbing and easy to understand. Your main focus will be creating high-quality German campaign and marketing copy, while also contributing English writing when needed.

You’ll work closely with our German Localisation Specialist, English Copywriters, and Designers to make sure everything we put out into the world reflects a consistent voice and a high standard of craft.

The Creative Studio operates primarily in English, but this role is focused on producing exceptional German-language creative work.

In this role, you will:
• Write clear, engaging German copy across social, paid media, CRM, web, OOH, and other marketing channels.
• Develop campaign ideas, headlines, and concepts directly in German.
• Adapt and transcreate English campaigns into strong, culturally relevant German communication.
• Contribute English-language copy when needed alongside primarily German writing responsibilities.
• Collaborate closely with localisation to maintain linguistic excellence and a consistent brand voice in German.

• Recognised qualification within the field of copywriting.
• 3+ years of professional copywriting experience at agencies, start-ups, or companies, ideally for B2C digital or tech products.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der rechtlichen Architektur und Absicherung wegweisender Finanzprodukte. Du gestaltest die Zukunft des digitalen Banking, indem du komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen in rechtssichere Konzepte übersetzt – von der Skalierung unserer Bank-, Trading- und Krypto-Angebote bis hin zur Erschließung neuer europäischer Märkte. Dabei balancierst du Agilität mit höchster Compliance und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produktvisionen stets im Einklang mit dem Aufsichtsrecht stehen.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Du wirst innerhalb des N26 Legal Departments in unserem Banking Law Litigation Team arbeiten und bei der Einführung sowie Skalierung von zukunftsweisenden Bank- und Finanzprodukten mitwirken (z. B. Trading Crypto).
• Du berätst das Management und den Vorstand ganzheitlich in allen rechtlichen Fragen im Zusammenhang mit bestehenden und neuen Banking, Trading und Finanzprodukten.
• Du bewertest komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen und entwickelst rechtssichere Konzepte für neue Produkte in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
• Du arbeitest eng mit dem Product und dem Compliance Team zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Innovation und regulatorische Compliance Hand in Hand gehen.
• Du fungierst als Ansprechpartner bei regulatorischen Prüfungen und steuerst souverän die Kommunikation mit Aufsichtsbehörden.
• Du koordinierst eigenverantwortlich die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Rechtsberatern und stellst eine erstklassige Beratungsqualität sicher.
• Du führst eigenständig Gerichts- sowie Streitbeilegungsverfahren und verantwortest das Management bedeutender Verfahren über alle Instanzen hinweg.
 

What you need to be successful

Hintergrund:
• Du bist deutscher Volljurist und hast das erste und zweite juristische Staatsexamen mit überdurchschnittlichen Ergebnissen abgeschlossen.
• Du kannst mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung und einen wesentlichen Teil davon im Bank- und Finanzrecht in einer renommierten Kanzlei oder/und in einem internationalen Unternehmen (gerne auch Fintech) vorweisen.
• Umfassende Kenntnisse im Bank- und Finanzrecht und in angrenzenden Rechtsgebieten sind erforderlich. Erfahrungen in anderen Rechtsgebieten sind willkommen.
• Idealerweise hast du bereits einen Fachanwaltslehrgang im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder führst bereits den entsprechenden Fachanwaltstitel.
• Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift, jede weitere Sprache (insbesondere Französisch, Spanisch oder Italienisch) ist ein Plus.

Fähigkeiten:
• Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen sowie digitalen Geschäftsmodellen.
• Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und bist bereit diese auch intern und extern zu vertreten.
• Du bist bereit, dir pragmatisch auch neue Themen und Rechtsgebiete zu erschließen und dynamische regulatorische Entwicklungen eng zu begleiten.
• Du besitzt ein hohes Level an Integrität, Einsatzbereitschaft und Eigeninitiative und scheust dich nicht vor Personalverantwortung.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:
• Treibe deine Karriere voran und werde Teil eines der bekanntesten FinTech-Disruptoren Europas 🚀.
• Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Ein attraktives Budget für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung, ein Home-Office-Budget, Rabatte auf Fitness- und Wellness-Mitgliedschaften, Sprach-Apps sowie Vergünstigungen für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
• Exklusive N26 Vorteile: Als N26 Mitarbeiter:in erhältst du kostenlosen Zugang zu einem N26 Premium-Konto sowie kostenlose Abonnements für Freunde und Familie.
• Treuebonus: Ein zusätzlicher Tag Urlaub für jedes Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit.
• Freiraum Technologie: Ein hohes Maß an Autonomie und Zugang zu modernsten Technologien – während du in einem freundlichen, internationalen Team mit unterschiedlichsten Erfahrungen und Hintergründen arbeitest.
• Relocation-Paket: Unterstützung beim Umzug und Visum-Prozess für alle, die es benötigen.

Wer wir sind

N26 hat Banking für die heutige digitale Welt neu gedacht. Technologie und Design prägen alles, was wir tun – so bauen wir die globale Bankenplattform, die Menschen weltweit gerne nutzen.

Wir haben physische Filialen, Papierkram und versteckte Gebühren abgeschafft und durch ein elegantes digitales Erlebnis ersetzt. Menschen die Freiheit zu geben, so zu leben und zu banken, wie sie wollen – das ist es, was uns jeden Morgen antreibt und inspiriert.

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin, weitere Standorte befinden sich in mehreren europäischen Städten wie Wien und Barcelona. Unser Team zählt über 1.500 Mitarbeiter:innen aus mehr als 80 Nationen.

Siehst du dich in dieser Rolle aufblühen? Wir freuen uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du nicht 100 % der Kriterien erfüllst. Vielleicht bist du genau die Richtige bzw. der Richtige für diese oder andere Positionen bei uns!

Chancengleichheit für alle

Bei N26 glauben wir, dass unsere Stärke in unseren Mitarbeiter:innen und den vielfältigen Perspektiven liegt, die sie mitbringen. Wir setzen auf diverse Teams, die Innovationen vorantreiben und den Geschäftserfolg sichern. Wir suchen aktiv nach Talenten mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen und begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Kultur, sexueller Orientierung, Beeinträchtigungen, Neurodiversität oder Alter.

Wir setzen uns für einen hervorragenden und barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozess ein. Wenn du spezielle Unterstützung oder Anpassungen im Prozess benötigst, lass es uns bitte wissen. Wir sind gerne für dich da!

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel Banking Law
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity 

N26 is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel Banking Law to further expand our legal expertise. In this key role, you will be part of our Banking Law Litigation Team and serve as a strategic partner to management and the Executive Board.

Your focus will be on the legal architecture and risk mitigation for groundbreaking financial products. You will shape the future of digital banking by translating complex regulatory requirements into legally sound concepts, from scaling our banking, trading, and crypto offerings to entering new European markets. In doing so, you will balance agility with the highest standards of compliance, ensuring that our product vision always aligns with regulatory law.

In this role you will:
• Work within the N26 Legal Department in our Banking Law Litigation Team, contributing to the launch and scaling of forward-looking banking and financial products (e.g., Trading Crypto).
• Provide holistic advice to management and the Executive Board on all legal matters relating to existing and new banking, trading, and financial products.
• Evaluate complex regulatory requirements and develop legally sound concepts for new products in a dynamic environment.
• Collaborate closely with the Product and Compliance teams, ensuring that innovation and regulatory compliance go hand in hand.
• Act as the point of contact for regulatory audits and confidently manage communication with supervisory authorities.
• Independently coordinate collaboration with external legal counsel and ensure first-class advisory quality.
• Independently conduct court and dispute resolution proceedings, taking responsibility for the management of significant litigation across all instances.

What You Need to Be Successful:

Background:
• You are a fully qualified German lawyer (Volljurist) -and you have completed both the First and Second State Law Examinations.
• You have at least 4 years of professional experience, with a significant portion in banking and financial law at a renowned law firm and/or an international company (fintech experience is a plus).
• Comprehensive knowledge of banking and financial law, as well as adjacent legal fields, is required. Experience in other legal areas is welcome.
• Ideally, you have successfully completed the specialised lawyer course in banking and capital markets law (Fachanwaltslehrgang im Bank- und Kapitalmarktrecht) or already hold the title of Specialist Lawyer (Fachanwalt).
• Fluent in written and spoken German and English. Any additional language (especially French, Spanish, or Italian) is a plus.

Skills:
• Strong interest in technical and business contexts, as well as digital business models.
• Ability to work independently, make decisions, and defend them both internally and externally.
• Pragmatic approach to tackling new topics and legal areas, while closely monitoring dynamic regulatory developments.
• High level of integrity, dedication, and initiative, with no hesitation to take on personnel management responsibilities.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Risk Controlling - ICAAP / ILAAP (Pillar 1)
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? N26 is looking for a Senior Manager to drive and further develop the Risk Governance Capital Planning team.

In this role, you will take ownership of key risk controlling processes across capital and liquidity adequacy, with a focus on Pillar 1 topics within the normative perspective of the ICAAP framework as well as ILAAP. You will ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and internal risk strategy while further strengthening governance frameworks, methodologies, and risk controlling practices.

As a senior leader of the team, you will guide and mentor team members and play a key role in assessing, controlling, and reporting N26’s risks. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders and act as a key counterpart for auditors and regulators.

In this role, you will:
• Lead and enhance capital planning and overall ICAAP governance frameworks, providing guidance, mentorship, and expertise across Pillar 1 topics, while ensuring structural alignment with ILAAP frameworks.
• Own and further enhance capital planning processes and Pillar 1 ICAAP governance, including stress testing frameworks and scenario design.
• Oversee the maintenance and development of the ILAAP framework, including liquidity risk methodologies, stress testing, and key liquidity risk metrics.
• Oversee key risk governance components, including RWA calculation, risk appetite framework, risk policies, limit setting and monitoring, and internal controls.
• Own and further develop the risk inventory and recovery plan, ensuring consistency across capital and liquidity perspectives.
• Drive the continuous improvement of risk reporting, delivering high-quality, data-driven insights for senior management with a primary focus on capital adequacy and supporting liquidity metrics.
• Ensure strong data governance and data quality in line with BCBS 239 principles for key inputs used for capital and liquidity risk assessments (e.g. balance sheet, RWA, liquidity metrics).
• Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements (e.g., MaRisk, CRR, ICAAP and ILAAP guidelines, EBA regulatory expectations), act as key contact for auditors and regulators, and collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Finance, Treasury, Risk).
• Leverage a passion for and a track record of using state-of-the-art technology to simplify processes, automate risk controlling workflows, and increase overall operational efficiency.

What you need to be successful:

Background:
• Master’s degree in business/economics, finance, mathematics, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in risk management, risk controlling, capital planning, liquidity risk, or a related function within a regulated financial institution or leading consultancy.
• Strong experience across ICAAP, capital planning, and/or ILAAP and liquidity risk management.
• Proven experience in mentoring or guiding team members and driving complex cross-functional initiatives.

Skills:
• Strong understanding of ICAAP frameworks (Pillar 1 focus), including capital planning, risk inventory, stress testing, and recovery planning.
• Strong understanding of ILAAP frameworks and liquidity risk metrics to ensure alignment between capital adequacy and key liquidity risk parameters.
• Extensive knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., MaRisk, CRR, ICAAP and ILAAP guidelines, EBA regulatory expectations).
• Strong expertise in risk governance frameworks, including risk appetite, policies, internal controls, and decision-making frameworks.
• Experience in designing and enhancing methodologies across capital risk (e.g. stress testing, scenario design, capital planning processes) with a functional understanding of corresponding liquidity risk inputs.
• Strong understanding of data flows, data quality, and governance of key risk inputs (e.g. balance sheet, RWA, liquidity metrics).
• Strong analytical, conceptual, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to independently drive topics and communicate complex issues effectively.
• Fluent English; German is a strong advantage.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

Equal Opportunities:

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

We are seeking a passionate Senior Product Manager - Banking Scalability Platform to join the Core Systems team in disrupting the Core Banking technology standards with highly configurable, modular and automated solutions that enable rapid product launches along with automated compliance and data flows. The Core banking Group is split between our Barcelona and Berlin offices, which are the main product tech hubs for N26 globally.

As a Product Manager in the Banking Scalability Platform team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure of N26 that relates to Treasury, Ops and Finance. This function is critical to N26’s ability to not only provide our current functionality but to also offer new financial products in a competitive and scalable manner.

In this role you will:
• Drive core banking transformation: Lead the strategic implementation and seamless integration of our next-generation Core Banking engine within N26’s global architecture.
• Translate complex banking domains into scalable infrastructure: Architect robust platform requirements that balance intricate core banking processes, strict compliance and regulatory environments, and long-term operational efficiency.

About the opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Senior Product Manager - Ops Automation Enablement (OAE) with a passion for building the intelligence and systems behind world-class banking operations.

This is a true builder’s role: you will lead the strategy, design, delivery, and enterprise-scale adoption of Agentic AI, hyperautomation, process mining, and internal tooling to reshape how complex, control-intensive Banking Operations are executed.

You will work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders to ensure N26 can scale aggressively across markets and product offerings without proportional headcount growth—all while maintaining the strict regulatory and quality standards our customers expect.

In this role, you will:

Lead Enterprise Transformation Agentic AI Adoption:
• Architect AI Workflows: Design, deploy, and govern E2E, multi-step Agentic AI solutions and automations that target high-volume processes, cross-team friction, and manual back-office tasks.
• AI Champion: Act as the primary AI Champion for Banking Operations: translating complex ML/AI concepts into practical, working systems rather than just talking about them.
• Change Management Value Realization: Identify structural and behavioral barriers to adoption; design frameworks that embed new AI capabilities into day-to-day operations and team decision-making.

End-to-End Operating Model Process Intelligence:
• Process Mining Re-Engineering: Lead structured process capture, process mining, and workflow mapping. Evaluate opportunities to completely redesign end-to-end workflows rather than merely automating existing inefficiencies.
• Core CRM Platform Integration: Partner with Conversational Banking and Platform owners to optimize Salesforce (our core case-management backbone) and integrate AI agents with our central architecture and AWS infrastructure.
• Operational Efficiency ROI: Define and track clear metrics for every initiative (FTE impact, handling times, error rates, cost-per-unit, and time saved) to ensure high business value and ROI.

Execution, Governance Cross-Functional Alignment:
• Bridge Tech Operations: Work directly with Banking Ops leads, Data Science, AI Enablement, and Engineering to turn operational pain points into clear product specs, PRDs, and prompt configurations.
• Regulatory Excellence: Collaborate with Data Protection, Legal, and Compliance teams to build resilient workflows that comply strictly with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal governance standards.
• Operational Readiness: Own product readiness for launches: ensuring changes in one pod do not disrupt downstream processes, control environments, or customer outcomes.

What you need to be successful:
• Product Management

Experience:

5+ years in Product Management, Process Engineering, or Operational Transformation, ideally in a fast-moving tech, digital, or fintech environment.
• AI Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience taking ML, RPA, or Agentic AI products from 0 to 1 (or significantly scaling them) with measurable, quantified operational savings.
• Hands-On Technical Curiosity: Comfortable working with APIs, prompt engineering, agentic frameworks, and orchestration tools. You are hands-on enough to build/configure the first version yourself, but strategic enough to design the long-term vision.
• Process Improvement Mindset: Proven expertise in workflow mapping, failure demand analysis, and structured waste-reduction methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).
• Regulated Environment

Experience:

Background in banking or fintech, navigating compliance, legal, and risk sign-offs in a control-heavy environment.
• Analytical Data-Driven: Proficient in using data to model impact before building and measure results after (Power BI, SQL, or similar).
• Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of presenting complex trade-offs to senior leadership (EXCO/SteerCo) and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

About You:
• Structured by default: You write things down, build systems, and actively retire processes that no longer serve the organization.
• AI-First Instinct: You inherently see how agents can augment human teams and make work faster, smarter, and cleaner.
• Pragmatic Outcome-Focused: You care deeply about results, operational quality, and scalable growth, not just deploying shiny tools.

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Access Team
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Platform Engineering Domain in the Access Team.

The mission of Platform Engineering is to provide trusted, performant, self-service platforms that empower product teams to build “the bank the world loves to use.” Access Team’s mission is to ensure secure, seamless, and compliant access to that infrastructure. We build the gateway between our engineers and our cloud resources.

As one of the first banks completely hosted in the cloud, our security and compliance standards are industry-leading. We don’t just use a modern stack; we build sophisticated access solutions like JIT (Just-In-Time) provisioning and Privileged Access Management (PAM) to protect our customers and our data.

In this role, you will:

Be responsible for designing and maintaining the systems that govern how humans and services access our AWS environment. You will ensure that access is "least-privilege" by default, automated, and audit-ready.

More specifically, you will:
• Manage and scale our Teleport infrastructure for secure access to servers, databases, and Kubernetes clusters.
• Develop and maintain automated Identity and Access Management (IAM) workflows within AWS.
• Implement and improve Just-In-Time (JIT) access solutions to reduce our permanent attack surface.
• Collaborate closely with the Cloud Control team to integrate security policies into the core infrastructure provisioning process.
• Automate authorization flows to ensure regulatory compliance without slowing down engineering velocity.
• Maintain and improve our Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for all access-related components.
• Support internal and external audits by providing technical evidence and ensuring our access protocols meet strict regulatory standards; proactively identify gaps in our current access landscape and drive initiatives to remediate them.
• Create monitors and alerts for access patterns, diagnosing and resolving issues related to authentication and authorization services.

What you need to be successful:

Background and

skills:
• Production expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS), specifically with IAM, Organizations, and Multi-account security.
• Hands-on experience with Access Management tools, preferably Teleport, or similar PAM/JIT solutions.
• Strong experience with Terraform for managing cloud resources and security policies.
• Solid understanding of Linux systems and networking fundamentals (OIDC, SAML, SSH, TLS, TCP/IP).
• Experience programming in Go and/or Python to automate security workflows.
• Familiarity with compliance frameworks and a proven ability to translate audit requirements into technical solutions.
• Experience with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) from an access and RBAC perspective.
• A "Security-first" mindset with a proactive approach to solving complex permission issues.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a fast-paced environment.

Traits:
• Independently lead tech projects
• Lead and promote technical discussions with engineering audiences
• Mentoring support of Junior Mid-level engineers
• Review, assessment improvement of the current team tool landscape
• Advancements in code quality practices, security awareness and monitoring
• Build up knowledge of production data and its analysis
• You are on top of incidents, generate learnings and follow up
• Deepest understanding of everything built by the team
• Leading specialist activities, drive tech projects independently
• Bring architectural technical debt issues into the backlog
• You see the delivery of your team in a broad, domain-wide context
• Building bridges to other areas and be the glue in your own team
• Take full responsibility for your work and projects you participate
• Mature solution-oriented tech counterpart in any discussion

What’s in it for you:
• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors.
• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
• Come together with your team in the office for a dedicated day of teamwork each week, plus another day of your choice, and enjoy the flexibility of remote work the rest of the time. Some roles may require additional in-office presence.
• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds.
• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Software Logistics
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Software Logistics Team (CI/CD) within our Platform Engineering Segment.

Platform Engineering's mission is to provide easy-to-use, self-service platforms that enable other segments to build, deploy, and monitor their business applications with minimal friction. As one of the first banks hosted entirely in the cloud, we hold ourselves to high standards of security, resilience, and productivity — and we use a modern technology stack to deliver on them for our development teams, the company, and our customers.

In this role, you will:
• Maintain, implement, and optimise the systems and applications that power CI/CD at N26
• Shape and influence N26's CI/CD strategy, empowering development teams to deliver features faster
• Improve the security and compliance posture of our systems
• Implement security and compliance checks as a service within our CI/CD pipeline offering
• Standardise our pipelines and raise the level of autonomy for our users
• Mentor other engineers and help improve our ways of working and engineering practices
• Take an active part in roadmap definition and prioritisation for our group
• Stay on top of incidents and production deployment issues, ensuring stable and predictable delivery

What you need to be successful:

 Must have:

Platform Engineering’s goal is to provide easy to use, self-service platforms to enable other segments to easily build, deploy and monitor their business applications. And Observability’s role in that part of the company is to provide our users with end-to-end observability that’s easy to use.

As one of the first banks completely hosted in the cloud, our security, resilience and productivity standards require a motivated and well balanced team. We are using a modern technology stack to match our principles when it comes to providing the framework for our development team, the company and our customers.

In this role, you will:

In Observability you’ll build the tools for monitoring and measuring infrastructure, microservices, and sometimes totally unique workloads. You’ll put the developer experience at the front of your mind and implementations, and you’ll contribute deeply to understanding and preventing incidents through tooling, automation, and people-centered processes. All the while you’ll be thinking like an engineer. That means using automation to speed up repetitive tasks and to contribute to the security and compliance of the tech stack that you run and support.

What you need to be successful:

You need to be well-versed in the basics building blocks of observability: metrics, logs, and traces. You should also be familiar with the tools we need to extract (think things like Prometheus, StatsD, OpenTelemetry libraries), transform (tools like Vector, Beats, FluentBit), and load (OpenSearch, Grafana, etc.) this data in ways that your fellow engineers can make sense of it. Then, you should be comfortable with helping your colleagues understand this data so they can measure and monitor their applications and recover quickly for incidents..

Next, you’ll need experience with at least one glue language like GoLang or Python. And you’ll need to operate like your brain runs on Linux. Everything we do is in the cloud, so it’s important that you like it, understand it, and know what it takes to observe it. Your entire environment, from provisioning to deployment, will be defined and managed as code using tools like Terraform and AWS CDK.

Finally, things change fast here. We like it that way! Even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria for this job, but you should have a strong desire to learn and improve, and you have a passion for working with bleeding-edge technologies, then you’d be a great asset to our team. 

Bullet points version
• Understanding of the basic building blocks of observability: metrics, logs, and traces
• Experience using the right tools to extract data (think things like Prometheus, StatsD, OpenTelemetry libraries), transform data (tools like Vector, Beats, FluentBit), and load data (OpenSearch, Grafana, Datadog, etc.) so that your fellow engineers can make sense of it
• Solid skills with at least one glue language like GoLang or Python
• The ability to build in a cloud-only environment with with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform and AWS CDK
• A brain that runs on Linux

What’s in it for you:

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. 

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.
