The expectation will be to upskill across all areas over time. 

At Monzo we do things differently: we truly care about providing a phenomenal experience for our customers. We believe there’s a better way to do banking, and we want to be the best possible bank without getting stuck in the old ways of doing things. We operate a “three lines of defence” model of risk management at Monzo: you’ll be working in 2LoD as part of our Risk and Compliance Collective, in the Compliance Team.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
• Being the first point of contact for compliance advice, initially for the Wealth Collective but expanding to Growth Marketing and MonzOS over time.
• Providing clear and proactive compliance advice, especially on COBS, PROD, SDR, CASS and Consumer Duty.
• Reviewing customer journeys and communications to help the business deliver good customer outcomes, and flagging any risks.
• Advising Marketing and Financial Promotion teams on financial promotion rules and guidance.
• Overseeing regulatory breaches and incidents as part of the team.
• Learning about the wider Collectives the team supports with the aim to expand your knowledge to proactively support more areas in future.

This role requires strong communication collaboration skills with a ‘ hands-on ’ approach, to ensure that regulations are fully understood, our products are ‘compliant by design’ and our customers' needs are being met.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You know the Consumer Duty and COBS rules inside out
• You've got hands-on experience advising on products ideally from working at a bank, wealth manager, or fintech.
• You’re already incorporating AI into your day-to-day work
• You like to be where the action is and thrive in fast paced environments.
• You're a great communicator and problem-solver, good at weighing risks and finding balanced solutions.
• You can work independently and juggle changing priorities.
• You're good at building strong relationships with different teams.
• You're passionate about compliance and excited about the future of banking!

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌What’s in it for you

💰£59,500 - £70,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps
• Recruiter call
• Initial call with the hiring manager
• Role specific interview
• Behavioural interview

 We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Consumer Payments Compliance
jobs.description:
About PhonePe Limited:

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Location: Bengaluru, India

Team: Payments Compliance

Position: Assistant Manager

Reports To: Senior Manager – Compliance

Job Responsibilities
• Assist in the comprehensive review of new products, features, and offerings on the PhonePe platform, ensuring zero go-lives without compliance sign-off.
• Partner with Product teams through the entire product lifecycle to proactively flag and resolve compliance and risk-related issues and maintain deviations observed.
• Assist in mapping preventative and detective controls to mitigate compliance risks, document requirements, and manage their implementation.
• Assist in establishing an efficient Regulatory Change Management (RCM) framework to track, summarize, and implement RBI and NPCI circulars/communications with satisfactory evidence on records.
• Ensure regulatory reports are validated and filed timely with regulators.
• Ensure review of all Non-IT related policies and procedures on a periodic basis or whenever there is change in process and place it for Management approvals to board on a timely fashion.
• Assist in regulatory inspections, data validation and ensure audit preparedness throughout the processes designed.
• Handle and manage the GRC tool implementation
• Maintain oversight of key compliance metrics; prepare monthly Compliance Dashboards and trackers for governance forums.
• Keep abreast of all regulatory developments as well as evolving best practices in compliance controls and leverage the same to implement better and current compliance standards.
• Proactively pursue and implement automation and AI solutions to drive efficiencies in internal compliance processes. 

Basic and Advanced

Qualifications:
• Any Post Graduate in Finance and Risk Management / MBA / CA / CS with at least 6+ years of experience in the Payments Compliance space.
• In-depth knowledge on the compliance environment of the banking / payment and fintech’s industry along with Indian regulations and current market practices.
• Well versed with the RBI, NPCI, NBBL and KYC guidelines for payments products, especially UPI and BBPS.
• Excellent knowledge of reporting procedures and record keeping guidelines.
• Ability to communicate clearly and precisely to the point.
• Has an analytical mind able to “see” the complexities of procedures and regulations.
• Is a problem solver and always ready to take ownership of deliverables assigned.
• Has high ethical standards and is able to work diligently to complete your duties. 

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
• Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
• Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
• Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
• Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
• Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
• Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

 

Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. jobs.title: Financial Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Financial Operations team’s mission is to provide accurate, complete, and timely financial and operational information to our leaders, regulators, customers, and key stakeholders. We ensure efficient asset utilization, proactively mitigate risks, and ensure full compliance with regulatory bodies.

We are seeking a Financial Operations Manager to join our growing team on the ground in Singapore. In this role, you will lead our local financial regulatory reporting and finops work, ensuring adherence to Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulations while collaborating across international entities. As one of the early operational hires in Singapore, you will play a key role in building processes from the ground up with high autonomy and visibility.

This role is based in our Singapore office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Manage risk for back-office activities by maintaining controls over customer and firm cash, suspense accounts, and exception handling. Execute daily trust and custody computations by the strict deadline of 12:00 PM SGT in compliance with Securities and Futures (Licensing and Conduct of Business) Regulations (SF(LCB)R).
• Manage automated MT940 (Swift) messages and API pulls, extract customer ledger balances, and download statements from trust banks and sub-custodians. Reconcile security quantities against sub-custodian statements and verify no liens or encumbrances are placed on customer assets.
• Monitor Financial Resources to ensure continuous compliance above Total Risk Requirement (TRR) limits. Prepare and submit quarterly filings via the MAS-Tx portal, including Form 1 (Statement of Assets Liabilities), Form 2 (Statement of Financial Resources TRR), and Form 7 (Aggregate Margin Exposure).
• Partner closely with Corporate Accounting, Treasury, RHS Clearing, and Engineering teams to support system transitions (e.g., system migrations, report automation) and cross-train across broader global entity reporting.

What you bring
• Deep understanding of MAS Risk-Based Capital (RBC) frameworks, SF(LCB)R requirements, and capital requirements for broker-dealers in Singapore.
• 5+ years of experience in financial operations or regulatory reporting within a broker-dealer or financial institution in Singapore.
• Experience managing back-office ledger systems, Swift/API data feeds, and reporting automation using tools like Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or data visualization tools like Superset are a plus).
• Strong self-starter attitude with proven success operating independently in a fast-paced environment and managing time-sensitive regulatory deadlines (e.g., 12:00 PM SGT daily deliverables).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to partner with global teams across varying time zones.

What we offer
• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
• Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.
• Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
The role

We’re looking for a Brand Designer to shape how Solflare shows up across social media every day, while also supporting our People & Culture communications.

This is a hands-on role with social media design at its core. You’ll turn product updates, company news, campaigns, cultural moments, and reactive opportunities into distinctive, channel-appropriate creative. Alongside this primary focus, you’ll design internal communications, employer-brand materials, and recruitment content for our People organization.

You’ll work within Solflare’s established brand identity, finding fresh ways to express it across a fast-moving social environment rather than redefining it. The role is best suited to someone who enjoys a steady creative rhythm, can balance planned work with quick-turnaround requests, and knows how to maintain craft and consistency at volume.

You’ll join the Brand & Creative team and collaborate most closely with Social Media and Marketing, followed by People & Culture and Recruitment. You’ll receive creative direction and support from senior members of the design team while taking independent ownership of assigned briefs from start to finish.

Core

responsibilities:

Social media design
• Create distinctive, high-quality static and lightweight animated content for Solflare’s social channels.
• Turn product updates, company news, campaigns, cultural moments, and reactive opportunities into clear and engaging social creative.
• Develop visual concepts for recurring content formats and larger social campaigns.
• Adapt ideas into channel-appropriate formats, sizes, and content variations without losing their impact.
• Work closely with the Social Media team to balance planned content with short-turnaround requests.
• Maintain a high level of craft and consistency while finding fresh ways to use the existing brand system across a steady volume of content.
• Build reusable templates and production systems that help the Social Media team move faster without making the work feel repetitive.

People and employer brand
• Design internal campaigns, announcements, presentations, event materials, and other employee communications.
• Create recruitment campaigns, job-ad visuals, onboarding materials, and employer-brand content for external channels.
• Help People & Culture turn complex or sensitive information into communication that is clear, engaging, and aligned with the Solflare brand.
• Support initiatives related to culture, learning, recognition, wellbeing, performance, and company events.
• Build reusable templates that enable People & Culture teams to handle recurring communication efficiently and consistently.

Brand systems and production
• Apply Solflare’s visual identity consistently across internal and external communication.
• Create and maintain templates, libraries, components, and organized working files for recurring Social Media and People & Culture needs.
• Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital and occasional print use.
• Incorporate feedback efficiently and communicate clearly about scope, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.
• Identify repetitive work and propose practical improvements to templates and production workflows.
• Collaborate with senior designers when a brief requires a new creative direction or an extension of the existing identity.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager - Non-Financial Risks
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic individual to join our team as the Senior Risk Manager for Latam & MEA as an individual contributor. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the risk function across the region, overseeing risk identification, assessment, and mitigation efforts to safeguard the stability and integrity of the organisation's operations in the region. 

This role requires a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of regional market dynamics, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Your mission

As the regional risk manager you will be responsible for:
• Be a critical member of the Latam & MEA Risk team in developing and executing a global risk management strategy tailored to the region.
• Ensure consistent application of risk management methodologies, policies and procedures across all operations.
• Conduct risk self assessments for the business in entities, as per risk management principles, supporting remediation and closure;
• Work closely with product teams to value add on risk insights into product changes, new product and market launch, open issues and horizon risks relevant to the region.
• Monitor and analyse regional market trends, product risks, incidents, regulatory developments, and emerging risk factors to assess their impact on the organisation's risk profile and recommend appropriate risk mitigation strategies.
• Oversee the implementation of risk management tools and systems, leveraging technology and data analytics to enhance risk monitoring, reporting, and decision-making processes.
• Work collaboratively with business units and functions to design and implement effective risk mitigation strategies, controls and action plans. Monitor the effectiveness of controls and recommend enhancements as necessary.
• Provide timely and accurate risk reports and updates to senior management and the board of directors, highlighting key risk exposures, trends, and emerging risks in the region.

jobs.title: Global Business Complaints Lead
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced lead of business customers that can drive exceptional customer service, while generating high quality and actionable insights to key stakeholders, to create lasting and positive changes. 

At Wise, we're on a mission to make money move as easily as information — fair, transparent, and fast. As our Business Complaints Team Lead for Brazil, you'll be central to that mission: ensuring our business customers in Brazil receive fair, high-quality outcomes when things go wrong, and leading a team that sets the standard for what great complaints handling looks like.

You'll build and lead a growing team of Business Complaints Officers in São Paulo, coaching them to deliver excellent outcomes, managing day-to-day performance, and driving continuous improvement through data and root cause thinking. More than a people manager, you'll be an advocate for customers, a bridge to cross-functional teams, and a critical voice in shaping how Wise handles complaints in Brazil.

If you're passionate about people development, customer fairness, and making a real difference in a fast-moving fintech, this is the role for you.

 

Roles & Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management
• Lead and develop a team of Business Complaints Officers in São Paulo, managing daily operations and maintaining a high-quality, high-care culture
• Coach officers on complaint writing quality, regulatory obligations, and fair customer outcomes
• Monitor team KPIs and SLA performance, addressing underperformance proactively and recognising strong work
• Act as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases

 

Customer Focus & Quality
• Ensure every complaint is resolved fairly and in line with Brazilian regulatory requirements, including Ouvidoria and BACEN obligations
• Review and quality-check case outputs, delivering structured feedback and coaching
• Champion the customer internally — use complaint insights to advocate for product and process improvements across the business

 

Analytical Thinking & Reporting
• Identify trends in complaint data and translate them into actionable insights for the team and senior stakeholders
• Contribute to MBR-level reporting on Brazil complaint volumes, SLA performance, and root causes

Stakeholder Collaboration

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Team Lead - Sanctions
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Sanctions Team Lead to help guide and scale our established Sanctions Screening team in São Paulo, Brazil.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of our Brazil operations, mentor a growing team of specialists, and directly impact Wise’s compliance mission. If you are a natural leader who thrives on navigating complex regulatory changes, developing talent, and optimizing investigative workflows, this role is for you.

Your mission: 

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking.

We’re looking for a Sanctions Team Lead to join our newly established Sanctions team.

The main purpose of the team is to screen Wise customers against sanctioned entities and carry out complex investigations on the alerts.

Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Sanctions Screening team:
• Hire, lead, develop and manage a Sanctions team, including amongst others administrative tasks such as scheduling, interviewing, organising team activities etc.
• Measure team's KPIs, plan capacity and maintain focus on customer experience; as well as taking ownership of various projects
• Develop effective operational processes, task allocation, training and performance management to deliver a great customer experience with a tightly managed cost base
• Collaborate with Wise’s Quality team to maintain a high quality of sanctions checks that were performed by the team
• Take decisions within our policy framework and working with compliance to evolve both our policies and processes
• Understand and manage training the team on our regulatory obligations, how our policies fulfil them and our risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime
• Able to represent the policies, processes and auditable screening work to regulators and auditors
• Work with third party management, outsourcing partners, product teams, customer support and across compliance to manage operational impact of changes and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, increase automation or improve operational efficiencies.

jobs.title: FinCrime Operations Senior Lead
jobs.description:
As a FinCrime Operations Senior Lead - LatAm, you will be responsible for developing and managing a team of Financial Crime Operations Team Leads and Specialists for specific SME areas. Your key objective is to ensure the effective assessment and mitigation of risks related to high-risk customers, while strictly adhering to AML/CFT regulations and aligning with Wise’s risk appetite and internal policies. The specialists on your team will possess an in-depth understanding of the unique risks associated with complex business structures, varied customer types and activities, and country-specific challenges, as well as the strategies required to mitigate these risks effectively.

In this leadership role, you will act as a vital connector between your operational team, which includes team leads and specialists, and Wise's senior leadership. This involves clearly communicating the overarching strategic objectives to your team and transforming these goals into actionable and pertinent directives that drive process optimization and performance improvement.

You'll be instrumental in aligning Wise’s overall mission and strategy with performance expectations, ensuring that your team’s efforts are efficiently strategized and executed for optimal success. This includes developing and owning a strategic roadmap spanning several quarters your team, enhancing processes, and cultivating a positive and empowering work environment. You will support your team’s growth and independence through comprehensive training, mentoring, coaching, delegation, and recognition.

As an experienced operations manager, you will design and implement customer-focused processes while maintaining a vigilant awareness of the risks inherent in the financial industry, specific product offerings, and regulatory requirements. Your approach will ensure that Wise's operations continually meet the expectations of our partners and regulatory bodies.

Job Responsibilities
• Leadership and people development: Drive team performance and cultural excellence to support sustainable business growth. Lead by example, demonstrating values and work ethic that inspire accountability, proactive problem-solving, and a growth mindset. Manage and develop a high-performing team by role modeling success behaviors. Focus on cultivating a high-performance culture through talent development, career check-ins, and recommendations for growth. Build strong teams by hiring, coaching, and fostering skills and competencies. Promote continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and inclusion to empower your team to innovate and excel.
• Performance management: Foster a culture of excellence in your team by consistently meeting KPIs and SLAs in our metrics-driven environment. Refresh performance expectations to match business needs and address underperformance with clear action plans. Implement strong performance frameworks, provide actionable feedback, and ensure every team member operates efficiently.
• Operational management: In this role, you'll turn high-level plans into actionable changes and lead your team to success. You'll create phased implementation plans to minimize disruption and set clear metrics to track progress. Focus on optimizing team structure by managing recruitment and strategically placing staff. Continuously identify and address redundancies and inefficiencies. You'll develop scalable, compliant processes and collaborate with product and operational teams to enhance customer experience, boost automation, and meet financial and service goals. Strong data literacy is essential for analyzing complex data and making informed decisions. Governance is crucial; you'll escalate issues promptly, provide clear updates to senior leadership, and contribute to a customer-focused culture that balances regulatory objectives with excellent customer service.
• Quality assurance: Ensure the highest quality standards for your group's tasks by making decisions within established frameworks. Lead root cause analysis, turn insights into improvements, and mitigate risks. Ensure quality standards are integrated into processes, tools, and initiatives. Understand impacts, focus on findings, and propose actions for better outcomes. Collaborate with other functions, offering expertise to enhance processes and elevate quality across the team and organization
• Domain knowledge and expertise: Be a subject matter expert in Financial Crime areas with the ability to train and coach your team. Maintain a comprehensive understanding of our regulatory obligations and internal policies. Apply a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Be able to represent the operational team processes and policies when working with internal auditing and testing parties. Retain an understanding of the wider Financial Crime and regulatory landscape and take on best practices to your team. Own operational incident management: from initial detection to response and remediation. Liaise effectively with functions and stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication throughout. Be responsible for developing action plans, driving remediation efforts, and providing context and subject matter expertise during and after incidents. The Senior Lead supports product-related incident management, ensuring a response to all critical events.
• Project management: Effectively Lead projects from start to finish, prioritizing tasks and maintaining documentation. Communicate milestones, address blockers, and delegate tasks while monitoring progress. Articulate project impact and value, and engage with stakeholders from technical teams to senior management. Negotiate and influence cross-functional teams to drive momentum and align with strategic goals.
• Planning and execution: Ensure operational area plans are set in place and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering, updating and making sure your area is making progress on their goals by measuring the effectiveness of the output of the team. There is a clear strategy within your domain that is connected with the wider organisational key objectives, including impactful OKRs and goals based on these plans, and being able to confidently present plans to varied audiences.
• Stakeholder management and communication: Lead complex projects with multiple stakeholders, setting priorities and ensuring timely delivery. Partner with Product to support group objectives and advocate for customer success. Manage diverse relationships, anticipate issues, and share key insights. Engage stakeholders promptly and lead discussions effectively. Communicate clearly and tailor messages to the audience, using data to deliver impactful and concise messages. Adapt to diverse stakeholders with confidence, ensuring professional and effective interactions.

jobs.title: Regional Head of AML Investigations
jobs.description:
The Regional Lead of AML Investigations is a leadership role responsible for the strategic direction and operational excellence of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) investigations. Beyond functional oversight, this role serves as a critical strategic partner to regional executives responsible for operations and service delivery.

The role is responsible for driving focused results that meet the rigorous expectations of the Regional Business/Operations Leads, defining the regional investigative strategy and governing the standards that ensure sustainable growth. By bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements and operational efficiency, the appointed Regional Lead of AML Investigations provides the leadership team with the transparency and execution certainty needed to deliver exceptional service to Wise customers while maintaining the highest standards of financial integrity.

 

Job

Responsibilities:
• Executive Partnership & Reporting: Act as a trusted advisor to the Regional Product teams, Regional Compliance officers and Business Operations, providing data-driven insights into regional risk profiles, investigative performance, and emerging threats.
• Strategic Oversight & Risk Mitigation: Lead a multi-layered AML organization function of approximately 170 people. Drive high-performance through leadership of 3 Senior Team Leads (direct reports) and 13 Team Leads, ensuring workflows are optimized for both high-volume efficiency and deep-dive quality. jobs.title: Solutions Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Solutions Engineering Lead to join our growing Wise Platform team in London. The Wise Platform team works with top tier global financial institutions and major tech companies to offer Wise products and services directly to their customers. 

Through our API, we help partners to architect and build integrations to our world class-leading international finance products, which in turn improves Wise Platform by increasing the capabilities of our public API.

This role will facilitate growth, troubleshoot and enhance the product offerings of Wise.

What will you be working on?

As part of the Wise Platform team, you’ll play a key role in providing technical consulting and product guidance to top tier banks and other partners integrating Wise into their products, primarily in a post-sale capacity. 

Solutions Engineering at Wise is a post sales role, focussed on working with our integrating partners to enable them to successfully launch a product based on Wise’s services. The role is multifaceted but includes providing technical consulting to partners, designing novel solutions to solve for their constraints and working internally to influence the product roadmap.

Wise is growing the Solutions Engineering function globally and we are looking for a lead to continue building the team in EMEA and to support new and existing Wisers to achieve their potential. You would work across partners, your own team, Wise Platform and the wider organisation to maximise your team’s impact.

Your role in the team:
• You’ll be responsible for the overall health and productivity of your team. Defining strong, clear goals that align with Wise Platform’s objectives and supporting the team in achieving them.
• You’ll provide feedback on your team’s approach and help them make data-driven decisions.
• You’ll have an overview of what’s happening across the organisation and think about how things impact partners, in terms of opportunities and risks.
• When needed, you’ll roll your sleeves up to be involved in the project delivery process.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist - Marketing
jobs.description:
Your mission:

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Onboarding & KYC
jobs.description:
Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.

jobs.title: Lead Growth Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a technically strong Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. This is a high-impact role for someone who can take ownership of new marketing initiatives from exploration through to execution, partnering closely with senior stakeholders across Regional Marketing and Regional Product teams.

You will proactively run deep-dive analysis, connect insights to business priorities, and turn findings into clear recommendations and scalable analytical solutions. This role is ideal for someone with strong SQL and Python skills, experience in growth or marketing analytics, and an interest in using AI and automation to improve analytical workflows.

Your Mission

You will own analytical workstreams end to end, from defining the business question and exploring the data through to communicating recommendations and supporting execution.

• Drive end-to-end analytics for new marketing and growth initiatives, from exploration to execution and measurement.

• Act as a trusted analytical partner to senior stakeholders (Regional Marketing Directors, Product Leads) across Regional Marketing and Regional Product teams.

• Track record of helping stakeholders turn insights into business actions and measurable outcomes.

"We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every single requirement. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every point, we’d still love to hear from you."

jobs.title: Lead, Payment Operations Strategy & Automation
jobs.description:
We're hiring someone to lead the operational side of how Wise handles payments that don't complete cleanly and to help redesign that operation for a world where AI agents do most of the work.

Why this role exists

Wise moves money across borders for millions of customers globally. Most payments go through cleanly. Some don't — they get delayed, returned, misrouted, or need a human to step in. Those payments are handled by the Payment Operations function.

Wise is on a long-term growth trajectory, and operational handling needs to scale in a way that doesn't just track volume linearly. So we've made a deliberate bet: over the next three years, we're rebuilding Payment Operations into a hybrid human + AI operating model — where AI agents execute the majority of frontline work, and humans move from handlers to designers, monitors, and escalators of agent-driven systems.

That's the shift you'd lead.

The role

You'd own Central Payment Operations at the function level: a team of Product Specialists and Technical Leads embedded alongside our Payment Defects & Incidents product-engineering squad. Together, you and the product-engineering squad share one roadmap, one vision, and one mission.

Concretely, you'd:
• Own the outcome. Move our core operational metrics — cost, first-resolution rate, defect rate, operational loss — at scale.
• Co-shape the roadmap with the Product Manager and Engineering Lead. You're the operations voice in every strategy conversation, and the technical/product voice back into operations.
• Design the AI transition. Ship AI-assisted workflows in production. Define and build the evaluation and observability foundations. Prove the design patterns that scale.
• Build the leadership bench. Grow the senior individual contributors and Technical Leads reporting to you into future leaders.
• Represent the function in Risk, Compliance, Analytics, Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Internal Audit, and PayOps leadership forums.

This role reports to the Head of Central Payment Operations.

What the first 6 months look like
• Month 1–2: Land. Meet the team, product-engineering partners, and cross-functional stakeholders. Understand the current operational landscape and the shape of the biggest cost drivers.
• Month 2–4: Co-shape the next roadmap cycle. Ship the first AI-assisted workflow in production. Stand up the eval framework.
• Month 4–6: Deliver measurable improvement against the operating-model targets. Establish the operating rhythm for how the team and its product-engineering partners work together.

What we can offer
• A real mandate. This isn't a role where you inherit a system and maintain it. You'll shape how Wise handles payment operations at scale for the next chapter of the company.
• A team that already partners deeply with product and engineering. You don't have to build that from scratch.
• A leader who's done the job. You get a manager who understands the terrain, not someone who'll ask you to explain it.
• Real career pathways. PayOps leadership, business operations across servicing, product/analytics, or leading agentic-ops functions.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Logic & Product Innovation
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

 

About the Role

 

We are looking for a seasoned financial engineering and product innovation leader to build and lead our Financial Logic Product Innovation (FL) team within DBU. This role sits at the intersection of quantitative finance, derivatives product design, and crypto-native innovation. You will own the financial models that power our trading platform and drive the creation of next-generation financial products.

 

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Financial Logic Ownership
• Own and optimize core financial formulas across the platform: funding rates, index prices, mark prices, liquidation engines, margin models (UTA/cross-margin), insurance fund mechanics, and settlement logic
• Identify and resolve edge cases, parameter inefficiencies, and risk-reward imbalances in existing financial models
• Collaborate with Risk to support risk index development and financial logic optimization projects

 

Product Innovation
• Independently research and propose new financial products (derivatives, structured products, hybrid instruments) beyond the current roadmap
• Conduct competitive analysis, market microstructure research, and user behavior analysis to identify product opportunities
• Translate product concepts into rigorous financial specifications ready for engineering implementation

 

Team Leadership
• Build, mentor, and manage a team of financial engineers and product researchers (currently 4, growing)
• Set clear goals, delivery timelines, and quality standards for the team
• Foster a culture of self-driven research, intellectual curiosity, and data-informed decision making

 

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Trading Products to translate market needs into financial models
• Provide BTE (exchange engineering) with precise formula specs, test cases, and validation criteria
• Partner with Trading Ops on real-time parameter tuning and anomaly investigation

 

 

Requirements

 

Must-have:
• 8+ years in quantitative finance, financial engineering, derivatives product design, or related fields
• Deep understanding of derivatives pricing, risk models, margin systems, and market microstructure
• Solid experience in both crypto exchanges and traditional financial exchanges (TradFi)
• Proven track record of designing and shipping financial products
• Strong intrinsic motivation to create and launch innovative financial products that don't yet exist in the market
• Strong mathematical and analytical skills; comfortable with stochastic calculus, numerical methods, and statistical modeling
• Experience leading and growing a technical team (4+ direct reports)
• Ability to independently produce research and proposals — not just execute on a given roadmap
• Excellent communication skills; able to distill complex financial concepts for cross-functional stakeholders

 

Nice-to-have:
• Bilingual (English + Mandarin) — team operates across English and Chinese-speaking contexts
• Programming proficiency (Python, SQL, or similar) for data analysis, backtesting, and prototyping financial models
• Hands-on trading experience (personal or professional)
• Familiarity with exchange systems: order matching, liquidation, funding mechanisms
• Background in quant trading, market making, or derivatives structuring at a top-tier firm
• Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related quantitative field

 

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.description:
About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Lifecycle CRM Marketing team and shape how Chime engages, retains, and grows members throughout their lifecycle. You’ll own the strategy behind complex, high-impact programs across email, push, in-app, and SMS, connecting member experiences to outcomes such as primacy, retention, product attach, ARPAM, and LTV. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence, lead through ambiguity, and know when to escalate while influencing decisions across Product, Growth, Product Marketing, Creative, Data Science, and Analytics. You’ll also help the Lifecycle team develop stronger ways of working and contribute to lifecycle innovation through data, AI, automation, and personalized cross-channel journeys.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $150,000 and up to $208,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to
• Own the lifecycle strategy for a complex, high-impact area of the business, setting a clear direction tied to member and business outcomes.
• Design and evolve connected member journeys across email, push, in-app, and SMS as member behavior, business priorities, and available data change.
• Develop segmentation and targeting strategies with Data Science to deliver more personalized, behavior-based programs.
• Set the testing agenda, identify the most valuable questions to answer, run rigorous experiments, and translate findings into strategy.
• Lead cross-functional decisions with Product, Growth, Product Marketing, Creative, Data Science, and Analytics, influencing lifecycle processes and capabilities beyond your immediate work.
• Use AI tools and automation as a core part of how you work, helping the team move toward more automated and personalized member journeys.
• Own the outcomes for your area, connecting lifecycle work to primacy, retention, product attach, ARPAM, and LTV while raising the quality of strategy and execution around you.

To thrive in this role, you have
• 6–8+ years of experience in lifecycle, integrated, or retention marketing, including leading complex, cross-functional programs that delivered measurable results.
• Strong data fluency and experience using analytics and AI-enabled tools such as Hex, Looker, or Statsig to answer questions, develop strategy, and recognize when further investigation is needed.
• Experience incorporating AI and automation into your day-to-day work, along with a clear point of view on how lifecycle marketing is evolving.
• Strong strategic judgment across member journeys, segmentation, targeting, channel orchestration, and testing.
• The ability to lead cross-functional conversations, influence senior partners, navigate ambiguity, operate independently, and recognize when escalation is appropriate.
• Deep member obsession and the judgment to balance member experience with business needs in high-stakes decisions.
• It’s a plus if you have hands-on experience with a CRM or marketing automation platform such as Braze, Iterable, or Klaviyo; have owned a lifecycle domain such as activation, retention, or monetization end to end; or have designed automation- or agent-driven journeys.

jobs.title: Regional Security Lead (North East)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Job Purpose

The Regional Security Lead ensures that our mission never stops. You are the guardian of our physical spaces, ensuring that every Moniepoint office is a sanctuary where our team can build and create without worry.

By leading regional security operations, managing on-ground teams, and proactively identifying risks, you provide the stability and safety that allows financial happiness to thrive. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them.

Key Responsibilities
• Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region.
• Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk.
• Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect.
• Build Strong Alliances: Act as our primary liaison with law enforcement and emergency services, ensuring we always have a seat at the table during emergencies.
• Investigate and Solve: Lead the response to security breaches and accidents, providing clear, factual reports that help us learn and improve.
• Empower the Team: Design and deliver training programs that equip our security personnel and employees with life-saving protocols.
• Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient.
• Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery.

Qualifications
• Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary.
• Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
• Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO.
• Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential.
• Language Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community.
• Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc.

About You
• You are a Hero: You are driven by mastery and the desire to protect others. People count on you to come through when things get tough.
• You are Relatable: You don’t hide behind technical jargon. You communicate clearly and build trust with everyone, from the security guards to the executive team.
• You are Proactive: You don’t wait for things to go wrong. You have the "Creator" spirit, always looking for better ways to secure our future.
• You are composed: In high-pressure situations, you are the calmest person in the room. You lead with facts, not emotions.

What Success Looks Like
• Zero Preventable Incidents: Our regional offices remain safe, secure, and fully operational.
• High Readiness: Security personnel are well-trained and respond to drills or real-world events with 100% precision.
• Strong Community Ties: You have built a network of local stakeholders that helps Moniepoint navigate regional risks effectively.
• Operational Excellence: Security technology is 100% functional, and documentation is factual, honest, and actionable.

What we can offer you
• Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard, and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
• Learning: We have a learning- and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
• Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
• An interview with the hiring team.
• An interview with a member of our executive team.

Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Director, Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Accounting at Brex

The Accounting team at Brex ensures we produce accurate and timely financial results to stakeholders to guide the business forward. We go beyond closing the books — we automate, iterate, and improve processes in close collaboration with partners across the business. The team also serves as power users and thought leaders for Brex's own products. We bring precision and curiosity to everything we build, combining deep ownership with a product mindset to help shape the future of finance.

What you’ll do

You will be the principal architect of Brex’s financial reporting and technical accounting framework, ensuring the highest level of compliance with GAAP while navigating the complexities of a fast-growing fintech environment. You will be responsible for building a world-class reporting function that meets the rigor of a public company and aligns with the global accounting policies of Capital One. You will also be a key advisor on accounting implications of product launches and other complex transactions. You will work cross-functionally within a detail-oriented environment where creative problem solving is highly valued. The Financial Reporting Director is expected to manage multiple priorities concurrently without compromising quality, accuracy or completeness.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Oversee the end-to-end global financial reporting function, ensuring the integrity of consolidated and entity-only US GAAP financial statements for internal and external stakeholders
• Lead the strategy for regulated entity reporting, ensuring 100% compliance with evolving regulations
• Act as the subject matter expert, evaluate complex, non-routine transactions and provide technical accounting guidance and disclosure recommendations
• Iterate and develop GAAP accounting policies and support high-impact business initiatives such as post-merger integration and product launches
• Establish and maintain a robust library of corporate accounting policies; lead the implementation of new FASB/ SEC standards
• Lead the design and maturation of an internal control environment in preparation for integration with Capital One’s financial reporting standards and SOX requirements
• Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal and other teams to provide proactive accounting for new product launches and business model changes
• Ensure timely close through the preparation and review of journal entries, reconciliations and variance analytics, as well as coordination with FP A
• Identify and deliver process improvements via automation, AI initiatives and cross functional collaboration

Requirements
• BA/BS degree, preferably in Business, Finance, or Accounting
• CPA license
• 10+ years of experience, including significant time at a Big 4 accounting firm and/or leadership role in high-growth companies
• Strong technical accounting and financial reporting knowledge in US GAAP
• Deep understanding of financial services, credit card processing or payment-related accounting
• Ability to translate complex accounting jargon into actionable insights for non-finance counterparts
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and address difficult situations in a professional manner
• Innovative and able to provide “outside of the box” solutions
• Passion for having an owner’s mentality towards responsibilities and for career growth
• Experience implementing and improving business processes and systems
• Knowledge and experience using DFIN, Workiva or similar financial reporting platforms

Bonus Points
• Experience operating within a public company environment
• Advanced proficiency in data analytics and a product mindset toward accounting systems
• Direct experience applying AI to streamline the financial reporting or research process

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $252,216 - $315,270. However, the starting base pay will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

• 1+ years SDR management experience with a consistent record of quota attainment

• Strong expertise in outbound sales, primarily through email, phone, and social selling

• You are an expert at partnering with marketing and your AE counterparts to plan and execute multi-touch, multi-channel campaigns
• Expert at using LinkedIn, Outreach, SalesNav, ZoomInfo, SFDC

jobs.title: Lead Backend Development Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Overview

We are looking for a skilled Java Developer with strong mastery of core backend systems. In this role, you will drive the evolution of our core distributed transaction engine and high-concurrency Instant Messaging (IM) platform.

Beyond deepening core business applications, you will act as a key technical backbone for strategic AI Shopping Assistant projects, exploring the integration of the Java ecosystem with Large Language Models (LLMs) to drive intelligent business transformation.

Key Responsibilities
• Core Java Development: Design and build high-concurrency order processing centers, payment settlement logic, and IM messaging engines; write high-quality, clean, and maintainable Java code.
• Architecture Optimization Evolution: Refactor technical debt, optimize JVM performance, database indexing, and caching strategies; resolve data consistency challenges in distributed environments.
• AI Implementation: Participate in the architectural design of AI shopping guide/assistant projects, leveraging Spring AI or related frameworks to integrate LLM capabilities for smart recommendations, automated customer support, and other business scenarios.
• System Stability: Lead core pipeline monitoring and troubleshooting to maintain high system availability during traffic spikes and promotional mega-sales.

Requirements
• Technical Background: 3–5 years of Java development experience with solid CS fundamentals; deep understanding of JVM memory models, GC mechanisms, and multi-threading/concurrency programming.
• Framework Proficiency: Proficient in Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, MyBatis, and related mainstream frameworks, with a clear understanding of their core principles and extension points.
• Domain Experience (At least one required):
• Transaction Systems: Familiar with distributed transactions and state machine design; hands-on experience with complex, financial-grade order or settlement systems.
• Messaging Communication: Proficient in Netty network programming with a deep understanding of WebSocket/MQTT protocols; experience in handling push systems with millions of concurrent connections.
• Middleware Storage: Proficient in using message queues (RocketMQ/Kafka) for asynchronous decoupling; rich experience in MySQL performance tuning and Redis distributed locks.

Preferred Qualifications
• Work Visa Status: Holders of Hong Kong Top Talent Pass Scheme (TTPS) or Quality Migrant Admission Scheme (QMAS) visas—or those eligible to apply—are highly preferred.
• AI Vision: Attentive to AI industry developments; hands-on experience with LangChain, Vector Databases (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone), or RAG architecture is a strong plus.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.description:
Nossa área de Enterprise Architect 

Área responsável por definir e evoluir a arquitetura tecnológica, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e eficiência das plataformas, alinhadas à estratégia do negócio. Atua na condução de estudos técnicos (build vs. buy), avaliação de novas tecnologias e acompanhamento de tendências e regulações. Possui forte foco em governança, incluindo mapeamento e redução de débitos técnicos, gestão de riscos e definição de padrões arquiteturais. Trabalha de forma transversal com engenharia e fornecedores, promovendo boas práticas e melhoria contínua. 

Suas atividades como CSixer
• Definir e manter a estratégia tecnológica de médio e longo prazo da plataforma de Cartões, garantindo aderência aos objetivos de negócio
• Conduzir estudos de viabilidade e direcionamento estratégico de build or buy para novas capacidades
• Acompanhar evoluções tecnológicas e regulatórias do mercado de cartões, antecipando impactos e oportunidades
• Direcionar fornecedores para adequações tecnológicas necessárias ao crescimento e sustentação da plataforma
• Propor melhorias de escalabilidade, disponibilidade e redução de custos operacionais
• Mapear e priorizar débitos técnicos, acompanhando sua evolução e planos de remediação
• Aplicar princípios de arquitetura (design patterns, padronização, documentação) nas plataformas de cartões
• Avaliar riscos sobre as plataformas, propondo estratégias de amortização e redução de impactos
• Participar de PoCs e RFPs de avaliações tecnológicas
• Conduzir fóruns técnicos (Arch Cycles) com os Arquitetos de Soluções para endereçar as estratégias dos produtos
• Participar ativamente dos Fóruns Mensais de Arquitetura e organizar pautas relevantes
• Participar e contribuir nos fóruns de Incident Reviews e Design Reviews
• Organizar e apoiar temas que serão levados para o Design Review
• Atuar como guardião dos princípios de arquitetura, assegurando disseminação em todas as estruturas
• Trabalhar em conjunto com os demais arquitetos para definição e uso de melhores práticas padronizadas
• Identificar déficits de conhecimento e direcionar ações (hands-on, processos, treinamentos) junto aos times envolvidos

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de profissionais com menor senioridade no time de arquitetura

Requisitos e Experiência
• Conhecimentos sólidos em sistemas distribuídos, algoritmos, infraestrutura e pensamento orientado à resolução de problemas
• Experiência com plataformas de processamento de cartões (emissão, adquirência, bandeiras, tokenização, etc.)
• Capacidade de síntese, facilitação e entendimento junto aos times para diagnóstico preciso de problemas
• Conhecimento em métodos ágeis para organização e acompanhamento de atividades
• TOGAF, COBIT, ITIL, ISOs aplicáveis ao segmento financeiro
• Experiência com frameworks de arquitetura corporativa

Nossa área de Technology Platform Engineering

A área de Technology Platform Engineering é responsável por construir e evoluir as plataformas, produtos internos e capacidades compartilhadas que aceleram o desenvolvimento de software em toda a organização. Atuamos de forma transversal junto aos times de Engineering, Developer Experience, SRE Experience, Cloud Engineering, FinOps, Segurança e Arquitetura, criando soluções escaláveis, seguras e padronizadas que habilitam a entrega de produtos com qualidade e velocidade. Estamos expandindo nossa atuação para o universo de Inteligência Artificial, estruturando as capacidades, padrões e plataformas que permitirão a adoção segura, eficiente e escalável de IA por toda a engenharia do banco.

Suas atividades como CSixer
• Ser referência técnica na construção da estratégia e da plataforma de IA para Engenharia, apoiando a definição da visão, arquitetura de referência, padrões e melhores práticas.
• Desenvolver componentes e produtos internos que acelerem a adoção de IA pelos times de engenharia, como SDKs, frameworks, agentes, aceleradores, templates, bibliotecas e plataformas self-service.
• Projetar e implementar integrações com modelos fundacionais, serviços de IA generativa e plataformas de agentes, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e governança.
• Atuar de forma hands-on no desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando linguagens modernas e práticas avançadas de engenharia de software.
• Definir padrões para desenvolvimento de aplicações baseadas em IA, incluindo observabilidade, avaliação de modelos, governança, segurança e gestão de custos.
• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Developer Experience, SRE Experience, Segurança, Arquitetura e FinOps para criar uma experiência integrada para consumo de serviços de IA.
• Liderar estudos, provas de conceito e iniciativas de inovação envolvendo IA Generativa, agentes autônomos, RAG, copilots e workflows inteligentes.
• Definir mecanismos de governança, uso responsável e conformidade para aplicações que utilizam IA.
• Mentorar engenheiros, disseminar conhecimento técnico e influenciar decisões arquiteturais em escala organizacional.
• Acompanhar tendências de mercado, evolução das plataformas cloud e novas abordagens de AI Engineering, avaliando sua aplicabilidade dentro do contexto da organização.

• Experiência com serviços de IA na nuvem, especialmente Amazon Bedrock e ecossistemas relacionados.
• Conhecimento de práticas de Platform Engineering, DevOps e Infraestrutura como Código.
• Conhecimentos em segurança aplicada à IA, incluindo proteção de dados sensíveis, governança, auditoria, rastreabilidade e mitigação de riscos.
• Inglês avançado para leitura, comunicação técnica e acompanhamento de documentação e referências globais.
• Diferenciais: Experiência na construção de plataformas internas para consumo de IA em larga escala.

jobs.description:
About the role

Chime is seeking an experienced Creative Director to develop brand-defining campaigns. This role will be responsible for shaping the creative vision, crafting captivating narratives, and executing innovative marketing strategies across various channels, including TV, social activations, brand partnerships, and more. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in creative agency work, a proven track record of delivering impactful campaigns, and the ability to lead a talented team of art directors, designers, and copywriters.

This individual should be comfortable pitching bold, top-of-funnel brand campaigns while also understanding the importance and role of the full marketing funnel. They should be able to develop creative ideas that build awareness, drive consideration, and support conversion, ensuring campaigns are not only culturally resonant and brand-defining, but also strategically connected to business objectives across every stage of the customer journey.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $201,000.00 and up to $279,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to
• Create a vision for the Chime brand that translates into powerful and authentic storytelling that drives awareness/consideration
• Develop and execute a creative vision for what our brand looks and feels like through integrated marketing campaigns, TV, activations, social campaigns, and partnerships across all channels.
• Champion bold ideas and creative approaches to telling Chime’s stories and more deeply connecting with Chime’s members
• Oversee the end-to-end creative process, from concept development to final execution, ensuring alignment with the company's brand values and marketing objectives.
• Collaborate with marketing leads to create integrated campaigns that resonate with target audiences.
• Provide strategic direction and leadership to a team of art directors, designers and copywriters, fostering an environment of creativity, innovation, and collaboration.
• Lead creative brainstorming sessions, providing clear guidance, feedback, and inspiration to generate impactful ideas.
• Manage relationships with external creative agencies, production houses, and media partners to ensure high-quality execution of campaigns.
• Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to ensure our creative work is fresh and relevant.
• Maintain a strong understanding of our consumer base, market trends, and competitor landscape to inform creative strategies.
• Inspire commitment, loyalty, pride, and spirit in the organization, to support Chime as a great place to work

To thrive in this role, you have
• A deep passion for building brands with a results-oriented mindset
• 8+ years in creative leadership, with at least 5 years in a leadership position building brand-level work
• Deep understanding of advanced AI tools to support the creative process.
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Design, Copywriting or a related field.
• Proven experience working in a creative agency environment, with a strong portfolio of consumer-facing campaigns, including TV spots, digital, and partnership initiatives.
• Demonstrated ability to develop creative concepts that drive engagement and brand loyalty.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and lead a small creative team.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate creative ideas and concepts to stakeholders.
• Experience managing cross-functional teams and collaborating with external partners.

A little about us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress. 

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.

What we offer for our full-time, regular employees
• 🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
• 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
• ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
• 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
• 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
• 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
• 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
• 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
• 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
