jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to drive product strategy and product management across the Core Banking domain and to own the most complex, cross-functional core related initiatives. This is a senior individual-contributor role: you set direction, connect product strategy to the platform's technical strategy, and deliver measurable outcomes in partnership with engineering.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, sponsoring pre-consensus bets with a written thesis, setting operating rhythms for the Core PM group, and influencing VP/SVP stakeholders through documented trade-offs. You will be an authority on how a core banking system actually works — down to posting logic — and pair that with strong traditional product-management judgment across pricing, risk, product performance, compliance, legal, GTM, and partnerships.

What you’ll do
• With your PM colleagues, own and drive product strategy and roadmap across multiple Core domains (e.g., deposits, postings/ledger, product factory, transactions) and the end-to-end core product.
• The most complex cross-company initiatives — including core conversion enablement and US market-expansion capabilities.
• Connecting product strategy to org-level technical strategy; anchoring build vs. buy vs. partner.
• Product GTM with measurable outcomes and documented reviews, in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Ops, and client teams.
• Operating models and planning frameworks for the Core PM group; standards and playbooks other PMs build on.
• Regulatory posture and responsible-AI principles embedded into the Core product.

Product Strategy Roadmapping
• With your PM colleagues define and own multi-domain product strategy and the multi-quarter roadmap for Core Banking.
• Translate business, regulatory, and client needs into clear product outcomes; frame problems others haven't yet articulated.
• Conduct appropriate research and synthesize findings.
• Make informed trade-offs across speed, quality, scalability, and regulatory requirements.

Delivery Execution
• Partner with Engineering Managers on prioritization, sequencing, planning, and dependency management across teams and squads.
• Set operating rhythms and planning frameworks; remove cross-team hurdles and drive quality and velocity improvements.
• Maintain a coherent, prioritized product direction as priorities shift.

Stakeholder Client Collaboration
• Act as the senior product interface for business, operations, compliance, risk, legal, and technology stakeholders.
• Influence VP/SVP decisions through documented prioritization and signed trade-offs (timeline, risk, cost).
• Represent the Core product with external banking clients and internal SoFi Bank partners.

Technical Platform Leadership
• Apply posting-logic-level understanding of core banking (accounts, double-entry ledger, postings, interest, product catalog, batch vs. real-time).
• Challenge business architectural assumptions at the system and cross-org level; prevent unnecessary complexity and maintenance burden.
• Ensure the Core product meets the requirements of US-chartered banking entities.

What you’ll need
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant field
• Deep, hands-on understanding of the inner workings of a core banking system — ideally at the posting-logic / double-entry ledger level.
• A track record of building or product-managing a core banking product itself (a platform/vendor perspective) — as opposed to running core conversion or transformation programs inside a bank.
• Strong traditional product-management background across several of: pricing, risk, compliance, product performance, legal, communication, partnering, and go-to-market.
• A very good understanding of the US banking market and its regulatory environment.
• 10+ years of professional experience, with significant time in Product Management for complex, regulated technology platforms.
• Demonstrated ability to drive strategy across multiple product areas and lead the most complex cross-functional initiatives with a high degree of autonomy.
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to shape company-level product communication and executive-ready written theses.

Nice to have
• LatAm core banking exposure and/or Spanish-language proficiency.
• Experience with modern, API-first, cloud-native core platforms and microservices architectures.
• Familiarity with the competitive landscape (e.g., Thought Machine, 10x, Mambu, Finxact, FIS, Fiserv, Jack Henry, Temenos).
• Experience selling or supporting a core platform for external financial-institution clients as well as an in-house bank.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

We draw upon our experience as knowledgeable bankers, and best in class technologists to become the chosen option for these banks, and preferred partners for leading consultancies.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

This role is available to those within a commutable distance of our London, Manchester or Cardiff offices. You must be prepared to travel to our various sites when necessary. 

About the role

This role is for the Engine Legal Team and will report into the Senior Legal Counsel, Engine. The Engine Legal Team covers all legal aspects needed for a high growth company within a successful bank to succeed. You will have significant exposure to senior stakeholders across Engine. This role will have a strong focus on commercial contracts and related matters.

What you'll get to do:
• Drafting, negotiating and advising on client facing commercial contracts (e.g. NDAs, framework agreements, SaaS agreements, other software licences).
• Drafting, negotiating and advising on a full range of third party supplier and intragroup commercial agreements (e.g. marketing, IT, technology, outsourcing) to support the development of Engine.
• Helping to advise on data protection matters in terms of supplier arrangements, client agreements and intragroup data sharing.
• Advising on any issues and matters that may arise to successfully run a banking SaaS company.
• Supporting Senior Legal Counsel (and General Counsel) on international expansion aspects of Engine.
• Managing multiple projects (often to tight deadlines) and supporting colleagues to ensure business and enterprise-wide initiatives are executed in a timely and accurate manner.
• Updating and maintaining Engine’s legal precedent documents.
• Instructing and working with external counsel where necessary on specialist and international matters.
• You will be a UK qualified lawyer with around 3-5 years PQE (note PQE is a guide only), with banking SaaS and/or financial services regulatory (e.g. material outsourcing rules), and commercial contracts experience.
• Strong real life experience in drafting, advising and negotiating a range of different commercial contracts in a technology and financial services context (ideally both on a sell and buy side).
• Good real life experience in advising on data protection issues.
• You will need to have excellent technical knowledge, a solid understanding of contract law and principles and at the same time be commercially focused.
• You will be capable of working in a fast-paced environment, and be keen to grow and develop within the organisation.
• Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:
• 60 minutes with two people from the Legal team
• 45 minute interview, including a case study
• 45 minutes with members of the senior leadership team.
• 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Incentives refer a friend scheme
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Engine by Starling
jobs.description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology. 

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling, and two years ago we split out as a separate business. 

Starling has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

We draw upon our experience as knowledgeable bankers, and best in class technologists to become the chosen option for these banks, and preferred partners for leading consultancies.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

This role is available to those within a commutable distance of our London, Manchester or Cardiff offices. You must be prepared to travel to our various sites when necessary. 

About the role

This role is for the Engine Legal Team and will report into the Senior Legal Counsel, Engine. The Engine Legal Team covers all legal aspects needed for a high growth company within a successful bank to succeed. You will have significant exposure to senior stakeholders across Engine. This role will have a strong focus on commercial contracts and related matters.

What you'll get to do:
• Drafting, negotiating and advising on client facing commercial contracts (e.g. NDAs, framework agreements, SaaS agreements, other software licences).
• Drafting, negotiating and advising on a full range of third party supplier and intragroup commercial agreements (e.g. marketing, IT, technology, outsourcing) to support the development of Engine.

• Advising on any issues and matters that may arise to successfully run a banking SaaS company.

• Managing multiple projects (often to tight deadlines) and supporting colleagues to ensure business and enterprise-wide initiatives are executed in a timely and accurate manner.

• Instructing and working with external counsel where necessary on specialist and international matters.
• You will be a UK qualified lawyer with around 3-5 years PQE (note PQE is a guide only), with banking SaaS and/or financial services regulatory (e.g. material outsourcing rules), and commercial contracts experience.
• Strong real life experience in drafting, advising and negotiating a range of different commercial contracts in a technology and financial services context (ideally both on a sell and buy side).
• Good real life experience in advising on data protection issues.
• You will need to have excellent technical knowledge, a solid understanding of contract law and principles and at the same time be commercially focused.
• You will be capable of working in a fast-paced environment, and be keen to grow and develop within the organisation.
• Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.

jobs.title: CRM Manager - UK and Europe
jobs.description:
The CRM team is a diverse and inclusive crew of problem solvers from all over the world. We form long-term customer relationships through best-in-class communications - so more customers use Wise more often for their international money needs, stay with us longer, and advocate for us sooner. We place the customer at the heart of everything we do so they look forward to our communications because they’ll either be entertained, learn something new or find out about a useful product, service or promotion. 

The team is structured into a Global team centered around our four main customer actions—Send, Hold, Receive, Spend & Grow, and a Regional team split by our key markets in the UK, Europe, North America, Latin America & APAC. So you’ll join a team of CRM specialists identifying regional opportunities to drive product adoption and improve retention, ensuring our lifecycle and adhoc comms are relevant and drive real impact in the UK and Europe.

The Role

We're seeking a versatile CRM Manager in London to help us drive our global B2C lifecycle communications strategy and implementation for the UK & Europe markets. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape and execute innovative campaigns, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible impact on our customers' experience.
• Develop and manage our UK & Europe CRM strategy, including customer lifecycle management, segmentation and engagement initiatives
• Utilise data and insights to segment customers effectively and tailor communications for maximum relevance and impact
• Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Creative, Engineering & Analytics teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution across multiple channels (email, push notifications, in-product messages)
• Manage internal stakeholder communication and collaboration across various departments
• Design and implement effective customer lifecycle management strategies to drive long-term engagement and loyalty through continuous optimisation
• Analyse campaign performance and use data to identify and implement opportunities for increasing engagement and conversion rates at all stages of the customer’s lifecycle journey
• Ensure compliance with CRM best practices and regulatory requirements while maintaining database health and retention efforts.
• Implement the localisation process for Wise’s international campaigns
• Oversee email calendar management, deliverability, and monthly reporting.

Collaborating with regional teams, you will ensure seamless training delivery and maintain a comprehensive global learning calendar. Additionally, you will conduct learning needs analysis and provide data-driven insights for stakeholders. You will serve as a local point of contact for core products, ensuring data integrity and regular content updates. Your role will require strong project management, data interpretation, and stakeholder management skills, with an emphasis on strategic thinking and adaptability. You should be proactive, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with a strong ability to navigate change and apply data-driven insights for impactful learning solutions.

Responsibilities

Facilitation

Learning Partnering

jobs.title: WFM Operations Partner Senior Lead
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Workforce Management Operations Partner Senior Lead to join our Operational team in our Tallinn office!

The WFM Operations Partner Senior Lead is accountable for the WFM–Operations partnering model, ensuring Workforce Management disciplines are consistently embedded into operational decision-making across the business.

This role owns the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of WFM partnership with Operations, ensuring that intraday, scheduling, and capacity principles are applied correctly, escalations are handled with discipline, and short-term decisions do not undermine medium- and long-term workforce plans.

The role does not execute tactical WFM activities or own forecasting, scheduling, or intraday delivery. Instead, it leads the Ops Partner function, sets standards, manages people, and acts as the senior WFM representative in complex operational trade-offs.

Your mission is to institutionalise WFM decision-making inside Operations, moving the organisation from reactive firefighting to predictable, data-driven execution at scale.

Your Mission
• The WFM Operations Partner Lead is accountable for the people, standards, and decision quality of the WFM Operations Partner function. This includes direct line management of Ops Partner Leads and dotted-line functional leadership over Intraday and Scheduling Specialists.
• Act as the direct people manager for WFM Operations Partner Leads, with accountability for:
• hiring, onboarding, and role clarity
• performance management, GrowWise cycles, and calibration
• ongoing coaching, feedback, and development.
• Set and reinforce clear expectations for:
• decision quality
• stakeholder behaviour
• adherence to WFM principles and frameworks.
• Develop Ops Partner Leads from:
• metric interpretation
• structured decision support
• confident, evidence-based challenge of Operations leadership.
• Ensure consistent capability, judgement, and behavioural standards across the Ops Partner team through calibration and peer review.
• Act as the senior WFM representative to Operations Heads and senior Ops leaders.
• Own the quality and consistency of workforce decisions taken by Operations.
• Serve as the final escalation point for workforce-related decisions that materially impact service, cost, or workforce sustainability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Manager - KYC
jobs.description:
Our Product Compliance & Risk (“PC&R”) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams in delivering exceptional financial products for our customers while ensuring they’re compliant by design. 

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric and proactive individual to join the Wise Global FinCrime PC&R team, to work across our Product and Compliance teams to take our Global KYC program to the next level for consumers and businesses. This individual will work closely with our Global KYC product team to ensure our controls strike the right balance for our customers and our compliance requirements to onboard customers.

This role works side-by-side with our Product teams in order to:
• Focus on new products and features to ensure that scalable and compliant MVPs can be brought quickly to market.
• Remediate issues identified with existing products and features to ensure that they remain compliant and scalable.

Your mission:
• Ownership of PC&R’s support in the design, development and deployment of KYC controls for all of our global customers.
• Identify and drive enhancements that could improve our customer experience, unlock growth, and improve our operational processes
• Use data to define the effectiveness of controls and support the implementation of an ongoing testing program
• Work with and support our product teams to implement and prioritise control improvements to strengthen our program while finding ways to create efficiencies
• As improvements are identified in audits or by third parties define project plans and facilitate their implementation
• Perform periodic reviews to ensure our controls remain complaint- reviewing changing regulations and industry guidance
• Contribute to the mapping and assessment of controls as part of the annual financial crime risk assessment

A bit about you

We are looking for someone passionate about payments, fintech and compliance risk management and with an eye on the future. You should have:
• Minimum 7 years experience working within AML, with particular focus on KYC controls and advisory
• CAMS, ICA or equivalent certification desirable
• Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams to develop KYC and/or financial crime controls
• Experience in automation of financial crime controls
• Strong data analytics skills
• Clear communication, project coordination, and management skills.
• Wisdom, a world view and talent for thinking outside the box
• Professionalism and high integrity
• You understand the importance of providing clear rationales for teams and excel in doing so.
• You anticipate roadblocks, are resilient and not easily disheartened
• Willingness to challenge teams and themselves on how to best serve our customers, while keeping processes robust and compliant
• Willingness to travel as required

jobs.title: Analytics Director, APAC
jobs.description:
Salary Range: 230,000 - 318,000 SGD base per annum + RSUs

We’re looking for an Analytics Director for the APAC Squad who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders, to lead a high-impact analytics team that is central to building out the product roadmap for this major Region. This is a unique opportunity to drive decision making in a diverse, high-potential region!

You’ll report to the Global Senior Analytics Director for Regional Expansion, and partner daily with the Product, Banking and Engineering leads for the APAC squad. Together, you will form a cross-functional group of key decision makers who own the challenge of driving the product roadmap in this Region. You’ll also be part of the Analytics community within Wise, giving you access to a global network of analytics professionals.

You’ll lead a team of c.10 passionate product analysts and support them to partner across product teams to drive data-led decision making and ensure robust measurement of the impact of the work we do! You will also support them in identifying insights to inform our planning process - all to ensure that we are enhancing our customer’s experience across the diverse countries in the APAC region. 

If you’ve previously led or helped to build analytics teams in fast-paced, scaling, global companies - we’d love to hear from you. 

Problems you’ll solve

in this role:
• Support the APAC squad to address the most important challenges for the Region using data and insights, and building relevant KPIs to measure impact and hold ourselves accountable
• Develop, coach and support a talented analytics team, unblocking them to influence the strategic roadmap for the Region
• Refine the analytical vision and plan for APAC and contribute to the Regional Analytics strategy globally (we are solving similarly complex problems across all Regions)

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Be part of a positive change in the world. Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply. So we’re building a new one. Our mission is to make money without borders the new normal
• Have a significant impact by shaping the next phase of analytics in a fast-paced, scaling, global company
• Learn from a global network of professionals. We have a large, diverse team of analysts and data scientists that you will work with and learn from by being part of the Analytics community
• Use all your experience and skills to bring new thinking and ideas to how we build an outstanding analytics function

jobs.title: Northam Enterprise & Ops Risk Senior Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Risk Manager to drive the implementation and day-to-day management of our risk management framework for the Wise US Broker Dealer franchise, with a particular focus on Operational risk management. This role will provide guidance on risk and control assessments, risk appetite, KRIs, audit and self identified issues, incident management, control monitoring and remediation, and new product initiatives. 

We need to make sure we're identifying the right risks and design effective scalable controls, including a comprehensive control monitoring program. 

What will you be doing?
• Supporting the implementation and operation of our enterprise risk framework, with a particular focus on Operational risks, including embedding of the risk and control self assessment process, and issues management.
• Define the key risks inherent in end to end business processes, and coordinate the mapping and documentation of controls.
• Help design a scalable control monitoring program.
• Support first line teams in documenting, solutioning, and prioritising control gaps and drive a culture of proactive issue identification and remediation.
• Ongoing oversight of issue remediation activities using our risk management tool (Optro) to ensure appropriate risk focused prioritisation, and help validate closure of remediated issues.
• Support the development and implementation of key risk indicators, and risk appetite statements.
• Support and drive the creation of dashboards using data analytics tools to report on key risk indicators and identify actionable insights.
• Coordinate the quarterly residual risk assessment process across the risk taxonomy, including loss and incident reporting, to inform our regional risk profile for reporting to local and global risk committees, and to our local board.
• Partnering with ‘first line’ teams across the business to support the design and launch of new products and features by ensuring that key operational risks are identified and mitigated prior to launch.
• Promoting and helping embed a proactive risk culture, making risk meaningful and relevant to everyone at Wise.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (YouBiz)
jobs.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Staff Software Engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer with an exceptional command of backend tech to join our dynamic team. As a Staff Software Engineer, you play a crucial role in the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software systems. This position requires a high level of technical expertise, leadership, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities:
• Provide technical leadership and guidance to a team of software engineers.
• Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning.
• Own up the design and architecture of complex software solutions.
• Take ownership of several software components, ensuring their robustness, availability, and scalability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with overall system architecture.
• Plan and execute projects, ensuring efficient and on-time delivery of software products.
• Write high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code.
• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards.
• Collaborate with product managers to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain technical documentation for code, design, and architecture.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations.
• Collaborate with other software engineers to promote best practices and knowledge sharing.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in software development, with substantial experience in backend and cloud infrastructure.
• Expert-level proficiency in designing and developing high-performance, concurrent applications with Golang (Go).
• Knowledge on other languages like Java, Python, or Ruby will be an added advantage.
• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
• Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud native computing.
• Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies and tools, including unit testing and integration testing for backend applications.
• Demonstrated ability to lead projects, collaborate effectively with teams, and mentor junior engineers.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
• Passionate about software development and eager to stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in Software Development.

Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

GTM Enablement at Brex

Brex's go-to-market org is forward thinking with out AI tooling and support across Sales, RevOps, and Enablement. While we’ve made a promising start, our AI applications have been built ad hoc, with no shared standards, no central ownership, and no consistent way to measure whether they actually move the number. This is a highly impactful, net-new role for Brex: the first person on Revenue Enablement accountable for turning "a bunch of AI experiments" into a governed, prioritized, production-grade AI capability for the entire GTM org.

This isn't a prompt-engineering or tooling-rollout role. It's a hybrid of strategist, engineer, and embedded partner - someone who can set the roadmap for GTM AI investment, personally build and ship the applications that matter most, and then get in the trenches with sellers to make sure the work actually gets adopted. This person will serve as a lynchpin between Sales, Revenue operations, product and engineering. 

What you'll do

This role lives inside GTM Enablement, so your charter is the systems that make sellers effective including how they get certified, how they get ramped, how they get collateral, and how they get better at their craft. AI is the mechanism; enablement is the domain. Some of what you’ll work on:
• Set the internal sales enablement AI roadmap. Own the prioritization framework for how Brex builds AI applications and tooling across the enablement lifecycle including certification, onboarding, content, coaching, ramp. Decide what gets built next, what gets sunset, and why.
• Build and standardize GTM’s AI tooling stack. Write, review, and ship code yourself. You're not handing specs to an engineering team — you are a capable coder with a strong product sense who develops AI tooling for GTM reps.
• Make the build-vs-buy call. Continuously evaluate what enablement capability Brex should leverage third-party vendors (Gong, Itero, Highspot-type tools) for particular use-cases versus build in-house on Brex's own AI stack (Claude, etc.). This is a real strategic judgment call, not a default toward either — you'll need a clear framework for when a point solution is worth buying and when it's worth owning.
• Go deep on the sales domain. Understand the sales process — pipeline stages, seller CRM workflows, quota mechanics, what "good" looks like on a call — well enough to know where AI creates real leverage in enablement versus where it's a solution looking for a problem.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in one of our 5 hubs (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Salt Lake City and Vancouver). We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Requirements
• 4+ years in a role that combined hands go-to-market (Revenue ops or Enablement) with 1+ year focused on building sales-technology domain work
• Proven ability to ship production code — not prototypes or internal scripts, but tools that sales teams rely on daily (Python/TypeScript or comparable; LLM/agentic application experience strongly preferred)
• Real fluency in sales process and domain knowledge — you can sit in a pipeline review or forecast call and understand what's actually happening
• A track record of defining and tracking success metrics for your own initiatives — you don't wait for someone else to tell you if it worked
• Experience driving adoption, not just deployment — you know the difference between a tool that's live and a tool that's used
• Comfort operating with high autonomy and ambiguity — this role reports into GTM Enablement leadership, and you have counterparts across RevOps Product, but the roadmap is substantially yours to define
• A bias toward governance and simplicity — you'd rather have three trusted tools than fifteen overlapping ones

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is CA$154,400 - CA$193,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Manager (Business Audit & Forensics)
jobs.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

We are seeking an experienced Internal Audit Manager with forensic investigation experience to join our global internal audit function. This role will be responsible for leading end-to-end business audit engagements across business functions, as well as conducting fraud investigations and whistleblower cases.

The ideal candidate will combine strong audit fundamentals with investigative rigour — capable of both evaluating control environments and tracing irregularities to their root cause. Deep knowledge of financial services, cryptocurrency, or fintech is highly valued.

Business Audit
• Plan and execute end-to-end risk-based audit engagements across operational, financial, and business functions

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, New Account Risk
jobs.description:
About the Role

At Chime, the moment someone becomes a member is everything—it’s where trust begins, and where bad actors try to slip in. As an L4 Risk Analyst on the New Account Risk team, you will help protect Chime’s enrollment funnel from fraud while ensuring every legitimate applicant gets a fast, frictionless path to membership. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Operations, digging into data to spot emerging fraud patterns and turning your findings into policies, dashboards, and recommendations the team can act on.

Your work will directly support the team’s two headline goals for 2026: improving the Funnel Enrollment Rate (FER) and reducing the post-enrollment synthetic identity theft rate.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $133,000.00 and up to $185,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to
• Analyze enrollment and application data to identify opportunities to reduce synthetic identity and ID theft losses, with minimal impact to legitimate applicants (35%)
• Support the design, testing, and monitoring of new account risk policies and decision rules, partnering with Product and Engineering to ship improvements (30%)
• Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track Funnel Enrollment Rate, fraud loss, and approval/false-positive rates against team goals (20%)
• Monitor the performance of third-party vendor models and risk signals used at enrollment, flagging anomalies and trends to senior team members (10%)
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to fulfill ad-hoc analysis requests as needed (5%)

To thrive in this role, you have

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since
2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About

the role:

We are hiring for a dedicated Google Acquisition function to drive scalable customer growth across both our personal and business banking products. This Senior Manager will own the end-to-end Google performance channel — from campaign architecture and technical infrastructure to economic modelling and channel governance.

This is not an execution role dressed up as a leadership role. We need someone who thinks in systems, works from first principles, and has the depth to make credible judgements on strategy, technology, and economics simultaneously.

Responsibilities
• Campaign Architecture Execution
• Design and own the full Google channel strategy across UAC / App Campaigns, Performance Max, and Search for both personal and business banking acquisition
• Build and maintain campaign structures optimised for Moniepoint's dual-product funnel — separating signals, audiences, and bidding logic appropriately across segments
• Set bidding strategies, budget allocation frameworks, and creative testing cycles that reduce dependence on any single signal or format
• Own campaign performance end-to-end: from brief to launch to optimisation to reporting
• Tracking, Attribution Technical Infrastructure
• Architect and own the full measurement stack: Firebase / GA4 event taxonomy, Google Tag Manager configuration, and server-side event pipelines
• Lead the implementation and ongoing integrity of Conversion APIs and enhanced conversions to maximise signal quality sent back to Google
• Define the attribution model — evaluate last-click, data-driven, and custom models against Moniepoint's funnel reality, and own the decision with clear reasoning
• Partner with engineering and data teams to ensure event data flowing to Google is accurate, complete, and timely — treating signal quality as a competitive asset
• Build audit protocols for tracking coverage and attribution consistency; surface gaps before they distort decisions
• LTV/CAC Economics
• Own the economic model for Google acquisition: define CAC targets by product, segment, and channel variant; set the inputs, assumptions, and review cadence
• Understand the LTV/CAC relationship at a structural level — not just as a ratio to optimise, but as a function of product retention, monetisation curves, and cohort behaviour
• Build and iterate on payback period models that account for Moniepoint's emerging market context: irregular income patterns, higher churn risk, and longer monetisation timelines
• Design bidding and budget logic that reflects true LTV signals rather than proxy metrics, working closely with data science to enrich Google's Smart Bidding with offline conversion data
• Proactively identify when CAC is drifting against LTV thresholds and lead the diagnosis — channel mix, audience quality, creative fatigue, product-market fit — before it becomes a financial problem
• Governance Reporting
• Build a channel reporting system that surfaces reality clearly — not dashboards that flatter performance, but views that drive better decisions
• Establish review cadences with clear owners, metrics, and follow-through mechanisms
• Translate channel performance into business language for senior stakeholders: what is the cost of growth, is it sustainable, and what would change the trajectory
• Emerging Market Fintech Context
• Adapt Google acquisition strategy for the realities of emerging market users: variable device penetration, low-bandwidth environments, trust barriers to financial services, and diverse
• language/literacy contexts
• Navigate platform constraints specific to fintech advertising on Google: financial services policies, verification requirements, and creative compliance
• Bring genuine insight into what acquisition patterns distinguish sustainable fintech growth from subsidised growth in markets like Nigeria

To succeed in this role, you should have:
• 6+ years of hands-on paid acquisition experience, with the majority of that time spent on Google UAC / App Campaigns at meaningful scale
• Deep, demonstrable technical knowledge of Google's campaign infrastructure: bidding algorithms, audience signals, creative specs, and the mechanics of Smart Bidding
• Proven ability to architect and own the full measurement stack — Firebase, GA4, GTM, Conversion APIs — not just configure it but understand why each component matters
• Fluency in LTV/CAC modelling: you have built the models, owned the assumptions, and used them to make real budgeting and bidding decisions
• Experience operating in a fintech or financial services context, with direct knowledge of the acquisition compliance and trust dynamics unique to financial products
• Strongly Preferred
• Experience running Google acquisition in Sub-Saharan Africa or comparable emerging markets — Nigeria specifically is a significant advantage
• Familiarity with server-side conversion APIs, offline conversion imports, and enhanced conversions as mechanisms for improving signal quality in cookieless or app-first environments
• Experience working with data science or analytics teams to build custom bidding signals and offline LTV imports into Google's systems
• Prior work on dual-product or dual-segment acquisition (e.g., consumer and SME / business) with separate funnel logic

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days
• Full audit of existing Google campaign structure, tracking integrity, and attribution model completed — with a written assessment and prioritised improvement plan
• Measurement stack gaps identified and remediation underway with engineering
• LTV/CAC baseline model built with documented assumptions, reviewed with Growth and Finance
• First governance cadence established — weekly performance review with clear owner, metrics, and follow-through log

In the first year
• Google channel operating as a reliable, scalable growth engine with predictable CAC across both personal and business banking segments
• Signal quality measurably improved — higher match rates, cleaner conversion data, reduced reliance on last-click proxies
• Attribution model validated against actual cohort data and actively used in budget allocation decisions
• Playbook documented: campaign architecture, bidding logic, audience strategy, and economic model all institutionalised — not living in one person's head
• A team (or foundations for one) built with clear ownership, development paths, and no single point of failure

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
• A technical interview with the hiring manager
• A Case Study
• A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team
• All interview stages are virtual

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll build and own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s core financial products. You’ll solve complex scalability challenges while gaining deep expertise in U.S. financial systems and making a direct impact on the products used by millions.

The Brokerage team’s mission is to pave the way for launching new features, expanding into diverse financial services, and welcoming millions more people into the financial system. The team owns critical services that support trading and brokerage infrastructure and partners closely with other engineering, product, and operations teams across Robinhood.

The Incentives team drives user growth and engagement through both strategic incentives and platform capabilities. jobs.title: Senior Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The role:

As a Senior Compensation Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping SoFi Technologies’ global compensation strategy and programs to attract, retain, and motivate top talent globally. This role will lead our global job architecture, compensation structures, market benchmarking, and broad-based compensation modeling. You will use expert knowledge, market data, trends, technology, and financial analysis to develop compensation frameworks that are competitive, scalable, and aligned with our compensation philosophy.

You will be responsible for developing our annual cash and equity guidelines, modeling program budgets, and partnering with Finance on monthly stock-based compensation forecasting and analysis. You will also support the executive compensation function, working closely with the Executive Compensation Lead on Compensation Committee materials, executive compensation programs, and related disclosures.

What you’ll do:

Broad-Based Strategy Execution
• Lead global compensation benchmarking, market pricing, and the development of compensation structures, including base salary ranges, target bonuses, and long-term incentive guidelines.
• Own and enhance SoFi’s global job architecture, including job families, career levels, job profiles, and related compensation frameworks.
• Lead job architecture maintenance and redesign projects to support organizational design, workforce planning, career development, and talent acquisition.
• Develop recommendations for annual cash and equity program budgets based on market data, business priorities, affordability, and compensation strategy.
• Develop and maintain equity guidelines and model the share usage, dilution, and stock-based compensation impact of new hire, promotion, refresh, and other equity programs.
• Partner with Finance on monthly stock-based compensation forecasting, variance analysis, and long-term planning.
• Apply country-specific market practices and regulatory considerations to ensure compensation structures are locally competitive while remaining consistent with SoFi’s global compensation philosophy.
• Monitor compensation trends, market practices, and emerging developments, providing recommendations and insights to the Compensation team and business leaders.
• Partner with People, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Talent Acquisition to ensure compensation programs support business needs and are administered consistently.

Executive Compensation Support
• Support the preparation of quarterly Compensation Committee and Board materials, including executive compensation analyses, scenario modeling, and executive-ready insights.
• Assist with the preparation of proxy disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion and Analysis and SEC-required compensation tables, in partnership with Legal, Accounting, Finance, and Investor Relations.
• Support executive compensation operations, including incentive program tracking, Compensation Committee approval materials, stock ownership policy compliance, and executive offer letter development.
• Conduct executive compensation benchmarking and market analysis using relevant survey and peer company data.

 

What You'll Need:
• Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, human resources, business, or a related field. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is a plus.
• At least six years of broad-based compensation experience, including at least three years of direct experience developing job architecture, compensation structures, and market benchmarking frameworks. Executive compensation experience is preferred but not required.
• Experience owning or significantly contributing to global job architecture programs, including job families, career levels, salary structures, and incentive guidelines.
• Experience developing compensation programs for a multinational organization, including familiarity with country-specific compensation practices and structures.
• Direct experience supporting compensation programs in Latin America, including markets such as Argentina, Brazil, Ecuador, and Uruguay.
• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including experience building complex compensation, equity, and financial models.
• Experience modeling stock-based compensation expense, equity usage, dilution, or related financial impacts in partnership with Finance or Accounting.
• Experience using major compensation surveys and data providers, such as Radford, Willis Towers Watson, Mercer, or McLagan.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
• Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex compensation concepts clearly to different audiences.
• Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
• Strong cross-functional partnership skills and experience working with stakeholders across People, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Compliance, and Talent Acquisition.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver accurate results in a fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, take pride in delivering accurate and clear work, and thrive with a high degree of autonomy.

Compensation and Benefits

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are expanding our Latin American teams by establishing a new São Paulo engineering hub, building multiple new, high-impact engineering teams on the ground. We are looking for ambitious and highly skilled Staff Software Engineers to join these LatAm engineering teams, contributing to the first wave of talent in this hub. This is a unique opportunity to be a foundational member of our São Paulo engineering hub, helping to shape our local culture, processes, and technical direction. You will play a crucial role in expanding our product across Latin American markets, covering Onboarding (Consumer & Business) and Money Movement capabilities by integrating with local partners, connecting with local payment schemes, and building seamless customer journeys across the region, while collaborating closely with our global teams, including helping to shape our global KYC/KYB and money movement systems.

Your Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer based in our new São Paulo engineering hub, you will be a core contributor within one of the LatAm engineering teams, focused on building robust and scalable capabilities for Onboarding (Consumer & Business) and Money Movement across the diverse Latin American region. You will be instrumental in implementing integrations with banks, payment providers, identity/business verification vendors, and other local partners, connecting our platform to various local payment systems, optimizing onboarding funnels, and handling the complexities of moving money across countries, within your team's specific area of focus.

This role requires a high level of technical and product excellence and a passion for building high-quality, scalable, and compliant solutions tailored for the unique financial infrastructure and regulatory landscape of Latin America. You won't just be writing code; you will be involved in proposing solid technical designs, participating in code and design reviews within your team, and collaborating closely with engineers in other global offices to build the core infrastructure that unlocks and grows new markets across LatAm, especially in the area of global KYC/KYB and money movement systems.

You will have the chance to significantly contribute to the technical direction for your team's domain, help build a best-in-class engineering organisation right here in São Paulo, leveraging your experience to mentor and coach less experienced team members as we grow the engineering teams in this new hub. You will also collaborate closely with other engineering teams being established in São Paulo, and with global teams in other locations.

 

What You'll Be Doing:
• Design, develop, test, and deploy features and services to enable Consumer & Business Onboarding and Money Movement capabilities in existing and new Latin American markets, within your team's focus area.
• Implement integrations with local banks, payment providers, identity/business verification vendors, and financial partners across the region.
• Connect the Wise platform to various local payment schemes and networks across Latin America.
• Automate and improve onboarding workflows and compliance checks (KYC/KYB) for different customer types across the region.
• Propose and advocate for high-quality technical designs and solutions for both Onboarding and Money Movement that are scalable, reliable, and compliant with the diverse regulations across Latin American markets.
• Participate in code and design reviews within your team, providing constructive feedback to maintain and elevate our engineering standards.
• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers in our other global offices, to align on product vision and technical implementation for regional expansion and contribute to the evolution of our global KYC/KYB and money movement systems.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Onboarding, Money Movement, cross-border payments, and local integrations in LatAm markets.
• Contribute to the technical strategy and roadmap for the LatAm domain.
• Act as a technical mentor for less experienced engineers within your team and contribute to the technical growth of the São Paulo engineering hub.
• Stay updated on relevant LatAm market trends to inform product development and ensure compliance.

By leveraging emerging technologies and AI, you will productionise the technical engine that translates complex performance data into clear, actionable narratives. Your work will empower the wider marketing and regional teams to understand the why behind the numbers, transforming analytical understanding into impactful execution that scales our global growth and helps us improve our measurement within marketing analytics.

You have the business acumen to know what makes a data product meaningful for marketing stakeholders and can effectively partner with them to act on your findings. You will ensure data quality remains solid across a broad horizontal scope, building a scalable, reflective view of past growth drivers while providing the technical foundation to fuel future strategy, ideation, and understanding across the wider analytics team and its context. 

Your Mission

Your mission is to turn complex marketing data into a scalable, high-performance engine for insight generation and growth driver explanation. You will own the technical infrastructure that explains marketing performance, driving the development of automated tools (such as Streamlit apps, AI/agentic automation and reporting tools) that clearly articulate the drivers behind our growth. Rather than just reporting the financials, you will focus on the why to identify the highest-value opportunities within our Marketing Financials process. Ultimately working closely with the wider marketing, analytics, product and regional teams to bring those opportunities to execution and improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Ownership
• Growth Driver Explanation: Build and maintain the infrastructure to explain marketing growth drivers, ensuring the wider business clearly understands the mechanics and the why behind our performance.
• Opportunity Identification & Execution: Proactively identify key opportunities within the Marketing Financials process and partner with the wider marketing and regional teams to bring these insights through to strategic execution.
• Automating Insights: Lead the further productionising of our Marketing Financials process, shifting the focus towards automating driver analysis and providing deep-dives that uncover the core reasons behind growth performance.
• Advanced Analytics Tools: Lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics consumption tools, including Lightdash reporting, Streamlit apps, and AI/agentic automation to provide clear, accessible explanations of growth drivers.
• Growth Frameworks: Unlock frameworks for new growth areas by deeply understanding the drivers across the marketing funnel, and collaborate with global and regional teams to translate these insights into actionable strategies.
• Impact-Driven Delivery: Balance technical rigor with speed to deliver meaningful data products that translate complex growth drivers into clear business impact.

Leadership & Partnering
• Successfully collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing and Regional teams, acting as the crucial bridge between identifying data-driven opportunities and executing them within the wider marketing context.
• Be a subject matter expert on technical infrastructure within the Marketing Analytics team, ensuring our systems are optimized for driver analysis and explanation rather than just standard reporting.
• Contribute to the overall analytics strategy, ensuring that tribe data and analytics are discoverable, leveraged, and heavily focused on actionable understanding.

Required Qualifications
• 4+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing analytics, data engineering, or insights role, ideally at the start of your technical lead journey.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced Python is required.
• Experience with modern data stacks, including dbt, data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake), and visualization/semantic layers like Lightdash or Looker.
• Strong ability to understand the underlying mechanics of marketing to ensure technical products are meaningful and focused on explaining growth drivers.
• Proven ability to identify analytical opportunities within financial/marketing processes and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (Marketing, Regional teams) to translate insights into strategic execution.
• A focus on building systems and automated insights that drive measurable improvements in how the business understands and acts upon data.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience building data products, such as Streamlit apps, custom internal tools, or AI-integrated workflows.
• Familiarity with AI-native development workflows and tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the build of data products and automated agents.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - Regulatory Reporting
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst - Regulatory Reporting (IC2) to join the team in London. This is a high-impact role where your work directly enables Wise to operate and grow in regulated markets worldwide. You'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of regulatory reporting datasets — from understanding regulations and mapping them to internal data, through building and automating pipelines, to delivering clear visualisations and insights to stakeholders. You'll work at the intersection of finance, compliance, and data engineering, collaborating with teams across the business to ensure our reporting keeps pace with regulatory demands, Wise's growth and expansion, and its evolving data infrastructure.

This is a role for someone who combines strong technical skills, clear communication, and a drive to deeply understand the regulatory landscape and Wise's products. You'll translate that understanding into data — building things that are robust, scalable, efficient, and trusted.

Wise's Regulatory Reporting Analytics team builds and maintains the data infrastructure that underpins our regulatory obligations across multiple jurisdictions. We ensure that reporting datasets are accurate, automated, and scalable — enabling Wise to obtain and retain operating licenses while meeting audit and partnership requirements.

This team plays a critical role in:

- Powering regulatory compliance across Wise's legal entities.

- Supporting controlled growth and expansion by onboarding new entities, features, and regulations into regulatory deliverables.

- Contributing to controlled and accurate finance data through data quality checks.

- Fuelling operational efficiency through automation.

What you’ll be doing:

- Build and maintain accurate, efficient reporting datasets to meet regulatory requirements critical to obtaining and retaining operating licenses across multiple legal entities, and to fulfil our audit and external partnership obligations.

- Automate reporting workflows to minimise manual intervention and enable self-service for end users.

- Design and build intuitive data visualisations that present periodic summaries, control results, trends, and variances to stakeholders in a clear and accessible way.

- Develop robust data quality controls and integrate them into automated reporting workflows alongside monitoring and alerting mechanisms.

- Liaise with regulatory, prudential, and financial controllers, as well as regional product, compliance, and banking teams, to develop a thorough understanding of regulations and accurately map them to internal data points.

- Collaborate with analytics engineering and analysts across functions to keep pace with evolving data infrastructure and integrate cross-functional attributes into regulatory datasets.

- Investigate and drive resolution of complex data discrepancies, stakeholder queries, and internal control findings.

- Champion and uphold reporting standards and best practices across the team.

- Leverage Wise's tech stack, including modern AI and agentic tools, and stay current with emerging capabilities to improve reporting workflows and team efficiency.

Technical

skills:

- Advanced SQL: Ability to independently build efficient, readable queries spanning data extraction, transformation, and DDL/DML operations.

- Hands-on DBT experience, including materialisation strategy trade-offs and data quality testing.

- Experience working with a modern data warehouse such as Snowflake.

- Comfortable working with high-volume data.

- Python proficiency strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Indirect Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a motivated, decisive, practical and detail-oriented Indirect Tax Specialist to join our team. Our Tax team makes sure that we operate policies and governance procedures that seek to ensure we comply with tax laws in every territory we do business. With a high level of autonomy and responsibility, you’ll work across teams at Wise to manage and oversee our Indirect Tax Compliance function.

Your mission
• Prepare indirect tax returns, which includes Singapore, Australia and other key territories within the APAC region. This aspect will also require some preparation of Wise Indirect Tax returns globally from time to time. This involves working with other members of the finance team to extract the relevant data, ensuring processes are fully documented, controls are operating effectively, returns are reviewed and reconciled back to financial data.
• Eventually take ownership of the overall Indirect Tax reporting process for relevant returns across the APAC region. This includes adhering to controls, managing risks and judgement schedules as well as managing the end to end process with external advisors.
• Support the rest of the Indirect Tax team in helping the business to manage and optimise the overall Indirect Tax positions of the group. This may include ad hoc technical research, leading technical projects, identifying and suggesting improvements to existing processes and liaising with external advisors to ensure tax requirements for any new geographies or product are properly understood, captured and reported, and also communicated.
• Develop strong relationships with the accounting team, as well as financial controllers, to ensure the impact of Indirect Taxes are understood and reflected in the financial statements of the business.
• There is also the opportunity to work with the others within the Indirect Tax team / those in the Regional Tax team to support broader Indirect Tax consulting opportunities depending on the successful candidate’s desire and capacity. 

This role will give you the opportunity to
• Own your own path to success - you’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility to participate/lead cross team projects.
• Work in an international Tax & Finance Team and learn a lot about the tax around the world, fintech and driving financial sustainability of a fast growing company.

Sobre a vaga e missão do cargo 

Você irá atuar na Diretoria de Finanças como Financial Partner da vertical de Crédito Varejo PF, apoiando nas decisões e garantindo crescimento sustentável do negócio sempre com viés Financeiro. Sua atuação visa garantir o crescimento do business através de modelagem financeira preditiva do P L, busca ativa por variações que garantam a correta contabilização das linhas do P L e melhoria contínua nos processos para auxiliar na tomada de decisão orientada a dados e melhores práticas Financeiras.

No seu dia a dia, você vai:
• Atuar parceiro financeiro da unidade Crédito Varejo PF, sendo responsável pela análise de resultados e pelo suporte à tomada de decisão dos produtos.
• Trazer a visão de Finanças para discussões, reuniões e estudos estratégicos, aplicando teoria financeira na prática e considerando as especificidades de produtos.
• Controlar P L nos cenários de Budget, Actual e Forecast — abrangendo Receita, Despesas, Margem e EBT
• Analisar desvios com comparativos YoY, MoM e Actual vs. Budget.
• Modelagem financeira para projeções preditivas (trend, closing e forecast), pelo desenvolvimento de automações via RPA para otimização do consumo de dados e ganho de produtividade e pela criação de visualizações de dados (Dataviz).

Obrigatórios:
• Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em FP A, Controladoria, Consultoria Financeira ou Investment Banking.
• Modelagem financeira em Excel (cenários, sensibilidades, Pivot) e construção/manutenção de P L gerencial com decomposição em drivers operacionais (TPV, take rate, CAC, LTV, NII, CoF, CoR).
• Familiaridade com SQL para extração autônoma de dados.
• Experiência em variance analysis (Actual vs. Budget vs. Forecast) com identificação de causa-raiz e materialidade.
• Construção de Budget e Forecast com lógica top-down e bottom-up.
• Conhecimento de contabilidade gerencial e financeira aplicada a banco (DRE, Balanço, métricas regulatórias básicas) e unit economics em produtos financeiros (margem por cliente, payback, contribuição por linha).
• Compreensão dos principais KPIs como NII, custo de funding, cost of risk e seu impacto no P L.
• Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação técnica e construção de materiais.
• Domínio de PowerPoint para síntese de análises em mensagens que traduzam a estratégia do negócio.

• Conhecimento e/ou interesse em linguagem de programação para automação de pipelines de dados, reconciliação e ETL.
• Power BI ou Tableau para construção de dashboards executivos.
• Uso aplicado e/ou interesse em IA em workflows de FP A.
• Experiência prévia em produtos de crédito varejo e familiaridade com as linhas de P L que os envolvem.
• Entendimento de como despesas e custos variáveis se relacionam com o produto e seu impacto no P L.

jobs.title: Data Science Manager (Credit)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is a global fintech building modern financial services for millions of people and businesses across high-growth markets. We provide payments, banking, credit, and financial management tools - reliable products that people and businesses use every day to run their lives, grow their companies, and move money safely.

Our mission is simple: to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. And this is day one. We’ve grown rapidly in Nigeria and the UK, and we’re now expanding our product, engineering, and analytics teams. Our work ranges from building financial infrastructure to designing intuitive customer experiences for emerging markets - solving real, meaningful problems at scale.

We onboard over a million new customers each month, process 100s of billions of dollars in payments annually, and support tens of millions of users across our ecosystem. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, high-impact environment alongside international leaders from companies like Glovo, Bolt, Monzo, Klarna, Checkout.com, and Tide. If you want to build our data science function from the ground up, work with one of Africa’s highest-scale fintech data sets, and ship products that influence tens of millions of users, this is an exceptional time to join.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Spain-based Data Science Manager to lead our consumer credit data science efforts in a high-growth environment. This role is pivotal in building and scaling a team responsible for pricing, credit limit modelling, and production credit model deployment, with direct ownership of decisions that impact millions of customers.

You’ll work closely with our Consumer Credit, Product, and Engineering teams to shape how we assess and price risk, design credit products, and measure outcomes across the credit lifecycle. Sitting at the intersection of data science, credit risk, and product, you’ll build the analytics and modelling foundations that inform underwriting, customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio performance at scale.

Your day-to-day
• Developing credit scoring, affordability, and behavioural models to support underwriting, pricing, and collections
• Design and run experiments to optimise approval rates, loss rates, and profitability
• Partner with product squads to embed decision logic into real-time systems
• Ensure data quality, compliance, and ethical use of models across all decisioning processes
• Mentor product squads on best practices in experimentation and data-driven decision making
• Provide models to optimise outcomes in collections, churn management and user retention

We would love to hear from you if
• You’re comfortable with Statistics - and have a Degree or qualifications in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or similar)
• You have +5 years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within financial services, including +2 years in managerment
• Working knowledge of credit risk, consumer lending, and regulatory considerations
• Proficiency in SQL and at least one modelling/programming language (Python, R)
• Experience with A/B testing, machine learning, collections modelling and churn management
• Ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for business stakeholders
• High ownership mindset and comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams

What Moniepoint Can Offer You
• The opportunity to drive financial inclusion and shape the future of the African financial ecosystem
• The chance to work on innovative and impactful projects
• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative environment where every team member’s voice is recognised and valued
• Flexible work arrangements
• Continuous learning and career growth opportunities
