jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Verification Platform
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to manage the Platform team within the Business Onboarding Verification (BOV) organisation — based in London. This team owns the platform rails that Business verification is built on; the sister team (BOV Global) uses those rails to ship customer-facing journeys and agent tooling. There are three organisations in the wider squad — Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification, and Wise Platform Verification.

 

The scale we operate at
• In FY2025, 15.6M people and businesses used Wise; we onboarded over 5.9M new customers (~500K/month) and moved £145B across borders (~£400M/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies.
• Our onboarding decisions gate ~£25B/year in cross-currency volume.
• Verification is on the critical path for every new signup and for ~10 product teams across Wise that build on our rails today.

Our verification systems are not supporting tools — they are core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies and evolving threat patterns.

 

The team you'll lead - Verification Platform

You will lead the Verification Platform (under BOV) team in London — a cross-functional engineering team whose mission is to provide the BOV platform (Onboarding Platform for business, requirement evaluation, collection, review, unified vendor integrations, repapering rails) that lets BoV Global and regional teams iterate safely and quickly on business verification without rebuilding plumbing. Concretely, this team owns three work-streams:
• Onboarding Platform (for business) — modelling Business requirements as configuration-as-a-service, per legal-entity type (Ltd, LLC, Sole Trader, Partnership, Corp), with versioned rules and repapering / refresh rails so a policy change is a config choice, not a multi-quarter project.
• Review tooling platform — the review surface on which Global (and regional teams) build their review flows; the foundation that makes AI-assisted review and review automation measurable and safe to roll out.
• Unified Vendor Integrations — one observable, retryable, swappable gateway for registry, adverse media, website signal, Acceptable Use Policy and Business Onboarding data vendors, replacing today's point-to-point integrations.

Your mission

As the Engineering Lead for BOV Platform, you will:
• Lead, coach and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers — supporting their growth, well-being and performance, and empowering them to do their best work.
• Own the technical roadmap for the BOV platform — make sure it addresses real reliability, security and scalability concerns of the Business verification stack.
• Partner deeply with BOV Global, Personal Onboarding, Wise Platform Verification and Mitigation Handling so the platform serves real product needs — not what the platform team thinks the platform should be.
• Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team absolutely needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack — leading by example.
• Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, bottom-up decision-making, collaboration and continuous improvement — the way Wise engineering works.
• Own operational excellence. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, SLAs, documentation and observability for platform services; run incidents in your area of ownership and turn each into a durable fix.
• Collaborate globally with engineering leads across Global KYC and Onboarding (London, Tallinn, Budapest and Hyderabad) and the wider Wise engineering community.
• Run the engineering rituals of the team so we stay agile and predictable in product development.

Why this is an exciting problem

Picture a pharmaceutical company incorporated in Singapore, with one shareholder living in Dubai, trading in the UK and Singapore. In one signup, that business touches at least four regulatory perimeters — Singapore, UK, UAE for the shareholder, plus industry-specific controls for pharma (enhanced due diligence, sanctions, source-of-funds). Our job is to work out — in real time — exactly what each regulator needs, verify it against the right sources, and hand the customer a signup that feels effortless. Now scale that across 160+ countries and the millions of businesses we have. BOV Platform is building the framework that makes this possible without a new (or at most minimal) codebase per market, and the interesting problems stack up:
• Configuration-driven, versioned rules at scale. How do we express "what KYC do we need for entity type × country × industry × partner × risk tier?" as data — hot-reloadable, auditable, and safe to change weekly — while giving regulators a clean audit trail of which version passed which customer?
• Distributed decisioning under real-world latency. A single verification decision fans out to 10+ internal services and external vendors (registry lookups, sanctions, PEP, document verification, ML models). Sagas, idempotency, timeouts, and graceful degradation all matter — because "we couldn't reach the sanctions provider" isn't an acceptable customer experience.
• Consistency vs. availability on the KYC decision path. The same customer hits us from web, mobile and partner APIs concurrently. Where is strong consistency non-negotiable (a compliance-gated transfer) vs. eventual consistency fine (background re-screening)? How do we avoid decision drift across regions and entities?
• Event-driven re-evaluation and repapering. Rules change; a country updates its policy; a customer's risk profile shifts. How do we re-decide retroactively across millions of customers without stampeding downstream systems or ops queues?
• ML/AI in the loop — safely. Where does automation genuinely help (document classification, risk scoring, agent copilots), where does it not, and how do we ship it with safe fallbacks, clear observability and a human review path that doesn't become the bottleneck?

That's the problem your team will help solve — with real regulatory teeth, real customer impact, and enough platform surface area to keep senior engineers engaged for years.

Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, determines messaging and positioning, and translates our products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our marketers, across Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, are responsible for acquiring new customers and have a deep understanding of the business. We're a highly cross-functional team and partner most closely with Product, Sales, and Business Development to show our prospects and customers how we can help them reach their full potential.

What you'll do

As an Event Marketing Manager at Brex, you’ll support a portfolio of B2B events - the events that put us in front of founders, finance leaders, and operators. You'll report to the Head of Events on the Corporate Events team in Revenue Marketing, and work daily with sales, field marketing, and brand design. Corporate Events is a growing team that delivers highly engaging, high quality events with consistent ROI. You'll deliver a portfolio of industry hosted events from brief through post-event reporting. You'll have input on the portfolio strategy and how the team operates. The work spans strategy, operations, experience design with our brand and creative teams, and tight coordination with sales on what happens before and after each event. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in one of our 5 hubs (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Salt Lake City and Vancouver). We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own how Brex shows up at each event in your portfolio, from brief through post-event reporting, including vendor management, design partnership, registration, on-site execution, and sales follow-up
• Execute event sponsorships end-to-end: vendor and venue coordination, logistics, onsite management, and post-event reporting
• Coordinate with sales on pre- and post-event outreach - managing specific tasks and timelines to ensure lead follow-through and maximize pipeline impact
• Partner with design and brand marketing on activations, merch, and graphics for each event
• Manage vendor contracts and event budgets end-to-end, including reconciliation and variance flagging
• Collaborate with sales and field marketing teams to develop booth experiences and promotional materials aligned to brand standards
• Own lead gen pipeline targets; understand how event performance connects to broader marketing and sales goals
• Improve repeatable tradeshow processes, documentation, and workflows that scale across the portfolio
• Evaluate and recommend new event opportunities based on audience fit and pipeline potential
• Travel to manage onsite components for assigned events, as well as supporting events across the team as needed

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in event marketing or field marketing, with hands-on tradeshow and conference execution experience
• Demonstrated ability to own events end-to-end: logistics, vendors, onsite execution, and the follow-through that happens after everyone goes home
• Strong project management skills and a structured approach to planning; experience with project management tools is a plus
• Known for cross-functional collaboration and clean handoffs and proactive communication at all levels
• Understands how events connect to business goals - you know why you're running an event and what success looks like
• Team-oriented but self-directed: you collaborate closely and communicate openly, and you own your workstream without waiting to be told what to do next

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% for onsite event setup, supervision, and management

Nice to haves

• Experience managing event content and speaking engagements
• Familiarity with ClaudeAI and Splash
• Knowledge of the fintech or B2B SaaS industry

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $92,000 - $115,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, determines messaging and positioning, and translates our products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our marketers, across Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, are responsible for acquiring new customers and have a deep understanding of the business. We're a highly cross-functional team and partner most closely with Product, Sales, and Business Development to show our prospects and customers how we can help them reach their full potential.

What you'll do

As an Event Marketing Manager at Brex, you’ll support a portfolio of B2B events - the events that put us in front of founders, finance leaders, and operators. You'll report to the Head of Events on the Corporate Events team in Revenue Marketing, and work daily with sales, field marketing, and brand design. Corporate Events is a growing team that delivers highly engaging, high quality events with consistent ROI. You'll deliver a portfolio of industry hosted events from brief through post-event reporting. You'll have input on the portfolio strategy and how the team operates. The work spans strategy, operations, experience design with our brand and creative teams, and tight coordination with sales on what happens before and after each event. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in one of our 5 hubs (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Salt Lake City and Vancouver). We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Own how Brex shows up at each event in your portfolio, from brief through post-event reporting, including vendor management, design partnership, registration, on-site execution, and sales follow-up
• Execute event sponsorships end-to-end: vendor and venue coordination, logistics, onsite management, and post-event reporting
• Coordinate with sales on pre- and post-event outreach - managing specific tasks and timelines to ensure lead follow-through and maximize pipeline impact
• Partner with design and brand marketing on activations, merch, and graphics for each event
• Manage vendor contracts and event budgets end-to-end, including reconciliation and variance flagging
• Collaborate with sales and field marketing teams to develop booth experiences and promotional materials aligned to brand standards
• Own lead gen pipeline targets; understand how event performance connects to broader marketing and sales goals
• Improve repeatable tradeshow processes, documentation, and workflows that scale across the portfolio
• Evaluate and recommend new event opportunities based on audience fit and pipeline potential
• Travel to manage onsite components for assigned events, as well as supporting events across the team as needed

Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in event marketing or field marketing, with hands-on tradeshow and conference execution experience
• Demonstrated ability to own events end-to-end: logistics, vendors, onsite execution, and the follow-through that happens after everyone goes home
• Strong project management skills and a structured approach to planning; experience with project management tools is a plus
• Known for cross-functional collaboration and clean handoffs and proactive communication at all levels
• Understands how events connect to business goals - you know why you're running an event and what success looks like
• Team-oriented but self-directed: you collaborate closely and communicate openly, and you own your workstream without waiting to be told what to do next
• Comfortable using AI tools to streamline planning, communications, and repeatable workflows
• Proficiency with G Suite; familiarity with Monday.com, Salesforce, Marketo, or Nooks is a plus
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% for onsite event setup, supervision, and management
• A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, related field, or equivalent professional experience

Nice to haves
• Experience managing executive engagements and hospitality suites
• Experience managing event content and speaking engagements
• Familiarity with ClaudeAI and Splash
• Knowledge of the fintech or B2B SaaS industry
• CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) or similar certification

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $103,960 - $129,950. However, the starting base pay will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Small Business
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex
The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team.

What you’ll do

As a Sales Manager at Brex, you will lead a high-performing team of sales professionals, guiding them to achieve and exceed ambitious targets. You’ll be instrumental in driving strategy, mentoring team members, and ensuring operational excellence. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments, is passionate about leadership, and has a proven track record of success in sales. At Brex, we don’t just aim to hit quotas—we’re building a world-class team driven by innovation, resilience, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. Join us to shape the future of financial services for our customers while advancing your career in a company that recognizes and rewards your contributions.

In this role, you will lead a team of at least 8 high-performing Account Executives (AEs) dedicated to driving revenue growth and acquiring new customers within Brex's Small Business and Early Stage segment. In this pivotal role, you’ll empower your team to exceed ambitious targets, delivering impactful results that directly contribute to Brex’s success.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading and scaling successful B2B SaaS and/or Payments sales teams, ideally within fintech, travel, spend management, banking, or financial services industries. You thrive in dynamic environments, combining strategic thinking with hands-on coaching to unlock your team’s full potential.

You will collaborate closely with the Senior Sales Director to design and implement sales strategies that align with Brex's broader goals and vision. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sales at Brex, drive meaningful impact, and accelerate your career at the intersection of financial services and technology.

Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Lead a High-Performing Team: Guide, coach, and support a team of Account Executives (AEs) to consistently meet and exceed quotas, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
• Scale the Team: Recruit, hire, onboard, and train new AEs to support growth while improving internal enablement programs to ensure long-term success.
• Sales Strategy and Planning: Own weekly forecasting and ensure team members maintain an updated and accurate pipeline.
• Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to develop and execute sales strategies that align with Brex’s overall goals and objectives.
• Win Deals: Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers at mid-market companies to drive revenue growth and customer acquisition. Support your team in closing critical opportunities while teaching them to prioritize strategically for consistent success.
• Leverage Data: Continuously monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify trends, address challenges, and uncover opportunities for improvement.

Requirements
• 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally within fintech, travel, or spend management industries
• 2+ years of experience managing a high-performing sales team with a consistent record of achieving or exceeding quotas
• Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth and acquiring new customers
• Consistent track record of achieving quota
• Strong leadership, coaching, and team-building capabilities
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to inspire teams and build relationships with stakeholders
• Excellent prospecting skills and the ability to train others to generate pipeline
• Superb organizational skills and the ability to help others become organized

Bonus points
• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field
• Familiarity with financial products, credit cards, and business finance
• Familiarity with credit card management, encompassing a deep understanding of limits, rewards, and underwriting
• Keen awareness of the competitive landscape, industry trends, and market dynamics
• Familiarity with sales tools such as Gong, Salesforce, Outreach, etc. 

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is USD $233,000 - $259,000. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Role Overview

The Wallet Operations Director is responsible for the end-to-end operational integrity of the exchange's digital asset custody and wallet infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of operations, security, compliance, and engineering, ensuring assets are safe, accessible, and correctly accounted for at all times. The role requires deep technical knowledge of blockchain infrastructure combined with operational discipline and regulatory awareness.

 

Key Responsibilities

Wallet Operations Rebalancing
• Own and execute the daily operational cycle of hot, warm, and cold wallet management across all supported assets and networks
• Define and maintain rebalancing thresholds and triggers — ensuring hot wallets hold sufficient liquidity for withdrawals while minimising exposure
• Monitor wallet balances in real time; respond to alerts for low-balance, large outflows, or anomalous patterns
• Execute and authorise inter-wallet transfers (hot → warm → cold and vice versa), including multi-sig coordination with custodians or internal key holders
• Maintain SOPs for routine rebalancing operations and escalation procedures for off-cycle events
• Track gas/fee reserves across networks (ETH, BTC, TRON, Solana, etc.) and ensure fee wallets are topped up
• Coordinate with the treasury/finance team on asset flow reporting and reconciliation

Wallet Structure Advisory for Regulated Sites
• Provide operational inputs during licensing applications or regulatory reviews — documenting how client funds are segregated, custodied, and protected
• Design and recommend wallet architectures that meet jurisdictional requirements — including cold storage minimums, custodian approvals, and client asset segregation rules
• Work with legal and compliance teams to prepare wallet-related documentation for regulators (e.g., asset safeguarding policies, custody arrangements, asset-liability matching)
• Assess custody provider options (Fireblocks, Copper, Ceffu, BitGo, etc.) against regulatory expectations for each jurisdiction
• Flag operational risk or structural gaps ahead of audits or regulatory inspections
• Ensure wallet structures are scalable and adaptable as the exchange expands into new regulated markets

Proof of Reserves (PoR) Setup Operations
• Lead the design and implementation of PoR programmes for each site/entity — from methodology selection through to public publication
• Select and engage third-party auditors or verification partners; manage the relationship and audit cycle
• Define the PoR data scope: which assets, which wallets, which liabilities (snapshot definitions)
• Coordinate on-chain signing and Merkle tree construction with the engineering team to verify user liability coverage
• Build and maintain internal tooling or workflows to generate PoR snapshots on schedule (monthly, quarterly, or ad hoc)
• Respond to questions from users, auditors, or regulators on PoR methodology and results
• Stay current on evolving PoR standards and update methodology accordingly
• Ensure PoR results are consistent with internal reconciliation reports and finance records

Wallet Team Security Collaboration
• Serve as the operational counterpart to the Wallet Engineering and Security teams — translating business requirements into technical specifications and vice versa
• Participate in wallet infrastructure design reviews: new chain integrations, MPC/HSM upgrades, multi-sig policy changes, smart contract wallet deployments
• Drive the operational readiness checklist for any new wallet setup — key ceremony procedures, signing policies, access controls, DR/BCP scenarios
• Collaborate on key ceremony planning and execution (cold wallet creation, custody onboarding, signing authority changes) — ensuring proper documentation and witness procedures
• Conduct regular operational reviews with security: address findings from penetration tests, internal audits, or incident post-mortems
• Contribute to and review the Threat Model for wallet infrastructure; identify operational mitigations where technical controls are not sufficient
• Champion ongoing enhancements — proactively identifying process inefficiencies, latency bottlenecks, or risk gaps in the current setup

Risk, Controls Incident Management
• Own the wallet-related operational risk register; assess, track, and mitigate risks
• Define and enforce transaction approval limits, dual-control requirements, and segregation of duties across the wallet ops team
• Act as incident commander for wallet-related issues (stuck transactions, incorrect sends, suspected compromise) — lead the triage, contain the impact, and drive the post-mortem
• Maintain a 24/7 on-call escalation framework for critical wallet events
• Ensure all wallet movements are logged with full audit trails; support forensic investigations as required

Reconciliation Reporting
• Ensure wallet balances reconcile with exchange ledgers and on-chain state on a daily basis
• Partner with finance and product to resolve discrepancies, failed transactions, or asset suspension events
• Produce regular management reporting: wallet utilisation, rebalancing activity, PoR status, cold/hot ratio, incident log
• Support external audits (financial, security, regulatory) by providing wallet-related data and documentation

Team Leadership Development
• Recruit, manage, and develop a team of wallet operations analysts/engineers
• Set team KPIs, OKRs, and performance standards
• Build a culture of operational rigour, security-first mindset, and continuous improvement
• Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and training materials to ensure operational resilience and knowledge retention
• Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Tech, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Risk, and Customer Support

Skills Experience Required
• 4–8+ years in digital assets, crypto exchange, or institutional crypto custody
• Strong understanding of blockchain mechanics, UTXO vs account-based models, MPC, HSM, multi-sig
• Hands-on experience with Fireblocks, Copper, BitGo, Ceffu, or similar
• Familiarity with key ceremony procedures, cold storage operations, access control frameworks
• Exposure to regulated entity requirements (CMA, MICA, VARA or similar); understanding of client asset segregation
• Strong SOP authorship, incident management, reconciliation discipline
• Proven track record managing a small-to-mid-size ops team
• Comfortable with on-chain data, dashboards, and basic scripting for data pulls (SQL/Python a plus)

Key Performance Indicators
• Zero unplanned wallet outages or rebalancing failures
• Hot wallet exposure maintained within defined thresholds (% of total AUM)
• PoR published on schedule with zero material findings

• Regulatory wallet documentation accepted by all relevant regulators

jobs.title: Head of Recovery
jobs.description:
Who we are

 

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

 

JOB PURPOSE

The Head, Debt Collection is a strategic leadership position tasked with the architecture and execution of Moniepoint’s debt collection framework. The primary focus of this role is the minimization of Loss Given Default (LGD) within both the business and consumer lending divisions.

The incumbent will oversee, develop, and implement comprehensive and versatile debt collection strategies designed to manage a diverse portfolio of credit products, ranging from digital-first retail lending to large-ticket corporate financing.

Responsibilities include designing the organizational structure of the debt collection unit and recruiting high-caliber talent. Additionally, specialized expertise in debt litigation and asset recovery will be required to navigate complex cases of delinquency.

A data-driven methodology must be utilized to systematically evaluate the efficacy of recovery tactics and the performance of personnel.

 

Job Responsibilities
• Design and implement a segmented debt collection framework — differentiated by product type, ticket size, and delinquency stage — spanning early-stage soft collections through hardcore legal recovery, restructuring, and write-off pathways.

• Demonstrated experience designing, building, or scaling a recovery/collections function — including org design, systems and process build-out, and team hiring.
• Proven experience overseeing recovery operations with national coverage, including a strong network of legal counsel and law enforcement contacts spanning all six geo-political zones in Nigeria — as opposed to experience confined to a single state or region.
• Excellent negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial and portfolio data to guide recovery strategy.

Relevant Skills

• Credit Risk Management
• Data Analytics, Propensity Scoring Portfolio Reporting
• Digital Collections Tools Automation
• Negotiation Conflict Resolution
• People Performance Management

jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£40,000 - £52,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance | Benefits ✨

 

Our Procurement team ⭐

The Procurement team at Monzo is evolving into a proactive, strategic partner to the business - one that shapes commercial decisions, enables scale, and delivers meaningful long-term value.

We’re hiring a Buyer to join the team. This role will align to a defined category/collective and focus on delivering strong sourcing and commercial outcomes. While you’ll work within a specific spend area, we’re hiring for strong, transferable procurement skills - not deep subject matter expertise.

This is a great opportunity to build deeper category knowledge over time while becoming a high-visibility partner who guides stakeholder and business direction and builds credibility.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...
• ​​Leading end-to-end sourcing processes within your aligned category, operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability
• Navigating complex trade-offs, applying sound commercial judgement to balance risk, cost, value and long-term strategy
• Running competitive events and negotiating commercial terms that deliver measurable value
• Owning contract execution and renewal planning, proactively managing timelines and dependencies
• Translating stakeholder requirements into clear, commercially robust solutions - challenging constructively where needed
• Aligning and, where necessary, realigning stakeholders to drive clarity, momentum and confident decision-making
• Identifying and delivering opportunities to improve commercial outcomes within your remit through insight, influence and independent thinking

🌱 Growth Development

This role offers the opportunity to align to a category and develop deeper expertise over time, building both commercial depth and strategic influence. If you bring experience in a particular spend area, we’d love to know - but it’s not a prerequisite.

We’re primarily looking for strong procurement fundamentals and the ability to apply them thoughtfully in new contexts.

As you demonstrate independent execution, strong judgement and stakeholder leadership, there’s clear opportunity to broaden your remit, increase complexity, and grow your impact longer term.

• Have experience running end-to-end sourcing processes and negotiating commercial terms, always seeking to understand the commercial rationale behind decisions
• Understand core procurement principles and can clearly articulate commercial trade-offs - balancing cost, risk, value and long-term impact
• Naturally curious, seeking to understand the “why” behind decisions and constructively challenging assumptions to drive stronger commercial outcomes
• Are comfortable applying your skills across different spend areas, adapting your approach to new contexts with sound judgement
• Have experience working closely with stakeholders, guiding and influencing commercial conversations with confidence
• Thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy solving practical commercial challenges with curiosity and ownership

💰 £40,000 - £52,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Staff Analytics Engineer - Borrowing

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £121,600-164,600 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance and benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐ Our Borrowing Analytics Engineering Team

 

Our mission in Borrowing is to help people achieve their financial goals through better borrowing. Our customers borrow money to achieve something in their lives — whether that’s making a big life event affordable, buying something they need now without affecting their monthly budget, or getting by until payday. We’re shaping this mission by building products our customers love, while safely scaling some of Monzo’s biggest revenue lines.

Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most complex and fastest-growing domains. We operate 12+ products across multiple geographies, underpinned by 1,700+ data models and an analytics engineering team that’s scaling to match. We’re in the middle of a major data architecture transformation, expanding into new markets, and building the next generation of data infrastructure to support it all.

We’re looking for a Staff Analytics Engineer to help shape how Borrowing builds and uses data at scale. Reporting to the Borrowing Data Director, you’ll work across product, credit, engineering, Data Platform, and analytics engineering teams to turn complex technical problems into clearer systems, stronger data products, and better business decisions.

 

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…
• Architecting Borrowing’s data layer at scale. Partnering across Analytics Engineering, Product, Engineering, Credit, and Data Platform to shape how 1,700+ models across 12+ products are structured, connected, and evolved. You’ll set shared patterns that help teams build trusted, consistent, and scalable data products across Borrowing.
• Designing and governing data products. Moving us beyond ad-hoc tables toward well-defined, contractual data assets with clear ownership, SLAs, documentation, and interfaces. You’ll work with teams across Borrowing and Data Platform to define what makes a Borrowing dataset “production-grade” and consumable by analytics, ML, decisioning, and regulatory teams.
• Building feature stores and reusable analytical assets. Identifying cross-product signals (credit behaviour, repayment patterns, affordability, risk indicators) that should be modelled once, tested rigorously, and consumed by many. You’ll design the layer that turns raw product data into curated, versioned features that power models, dashboards, and decisions.
• Scaling our analytics engineering infrastructure. Shaping the tooling, patterns, and developer experience that make an 80+ person credit and data organisation more productive. This means influencing our data architecture and ways of working across data and credit disciplines, while partnering with the central Data Platform team to ensure Borrowing’s needs are reflected in ingestion, streaming, and schema contract design.
• Driving cross-product data consistency. As we expand across geographies and product lines, ensuring our data models are coherent and comparable. You’ll work with AE leads and domain experts to define shared conventions and abstractions that allow us to reason about Borrowing as a whole, not just product-by-product.
• Being a senior technical partner for Borrowing’s data estate. Partnering with backend engineers on source data payload design, with product managers on measurement strategy, with credit teams on decisioning data, and with senior leadership on what’s possible and what’s next.
• Leading through influence and leverage. You won’t manage people directly, but you’ll shape how an entire domain builds data. You’ll multiply the impact of AEs across Borrowing by setting the right patterns, unblocking architectural decisions, and raising the bar on what good looks like.

 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
• You think in systems, not just queries. You’ve designed data architectures that span multiple products or domains, and you know how to keep them coherent as they scale. You can take ambiguous problems and turn them into a clear technical direction, delivery sequence, and set of trade-offs.
• You’ve built data products, not just data models. You understand the difference between a table that exists and a data asset that’s governed, documented, versioned, discoverable, and trusted. You’ve defined SLAs, contracts, interfaces, or ownership models for data consumers, and you’re excited to do this at scale.
• You have deep fluency with analytics engineering systems and infrastructure. dbt at scale, BigQuery or equivalent, CI/CD for data, testing frameworks, and orchestration. You don’t just use these tools, you shape how teams use them. You’ve hit the scaling limits and know what to do about them.
• You can design reusable feature layers. You’ve designed, contributed to, or have a clear vision for reusable feature layers that serve multiple consumers, including ML pipelines, dashboards, decisioning engines, and regulatory reporting. You understand the trade-offs between freshness, cost, granularity, correctness, and ease of use.
• You’re comfortable at the platform boundary. You can have a productive conversation with a Data Platform engineer about ingestion patterns, streaming vs. batch trade-offs, schema evolution, and infrastructure costs. You don’t need to build the platform, but you need to shape what it delivers.
• You connect technical choices to business outcomes. You care about whether data models, feature layers, and platform patterns actually improve decisions. You understand how product, credit, engineering, and operational teams use data, and you use that context to align people around better technical choices.
• You lead through others. You create leverage not by writing more SQL, but by setting patterns, reviewing designs, unblocking teams, and raising the standard. You’re energised by making 30+ people more effective, not by being the single expert.
• You communicate across altitudes. You can whiteboard a data architecture with a back-end engineer in the morning and present a strategic data roadmap to a director in the afternoon. You adapt your message to your audience without losing precision.
• You care about credit products. You’re excited, or curious, about the complexity of lending, including risk, affordability, regulatory constraints, and multi-product dynamics. You see it as a fascinating data domain, not just a business vertical.

Interview process

Our typical process is structured as:

• Initial call

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

What’s in it for you:

✅ We can sponsor visas 

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

About

the Role:

PhonePe's Data Platform powers India's largest consumer payments app at national scale—managing petabyte-scale infrastructure, batch/real-time pipelines, and developer tooling entirely on-premise. You'll build the core data infrastructure, tools, and internal products that enable hundreds of engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business teams to move faster.

What You'll Do:
• Own product strategy, specs, and roadmaps for data platform components, APIs, and developer tools
• Synthesize requirements from business/product teams and translate them into system APIs, developer interfaces, and platform capabilities
• Work with architects and engineering leads to balance reliability, performance, technical debt, and new features
• Design solutions for data quality, governance, cataloging, and pipeline efficiency at petabyte scale
• Define and track platform health metrics: latency, query performance, uptime, adoption, resource efficiency

Must Haves:
• Product Management Experience
• 1-3 year as PM/APM with product ownership, OR
• 2-3 years as Data/Backend Engineer with PM work (PRDs, roadmaps, user research)
• Technical Stack Depth
• Deep understanding: ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehousing, data lakes/lakehouses
• Advanced SQL (query optimization, not just SELECT statements)
• Hands-on with ONE of: Hive/Spark/Hadoop/HDFS, Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery, or Airflow/DBT/Kafka/Trino
• Understands how data systems work end-to-end (not just BI layer)
• Problem-First Thinking
• Asks clarifying questions before solutions (WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHY, HOW)
• Articulates problems → solutions → outcomes (not feature lists)
• Synthesizes requirements from diverse stakeholders into clear product specs
• Structured Approach
• Breaks down ambiguous problems systematically
• States assumptions explicitly and validates them
• Thinks in MVP phases and iterations
• Technical Communication
• Holds technical discussions with engineers/architects
• Translates business needs into system specs, APIs, and developer interfaces
• Writes clear PRDs, specs, and documentation

Good To Haves:
• TB/PB-scale data systems experience
• On-prem stack: Hive, Spark, HDFS, Hadoop, Impala (cloud experience acceptable if fundamentals strong)
• Built internal developer tools, APIs, or self-service platforms
• Data governance: cataloging, lineage, access controls, metadata management, observability
• AI-native workflow: Active user of ChatGPT/Claude/GitHub Copilot; bonus for GenAI features (RAG, LLM apps)
• High-potential signals: Published work, side projects, led cross-functional teams

Why Join?
• Unmatched scale: Petabyte-scale data infrastructure, real-time pipelines at national scale
• Open-source stack: Massive on-premise deployments (Hive, Spark, HDFS, Hadoop)
• High impact: Enable every engineering, analytics, and business team to move faster
• Ownership + mentorship: Core platform modules with structured career growth

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
• Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
• Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
• Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
• Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
• Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
• Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

 

Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. jobs.title: Staff Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role 

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

At Robinhood, Quality Engineering (QE) is a critical function within our broader engineering organization. We serve as the final line of defense for product quality—empowering teams to ship confidently by embedding robust test strategies, running critical end-to-end checks, and maintaining automation systems that scale with our product velocity. Our mission is to uphold a high bar for customer experience, especially during P0 launches, through a mix of technical expertise, test execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will support high-impact product launches by designing test strategies, executing manual and automated testing, and partnering with our contractor team on regression test cycles. This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, cares deeply about the customer experience, and is eager to shape the test infrastructure behind Robinhood’s iOS, Android, and Web apps.

This role is based in our Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do
• Own the quality of new features, including test planning, execution, and feedback throughout the development cycle

jobs.title: WFM Team Lead
jobs.description:
As a WFM Lead, you will play a crucial role in supporting our agents and operational teams to optimise SLA and efficiency whilst protecting agent well-being. You’ll be supporting and levelling up our WFM team in our quest to provide the best and lowest-effort customer experience, whilst ensuring our processes and costs scale globally with the company’s rapid growth

Your Mission
• Grow and level up your team, supporting their development through the WFM Career map and beyond
• Set the scheduling strategy for the upcoming 3 months or intraday strategy for the next 2 weeks
• Build scalable scheduling or intraday routines, identify and highlight replication opportunities for global consistency
• Understand and interrogate our forecasts, making adjustments using your expertise and optimise our coverage to meet our SLAs, efficiency goals and resolution times
• Identify process improvement opportunities and take the initiative to automate, improve efficiency, and reduce waste and cycle times across WFM practices, whilst always considering our agents’ well-being
• Drive and be accountable for WFM KPI improvements (forecasting accuracy, scheduling accuracy, cycle times, intraday effectiveness)
• Identify performance opportunities through quality, data analytics and source-of-truth reporting
• Recommend capacity requirements and coverage distribution opportunities, supporting our strategy
• Work with our Vendor Management team to highlight opportunities and increase our flexibility
• Continuously improve our rolling 18 month capacity plan for the business unit, supporting your analysts with your expertise in reducing wMAPE rates
• Co-own quarterly OKR target-setting with your fellow leads
• Build out reports to improve the quality of decision-making in collaboration with our planners and analysts
• Build smaller-scale forecasts to support exceptional events, such as incidents
• Build regional WFM capacity plan for your team

jobs.title: Head of Global Partnerships - Cards
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Head of Global Card Expansion to own one of the most important parts of Wise's global payments infrastructure.

You'll own the partnerships that underpin both how customers spend with Wise and how they pay Wise. Your decisions will shape the future of the Wise Card, our card funding capabilities, and the commercial partnerships that support millions of customers around the world.

This isn't a traditional partnerships role. You'll own Wise's global strategy across Visa, Mastercard, and our acquiring partners, ensuring they enable our mission. You'll shape how we launch the Wise Card into new markets, how customers fund their Wise Account using cards, and how we build commercial partnerships that improve customer outcomes while strengthening the economics of our global card programmes.

You'll work across Product, Banking & Expansion, Treasury, Finance, Compliance, Legal and Engineering to solve complex problems and help Wise continue to scale globally.

Your mission:

Own Wise's global card partnerships:
• Own our executive relationships with Visa, Mastercard, our issuer banking partners and strategic acquiring partners. Define how Wise works with these organisations globally, aligning commercial strategy, product priorities and expansion goals to create long-term competitive advantage.
• You'll represent Wise in commercial negotiations, product forums and strategic planning, while ensuring our partnerships continue to support Wise's ambitious growth plans globally.

Build and scale the world's best global card programme:
• Define the strategy for Wise's global card programmes across issuing and card acceptance.
• Lead complex commercial negotiations covering network economics, incentives, issuer partnerships, acquiring relationships and long-term commercial frameworks. Own the commercial models that underpin our card business and continually improve the economics of how customers spend with Wise and fund their Wise Account.
• You'll be equally comfortable negotiating a multi-year commercial agreement, reviewing an issuer agreement with Legal, supporting due diligence for a new BIN sponsor or working through scheme documentation to enable a new card feature.

Enable global expansion:
• Partner with regional Banking & Expansion teams to launch the Wise Card into new markets and new legal entities.
• Work directly with regional Visa and Mastercard teams and local partners to define market strategy, remove blockers and accelerate launches. You'll understand that successful expansion requires balancing global consistency with local market realities and you'll enjoy getting into the details to make things happen.

Build compliant, scalable card programmes:
• Work closely with Compliance, Financial Crime and Legal teams to ensure our card partnerships and programmes remain compliant as Wise scales.
• You'll understand how scheme rules, AML and financial crime requirements, issuer obligations and local regulation intersect, and you'll work directly with partners to solve regulatory challenges that enable launches rather than slow them down.
• You're comfortable owning regulatory conversations with external partners and know that strong commercial partnerships are built on strong compliance foundations.

Be Wise's card ecosystem expert:
• Become the company's go-to expert on the global card ecosystem.
• You'll understand the technical, operational and commercial detail behind card schemes, issuer processing, acquiring, settlement, interchange, network economics, certification, digital wallets and payment acceptance.
• You'll use that expertise to influence product strategy, advise Engineering and Product teams, and identify new opportunities for Wise to improve the customer experience.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Own some of Wise's most strategic external partnerships and represent Wise with senior leaders across Visa, Mastercard, issuer banks and global acquiring partners.
• Shape the future of one of Wise's fastest-growing products by influencing how the Wise Card expands globally.
• Lead commercial negotiations that directly improve customer outcomes and the economics of Wise's global card programmes.
• Work on complex international launches, partnering with regional teams to bring new card products and payment capabilities to market.
• Solve difficult commercial, technical and regulatory challenges across multiple markets where no playbook exists.
• Define how Wise partners with the global card ecosystem for the next decade while remaining hands-on in making that strategy a reality.

jobs.title: Cards API Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Cards API Senior Specialist to own the operational health, scale, and performance of our Wise Platform partner’s card programs. In this role, you will be the operational backbone for our card issuance, bridging the gap between technical infrastructure and partner success. You will manage post-launch business-as-usual operations, monitor critical program health metrics, troubleshoot incidents, and drive automation to help our card issuance programs scale efficiently.

 

Key Responsibilities
• Maintain operational SLAs from card issuance, disputes and schemes reporting
• Build out operational guides for managing Cards API physical card programs
• Own and drive conversations with external vendors relating to Cards API program launches and remove operational bottlenecks and enhance partner experience
• Continuously identify manual workstreams required to service partners to drive automation rate and reduce operational load
• Assist CS teams when escalations are made with regards to Cards API operational issues (delivery, disputes, declines, etc.)
• Own invoicing process with Finance, internal operational teams, and external vendors
• Generate ad-hoc operational reports for Cards API partners when needed (audit requests, stock count requests, etc.)
• Manage disputes & chargeback requests as well as escalations from partners/internal teams
• Data gathering and input for quarterly and monthly operational reporting
• Ensure workstreams and dependencies from other Spend Ops teams (e.g., Issuance, Billing, Settlement) are considered in BAU changes, incidents, and partner requests by coordinating handoffs and ownership boundaries.
• Support Customer Success Manager and/or Account Managers of WP on partner’s queries

jobs.title: Senior Content Designer - Spend
jobs.description:
How should global money work? How do you take a complex, stressful experience and make it simple, calming even? How do you challenge the way it’s always been done? 

How do you collaborate in a human-centred way to ship work you’re truly proud of?

These are just a few of the challenges a Senior Content Designer will work on as part of Wise’s global mission to build an open, fair, and human financial system. Right now we move £6 billion every month for over 12 million people. But we're only 2% done — because people without borders deserve money without borders.

 

What you’ll be doing:
• You’ll shape how millions of customers spend with Wise, at home and around the world.
• Crafting clear, compelling experiences you'll help customers navigate complex moments with confidence — turning complicated financial, operational, and risk-related concepts into simple, actionable, rewarding experiences.
• This role sits within our Spend squad. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and Operations to ensure customers always know what's happening with their money and what to do next.
• You'll also be part of the Content Guild, and will regularly collaborate with the content community across Wise.

 

Here’s how you’ll contribute:
• Get to know our customers, building empathy and a deep understanding of their needs
• Use your expertise to discover, design, and deliver simple, beautifully crafted, intuitive experiences that customers love
• Influence teams and stakeholders to increase customer-centeredness, creativity, and content quality across the squad
• Work with designers from other squads to build a single, seamless experience for customers

 

Here’s how you’ll contribute:
• Get to know our customers, building empathy and a deep understanding of their needs
• Use your expertise to discover, design and deliver simple, beautifully crafted, intuitive experiences that customers love
• Influence teams and stakeholders to increase customer-centeredness, creativity, and content quality across the squad
• Work with designers from other squads to build a single, seamless experience for customers

 

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Deliver impact and ship work you’re proud of
• Own content projects from end-to-end
• Elevate content quality — defining what good looks like in the squad, then helping deliver it
• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken, greedy system, and putting people and businesses in control of their money

About you:
• You’re an accomplished Senior Content Designer with experience shipping world-class consumer products
• You’re comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity — and can successfully collaborate in this environment
• You’re highly empathetic, both to customers and the people you work with
• Exceptional content craft and a desire for quality
• Willingness to give and receive constructive feedback 

 

Heads up, this probably isn’t for you if:
• Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism or social media – and you have no hands-on experience of content design or working in UX

We’re people without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We want to work with the best people, no matter their background. So if you’re passionate about learning new things and keen to join our mission, you’ll fit right in. And because we believe that diverse teams build better products, we’d especially love to hear from you if you’re from an under-represented demographic.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Manager - Credit Risk
jobs.description:
Mission: We’re on a mission to make money without borders—instant, transparent, and eventually free. We’re a team of people who are passionate about building the financial infrastructure of the future. The newly created Credit team is at the frontier of this mission, tasked with exploring how transparent and fair credit can empower our customers to manage their global financial lives more effectively.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Manager, Credit to join the Spend Squad and shape the future of our first credit products. 

In this role you’ll partner closely with a high performing global team consisting of the product lead, engineers, data scientists and designers to deliver a world class credit product. 

You will be expected to be hands on with the data and grow a small team of analysts as the product scales. 

What You’ll Do
• Partner with Data Science to challenge and stress-test credit risk modelling assumptions for our SME customers (including scenario and sensitivity testing), ensuring decisions are robust and explainable.
• Leverage market insights and publicly available data on SME finance to help validate our modelling and decisions.
• Develop forward-looking views of expected loss, repayment failures, delinquency transitions, and write-offs, and creating feedback loops with product/risk decisions.
• Working closely with regional teams to inform our market launch strategy
• Own the Credit analytics data strategy: define the roadmap for the datasets, dashboards and tools needed to scale decision-making; ensure consistent definitions, documentation and data quality.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team: coaching, prioritisation, raising analytical quality, and hiring as the team grows.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Manager - Technology
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Internal Audit Manager for the technology risk portfolio with a global remit to join our new and growing IA team. 

Your main task will be to coordinate the internal audit process within the company and externally with partnering firms. You will make recommendations to improve governance, risk management and internal controls. You will be responsible for planning, assigning, and supervising the operational activities of the team. You will collaborate with different regional audit teams in collating content for internal and external reporting.

This newly created role presents a great and unique opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced and innovative environment, focussed on applying data driven techniques and automation. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.

We are a newly formed team, therefore you have the unique opportunity to collaborate and shape the operations, methodology and approaches of the Internal Audit function.

Your mission
• Support the implementation and operation of the internal audit assurance framework, including innovative development of continuous monitoring and automated audit routines.
• Support development of the annual IT audit plan, including the audit universe, risk assessment processes and budgeting processes with significant use of data and automation.
• Deliver audits per the audit plan to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes, including the use of impactful analytics.
• Build and support a strong, forward looking and self-sufficient IT internal audit team.
• Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the teams and measure the effectiveness of the improvements.
• Coordinate, collate and present information for internal and external reporting, e.g. audit committee reporting, when required.
• Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, internally and externally.
• The role is London-based, and many of our teams are located across different office locations. You will travel on occasions as needed to meet your objectives.

Skills:
• You are a subject matter expert in technology related risk, control or assurance, particularly on cloud platforms, e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP. You want to continuously innovate and improve how to get the job done.
• You have worked in technology, fintech or broader financial services industries.
• You have performed planning, staffing, delivery and reporting of multiple highly bespoke audit engagements.
• You are able to work independently, you assume responsibility and you make your own judgement. However, you know when to consult or inform other team members / stakeholders.
• You are able to identify opportunities and oversee the use of analytics and automation to drive impactful innovative agenda.
• You are prepared to take ownership over complex new areas and solve problems with no or very limited guidance.
• You have strong coordination skills and you are able to hold teams accountable for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality outputs.
• You demonstrate attention to details but can summarise key messages succinctly, verbally and in writing, adjusting your style and level of information based on the target audience.
• You’re curious and collaborative - you’re great at asking insightful questions to understand the real issues and deliver the right outcomes.
• You are passionate about driving change, making improvements and helping stakeholders.
• You are not afraid of making decisions, can work autonomously and take initiative.
• You’re a strong relationship builder across all levels of the business and externally.
• You have working proficiency in performing impactful automation and analytics using a programming language like Python and SQL is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Servicing Platform

At Wise, we are on a mission to build money without borders -instant, convenient, transparent and eventually free. Behind every transaction lies a critical responsibility: holding over £20B+ in customer balances, moving £145B+ across borders annually and protecting innocent customers from fraudsters, sanctioned entities and financial crime.

The Servicing Platform sits at the very heart of this mission. We build the foundational identity engines, high-throughput risk platforms and real-time APIs that power all customer servicing, onboarding and risk decisions across Wise globally.

As Wise expands its engineering presence in Hyderabad, we are building core execution capability to modernize our identity and risk infrastructure. As a Backend Engineer (IC3), you will tackle real-time scale challenges, execute complex system migrations and onboard products to next-generation risk APIs that gate billions in cross-currency volume.

What You Will Be Working On

You will join a high-velocity engineering squad focused on platform adoption and system reliability:
• Platform Implementation & Migrations: Drive the hands-on technical integration of Wise products onto our modernized Identity, Account and Risk APIs. You will unblock product and FinCrime squads by executing key migrations such as deprecating legacy models and services and improving integrations into Fin Crime domains.
• High-Performance Infrastructure: Build, maintain and optimize low-latency, high-availability microservices. You’ll work toward achieving sub second risk check speeds for real-time transactions.
• Data Lineage & Governance: Implement robust schemas, data contracts and immutable data flows to ensure complete auditability and data consistency across the full customer and transaction lifecycle.
• Operational Excellence: Maintain the operational health (SLAs/SLOs, monitoring, alerting) of critical platform components. Participate in incident resolution and post-mortems to ensure zero downtime for money moving out of Wise.
• Global Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (Product, FinCrime, Risk Assessment) and engineering peers across London, Tallinn and Hyderabad.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant I, Commercial
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Implementation at Brex

Implementation transforms new customers into power users. We lead the onboarding experience for companies adopting Brex Empower, helping them shift from outdated processes to a modern, employee-first approach. It’s a role that blends customer empathy, project management, technical expertise, process design, and change management. We take personal ownership of our customers' long-term success, and we set customers up thoroughly so they can be with ‘Brex for life’. As strategic advisors, we build trust, drive solutions with tenacity, deliver results fast, and work cross-functionally to make adoption seamless for customers.

What you’ll do

The Implementation Consultant I role on the Commercial team supports our small to mid-sized customers through their onboarding journey, helping them get up and running on Brex with guidance and structured support. As an initiator on the team, you’ll develop your product knowledge, sharpen your project management skills, and build the foundation for a career in implementation consulting.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Organize and facilitate customer meetings by managing agendas, capturing notes, tracking action items, and setting clear expectations throughout the implementation lifecycle.
• Support customers in understanding their business needs and configuring Brex to address them, translating basic requirements into product configurations with guidance.
• Manage straightforward stakeholder communication and assist with timelines and deliverables to keep implementations on track.
• Assist with spend migrations and support end user adoption during deployment, helping customers feel confident and prepared for go-live.
• Introduce integration concepts to customers, provide relevant guides for connecting Brex with external systems, and engage Technical Consultants for more complex integration or troubleshooting needs.
• Coordinate handoffs between AE/CSE and CSM, providing basic documentation to ensure continuity of the client relationship.
• Deliver standard change management templates to customers in preparation for go-live, and lead training sessions with supervision as needed.
• Collaborate within the Implementation team and contribute feedback on the client experience when asked, supporting process improvements over time.

Requirements
• 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within a SaaS organization or a consulting firm that delivers SaaS services.
• Some exposure to project coordination or structured implementation work.
• Strong communication skills, both with customers and internal stakeholders.
• Comfort working across technical and non-technical workstreams with guidance.
• Organized and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of urgency in driving tasks to completion.
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally to resolve issues.

Bonus points
• Experience in Financial, Expense Management, or ERP software.
• Familiarity with any of the following domains: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Expense Management, Travel, Procurement, or Corporate Card programs.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $91,304 - $114,130 USD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.
