Including proactive monitoring and diagnostics, sizing potential impact of opportunities on KPIs and retrospectives on launches. This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Grow as an Analyst: Develop your technical and soft analytical skills in a strong feedback and personal development work environment.

Experience:

jobs.title: Group Design Lead
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Lead ML Engineer / Scientist

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - Transaction Processing
jobs.description:
At Wise, our powerful spending infrastructure has allowed customers to spend their funds anywhere in the world with ease. Now, for the first time we will be allowing our customers to spend on a fair and transparent credit card. We are building an international credit program for our personal and business customers.

We are looking for an Engineering Lead who can join us to build out the first credit offering from Wise and ensure we can build a transparent, reliable and trustworthy system that complies to local regulations around the world and serves our global market. As the Engineering Lead, you will work with product, and begin to build our roadmaps, hire teams and develop this greenfields initiative. You will mentor engineers, and help define the product and team's missions to build out high performance teams, and an exceptional product. 

About the Role

Transaction Processing team is looking for an Engineering Lead to join an existing team that owns transaction processing. You’ll be responsible for the full transaction lifecycle, from authorisation and tokenisation to clearing, as well as managing complex integrations with card schemes. With our customers spending 44 billion using cards, you’ll focus on ensuring the scalability and reliability of our services, while minimising friction for our customers as they use our products. You’ll lead the team responsible for these critical infrastructure components, ensuring our systems remain performant and resilient as we scale.

You will be a key driver of the team's technical roadmap and strategy, partnering with product and engineering leaders across Transaction Processing to support our international growth. You will be responsible for owning the systems that underpin our transaction processing capabilities, ensuring they are built for scale, reliability, and low latency. You’ll drive technical excellence by guiding architectural decisions, enhancing our integration capabilities with card schemes, and ensuring that our services can handle the massive transaction volume our customers generate.

You will lead, coach, and mentor a talented group of engineers, fostering a culture of technical ownership, stability, and continuous improvement. You will balance immediate operational needs with long-term architectural investments, ensuring our platform evolves to meet our customers' needs without compromising quality or reliability. You will be a strong owner of your product space, navigating complex priorities to deliver robust, scalable solutions that set the standard for our transaction processing capabilities.

Technical Responsibilities
• Owning a technical roadmap to ensure that our product is maintained to high standards.
• Lead the development of new solutions. Drive initiatives from the ground up to develop entirely new products for our customers.
• Serve as a technical expert for the broader credit domain
• Build with the future in mind, what we build today can be a platform for other products tomorrow.
• Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team on architectural design, code reviews, and best practices.
• Ensuring code quality, consistency, and maintainability through code reviews and best practices.

Leadership Responsibilities
• Lead and mentor a diverse team of engineers (junior and senior), fostering a supportive environment that promotes technical growth.
• Participate and drive product roadmapping and strategy sessions with the product management team.
• Work closely with other Engineering Leads, Staff Engineers, and Product to shape the team’s and squad’s technical roadmaps.
• Help the team navigate complex priorities and make trade-offs to deliver solutions that reduce risk and unlock growth.
• Act as a key representative of the team, collaborating with stakeholders across the company and leading projects from the beginning till the release. In particular, work closely with the Business squad, Spend squad and Account Squad to help define the Wise Business spending experience for our customers.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Senior Manager (Fincrime)
jobs.description:
A bit about the role

We are looking for an Internal Audit Senior Manager (FinCrime) to join our Brussels based growing EU IA team. 

Your main task will be to coordinate the financial crime internal audit process within the company and externally with partnering firms. You will make recommendations to improve governance, risk management and internal controls. You will be responsible for planning, assigning, and supervising the operational activities of the team as well as completing your own tasks. 

The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous monitoring. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.

We are a growing team, therefore you have the unique opportunity to collaborate and shape the operations, methodology and approaches of the Internal Audit function, both regionally and globally. 

Your mission
• Support the implementation and operation of the internal audit assurance framework, including development of continuous monitoring and automated audit routines.
• Support development of the annual audit plan, including the audit universe, risk assessment processes and budgeting processes.
• Support key projects to deliver an aligned assurance model across Wise.
• Deliver audits per the audit plan to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes.
• Build and support a strong and self-sufficient internal audit team.
• Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the teams and measure the effectiveness of the improvements.
• Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, internally and externally.

A bit about you

Skills:
• You have proven experience working in risk, control or assurance and you want to continuously improve how to get the job done.
• You have worked in technology, fintech or broader financial services industries.
• A good understanding of the current regulatory environment, including EU Money Laundering Directives, FATF and Wolfsberg Guidance
• You have strong experience and specialism in financial crime topics including fincrime risk management, KYC/KYB/KYM, Customer and Enhanced Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Screening and Reporting. Experience with models and sanctions is preferred.
• You can plan and scope audits including designing and overseeing others in executing comprehensive, risk based test plans and identifying areas for improvement in well written reports. Your work meets quality standards and you can oversee others to do the same.
• You are able to work independently, you assume responsibility and you make your own judgement.
• You take ownership over complex areas and solve problems with no or very limited guidance and know when to escalate and ask for support.
• You have very strong coordination skills and you are able to hold teams accountable for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality outputs.
• You seek to use data analytics and technology in your work and decision making processes. Practical experience in data analytics preferred.
• You demonstrate attention to detail but can summarise key messages succinctly, verbally and in writing adjusting your style and level of information based on the target audience.

• You’re a strong relationship builder across all levels of the business and externally.

jobs.title: Lead Product Analyst

jobs.title: Group Product Compliance Lead - Regional Platform
jobs.description:
This is a first-line product compliance role. You will work directly alongside engineers and product managers to translate regulatory obligations into product decisions that are scalable, defensible and globally consistent. 

Your mission

Keeping pace with how money moves. As Wise expands into new markets, corridors, and payment schemes, the rules governing how transfers are processed, and who can send them, become increasingly complex. You will own the compliance strategy for core product flows that determine customer eligibility: how we verify where customers live, how we handle customers who move between countries, and how we allocate customers to the right licensed entity. These aren't abstract compliance questions, they manifest directly in product screens, data models, and engineering decisions. You will need to go deep quickly, surface the "so what," and drive alignment between legal, product, and engineering teams across multiple markets.

Strengthening the infrastructure for regulatory accountability. Wise is continuously evolving the regulatory infrastructure that helps us demonstrate compliance across our licences, markets, and products. This platform connects our regulatory obligations to the policies, controls, … You'll help shape and strengthen this capability by partnering with engineers, product teams, and compliance specialists to ensure regulatory obligations are accurately reflected in our systems and translated into appropriate controls. You’ll also help make this scalable.

Staying ahead of global payment standards. Wise operates across dozens of payment schemes and licensed entities worldwide. As international standards for payment messaging and data requirements evolve, you will own the compliance thread for how Wise's product and data infrastructure keeps pace, working closely with data engineering, scheme specialists, and regional legal counsel to ensure our payment flows are accurate, complete, and consistently applied across every market we operate in.

As Group Product Compliance Lead, you will:
• Own compliance strategy and delivery across all of Wise for core domains such as payment processing, obligations to control mapping and verification standards
• Translate complex, multi-jurisdictional obligations into actionable product and engineering decisions
• Represent Wise's compliance position to regional regulators, internal forums, and external auditors where required
• Build relationships with product, policy, and compliance teams globally to maintain a consistent and current view of obligations across markets
• Help define and scale the assurance frameworks that give Wise confidence its controls are working

We are looking for someone who:
• Has deep fintech compliance experience, with a track record of working directly in product teams, not alongside them
• Is comfortable in codebases, engineering discussions, and architecture reviews; not intimidated by technical complexity
• Can move between regulatory text and product specifications without losing either thread
• Is a strong communicator who can synthesise regulatory complexity into a clear position for non-specialists
• Is comfortable operating in ambiguity; capable of defining structure where none exists yet
• Has a track record of influencing decisions across legal, engineering, and product at senior levels
• Has familiarity with payment scheme rules (SEPA, SWIFT, domestic real-time rails)
• Has experience with multi-entity or multi-licence compliance structures
• Has working knowledge of KYC and identity verification frameworks and the product decisions that flow from them

In return, this role offers:
• Real ownership: you ship things, you don't just advise
• No regional or domain siloing; genuine cross-functional ownership spanning product, engineering, and compliance
• The chance to shape infrastructure and frameworks that will operate at company scale, affecting every Wise customer and licensed entity
• An exceptional cross-functional team across product, engineering, compliance, risk, and banking

jobs.title: Commercial Director - Payout Sales - APAC

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Wise Platform (Receive)
jobs.description:
Wise is building the world’s most powerful money movement infrastructure — designed to make international payments instant, low-cost, and transparent. Our mission: money without borders.

We’ve built a high-scale cross-border platform that processes billions in volume across 70+ countries, and we’re now bringing that infrastructure to banks, fintechs, and global platforms through Wise Platform, our enterprise offering.

We’re now looking for an exceptional Product Manager to help us expand and scale our Wise Platform Receive product — our enterprise offering that allows our partners to receive funds both internationally and domestically.

Since 2018, we’ve been investing in our licensing infrastructure and banking partnerships all around the world, allowing us to provide our partners with the same infrastructure that we now offer to our partners. We’ve received almost £100B in both international and domestic payments to our multi-currency accounts and have direct connections in 5 markets.

Wise Platform Receive is not just a feature — it’s a foundational capability that enables partners to embed Wise’s global money movement tools (cards, accounts, FX, transfers) directly into their own apps and platforms, under their brand, and with our global reach.

We’re looking for a product manager with deep fintech experience — especially in the banking and remittances space — to help us take Wise Platform Receive to the next level. This is a rare opportunity to build a zero-to-one category-defining product at global scale, backed by the engineering strength and mission of Wise Platform.

What you’ll do:
• Drive the strategy, execution, and growth of Wise Platform Receive globally with a strong focus on scale, resilience, and partner success
• Deliver on the strategy and KPIs by prioritising the most impactful projects that move the needle on a quarterly basis
• Go beyond the traditional boundaries of a product manager to help deliver faster, whether it’s owning your product’s compliance risk, helping unblock technical issues, or analysing data yourself where necessary
• Work closely with banking partners around the world to open up even more ways for customers to receive funds
• Collaborate closely with engineering, compliance, operations, and partner teams to deliver mission-critical infrastructure
• Deeply understand partner needs and translate them into scalable product capabilities
• Shape the future of embedded finance by enabling global platforms to receive funds both internationally and domestically

jobs.title: Head of Design, Wealth
jobs.description:
About PhonePe Limited:

Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug
2016. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore. 

 

PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode - hyperlocal e-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

 

Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Why PhonePe:

At PhonePe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.

Why PhonePe Design:

If you are sold on the vision of the company, you may want to consider the design team as a place to make this a reality. The design team at PhonePe is a bunch of creative trailblazers who are leading the effort to make a dent in the fintech universe. The design team consists of Product Designers, Visual Designers, Graphic Motion Designers, and Illustrators who are all engaged in blending art and science into a promising value proposition for our users.

About Share.Market

Share.Market is how PhonePe is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and WealthBaskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main PhonePe one, and it's backed by PhonePe's reach, trust, and distribution.

This is a hard, interesting design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.

The role

You'll own design for Share.Market end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with product and engineering — this is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.

You'll set the design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience. You'll report to the Head of Design (PhonePe Group) and work alongside the broader PhonePe design org, but Share.Market's design is yours to own.

What you'll do
• Own the experience. Set the bar for what good looks like on Share.Market, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.
• Ship, don't just direct. Get into the file. Design the hard screens yourself. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.
• Make complex things simple. Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.
• Partner closely. Work shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.
• Build the team. As Share.Market grows, manage and grow the designers around you, and set the standards they'll work to.

What we're looking for
• 12+ years in product design, with real ownership of consumer products at scale. Some of that as a lead, whether managing people or anchoring quality for a product.
• Proven craft. A portfolio that shows depth, not just breadth — interaction design, visual polish, and clear thinking about why each decision was made.
• Domain knowledge is a strong advantage. This is a genuinely complex space — broking, F O, market structure, the way regulation shapes every flow. If you've worked in trading, broking, or wealth, or you invest seriously yourself and understand it from the inside, that's a real head start. Not a hard requirement, but it counts for a lot.
• Comfort with complexity. You've designed for data-heavy or regulated products — fintech, trading, health, anything where the details are hard and the stakes are real. Or you can show us you'll get there fast.
• Systems thinking. You design with the whole product in mind, not one screen at a time. You're fluent with design systems and know when to extend one versus break from it.
• Strong written and verbal communication. You can write clear microcopy, make a tight argument for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback.
• Player-coach instinct. You're senior enough to lead and still want your hands on the work.

What we care about

We hire and grow people around three things: craft, context, and community.
• Craft — the quality of the work and the attention to detail behind it.
• Context — understanding the bigger picture: the user, the business, the system you're part of.
• Community — building the people and the relationships around the work, not just the work itself.

We believe in subtractive design: the best version of a financial product usually has less in it, not more. We'd rather remove the right thing than add another feature. If that resonates, you'll like it here.

Why this matters

Most Indians have never owned a stock. The ones who do often find investing intimidating, opaque, or built for someone more sophisticated than they feel. Getting this right means more people participating in the country's growth, with confidence and without getting burned. That's the work.

Design Microsite : https://design.phonepe.com/

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Income Tax team at Robinhood is responsible for leading our global corporate tax strategy, planning, and compliance as our business grows in complexity. We partner with accounting, legal, treasury, and engineering teams to manage our global tax structure and support Robinhood's international expansion. Our team oversees global tax planning, legal entity structures, and inter-company agreements. We focus on tax provision (ASC 740), compliance, transfer pricing, and structuring for international reporting. We are committed to maintaining tax compliance and technical standards across all our global operations!

As the Senior Director of Income Tax, you will lead our global corporate income tax function and direct our international tax strategy. You will oversee a talented team of tax professionals, managing their growth and alignment with Robinhood’s strategic objectives. In this role, you will design and implement tax structures, manage inter-company agreements, and support our growing international operations. You will collaborate closely with key leaders within the org, and present key tax developments to executive leadership. Your work will directly shape our corporate tax framework and ensure our compliance during this exciting phase of international growth!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do
• Direct and design Robinhood’s global tax planning and tax strategy, ensuring alignment with our expanding operations and business complexity.
• Oversee and manage the international corporate tax lifecycle, including transfer pricing, inter-company agreements, legal entity maintenance, and global tax compliance.
• Oversee all aspects of indirect tax strategy and compliance, including VAT, GST, sales tax, digital services taxes, and related international consumption tax matters across multiple jurisdictions.Provide guidance on tax matters for mergers, acquisitions, and restructuring activities, ensuring optimal integration of tax considerations into deal structures.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing tax team, including managing managers and senior tax professionals across compliance, provision, and reporting.
• Partner closely with product, accounting, legal, and treasury departments to evaluate the tax implications of new products, operational flows, legal entity structure, and international expansion initiatives to support tax-efficient business growth and ensure compliance with global tax requirements.
• Direct the global income tax provision (ASC 740) and tax compliance, ensuring accurate reporting and strong internal controls.
• Represent the tax department in discussions with executive leadership and external auditors on complex international tax and structuring matters.

What you bring
• At least 15+ years of corporate tax experience, with a heavy emphasis on international tax planning, strategy, and compliance within a multinational corporation or major public accounting firm.
• Proven experience as a people leader, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling high-performing tax teams (including managing managers).
• Deep expertise in international tax concepts, transfer pricing, inter-company agreements, legal entity structuring, and ASC 740 tax provisions.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex global tax structures and reporting requirements to executive leaders and board members.
• A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent practical experience; a CPA, Master of Taxation, or JD/LLM is highly preferred.

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:
• Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
• Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
• Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

• Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
The role

As a Backend Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the backend infrastructure of our applications, ensuring high performance, security, and scalability. You’ll work closely with the rest of the engineering team to tackle complex technical challenges and build solutions that can handle the unique demands of a crypto wallet app. 

Core

responsibilities:
• Design and implement scalable and robust backend services.
• Develop APIs and integrate third-party services and Solana RPCs.

• Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms (DigitalOcean, Google Cloud Platform).

• Write unit and integration tests using Jest to ensure code quality and reliability.
• Collaborate with frontend developers and other team members to ensure seamless integration.
• Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in web development and blockchain.
• Design and implement a microservices architecture for scalability and maintainability.

jobs.title: Digital Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Hello, we’re Starling. We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. We’re a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We’re a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,500 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

As a Digital Brand Designer, you'll help shape and elevate our brand identity across our primary digital touch points, with a core focus on our web experience.

We’re looking for someone who balances an exceptional eye for design and visual storytelling with a deep understanding of digital platforms. You won’t just be building UI components; you’ll be turning ideas into thoughtful, crafted digital experiences that capture the imagination and elevate the Starling brand. You'll bring a high level of creativity to everything from major web campaigns to the small, delightful interactions that make a website sing. You’ll collaborate closely with writers, marketing teams, data analysts, and developers to bring your visions to life. 

Please apply by close of business Friday 31st July.

Key Responsibilities

Web Experience and Digital Craft
• Design high-quality, beautiful, and engaging web experiences that align with our wider goals and brand principles.
• Translate creative briefs and marketing campaigns into strong, clear digital executions that feel fresh and premium.
• Use user data, analytics, and customer feedback to drive the continuous, iterative improvement of our website.
• Prepare and hand over meticulously crafted design files to our development team, collaborating closely with them to ensure your creative vision is technically achievable and perfectly executed in production.
• Bring a high level of craft, consistency, and visual clarity to digital layouts, typography, imagery, and interactive elements.

Collaboration and Team Contribution
• Cross-Functional Teamwork: Work closely with writers, marketers, engineers, and product designers to create cohesive digital journeys.
• Present your design concepts clearly and confidently to peers and stakeholders, explaining the "why" behind your visual choices.
• Contribute to creative reviews with ideas, web references, and positive critique, helping to foster a culture of curiosity and design excellence.

Brand Application and Visual Consistency
• Apply our visual identity consistently across web, landing pages, and digital marketing channels.
• Creative Evolution: Identify opportunities to evolve or improve how our brand is expressed in digital and interactive formats (including experimenting with motion, micro-interactions, or new layout styles).
• Trend Awareness: Stay aware of digital design trends, web technologies, and creative work across industries to keep our digital presence ahead of the curve.

Creative Thinking and Development
• Stay aware of design trends and creative work across industries
• Bring new ideas and fresh perspectives into the team
• Contribute to the culture of the design studio with curiosity and generosity
• Take initiative in developing your own skills and craft
• Proven design experience within a digital brand, marketing, or creative studio environment.
• A portfolio that showcases original thinking, exceptional visual craft, and a strong eye for digital and web layout. (We want to see how you think, not just the final components!)
• High proficiency in Figma (for web layouts, prototyping, and developer handovers) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).
• Experience using data, user feedback, or A/B testing insights to inform design decisions.
• Confidence in presenting your work, explaining your creative decisions, and collaborating with developers.
• Some knowledge of HTML/CSS (you don't need to code, but understanding how the web is built is a massive plus)
• Understanding of basic animation / motion skills for the web, e.g. Lottie or Rive.
• 25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)
• An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
• Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
• 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
• Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
• Life insurance at 4x your salary
• Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
• Generous family-friendly policies
• Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
• Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

jobs.title: Regional Health, Safety & Security Program Manager - Americas
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating a safe and secure environment where people can thrive? Do you have a knack for turning complex regulations into practical, effective solutions? We're looking for a Health, Safety & Security (HSS) Program Manager to be a guardian of well-being across our Americas offices. In this role, you’ll be a crucial part of our global team, ensuring our people and our business are protected and resilient.

What You'll Be Doing
• Be the HSS Authority: You’ll be the go-to expert for all things Health, Safety, and Security in our Americas offices, from Austin to New York to São Paulo and everywhere in between. You’ll develop and implement programs that not only meet but exceed local regulations, making safety an integral part of our culture.
• Innovate and Implement: You won’t just react to problems; you’ll proactively build and manage programs that reduce risks, prevent incidents, and promote a healthy workplace. From conducting risk assessments to supporting office expansions, your guidance will be critical.
• Protect and Respond: You’ll act as a core member of our Workplace Incident Management Team, ready to respond to workplace business continuity or crises and emergencies. Whether it's a small-scale issue or a larger-scale emergency, you’ll provide the specialized support needed to ensure our colleagues' safety.
• Vendor Management: Oversee and manage relationships with health, safety, and security vendors to ensure compliance, service quality, and alignment with organizational standards.
• Collaborate and Educate: You'll work closely with managers and teams across the region, providing training and technical expertise through third party providers. You’ll be responsible for maintaining on-site fire marshall and first-aid programs. You’ll also be a key partner to our global Head of Workplace Risk and Compliance and Americas Workplace Lead, helping to shape and implement HSS policies worldwide.
• Grow Our Impact: You’ll help us develop and monitor high-level KPIs, analyze regional trends, and strategically integrate HSS initiatives into the company’s global ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) roadmap. Your work will not only keep our people safe but also strengthen our commitment to a responsible and sustainable future.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Payroll Specialist - AMER SP FTC 12 Months

We’re currently hiring for a 12 months fixed term Payroll Specialist to join our global Payroll Team based in São Paulo/SP!

We’re looking for a payroll superstar, with a keen eye for accuracy, attention to detail and a desire to share your AMER payroll expertise and knowledge with our Global Payroll Team.

Reporting to the Payroll Lead, you’ll have above-average understanding of payroll across the AMER region with focus on LATAM, its overall function, and how our team provides excellent service to others. You’ll be responsible for the accurate, effective, and timely processing of your payroll for each pay period.

 

Your mission

This exciting role will join a team responsible for the overall global payroll process, including compliance, internal audit, and reconciliation across multiple countries for Wise. You’ll complete a variety of daily, weekly, monthly, annual, and ad-hoc tasks to ensure your payrolls are processed in accordance ahead of payroll deadlines.

This role will include supporting the payroll application, Cloudpay, of which we facilitate our payrolls. In processing and supporting the payroll, you will strive for accuracy, reduce errors, and payroll more efficiently. You will develop robust & detailed processes to ensure the execution of payroll in an effective, efficient, and timely manner. Cross-training will be key!

This amazing role will also participate by providing a variety of deliverables, including global projects, pre-post payroll journals, internal audits, and more. Also, you will provide input regarding team goals, KPIs, efficiencies, process improvements, and future optimization of our payroll team - all while providing outstanding customer service. Always.

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking. We’re 8000+ Wisers strong, with over 90 nationalities working in 25+ locations around the globe! We’re looking for a Payroll Specialist who lives our values, will help grow our culture, and drive our mission forward! 🚀

 

The specifics:
• You’ll be working as a part of a wider Global Payroll Team, servicing 25+ countries using Workday (HRIS), while focusing specifically on our AMER & LATAM based Wisers
• You’ll prepare, double-check, cross-check, review and analyze payroll inputs according to the established deadlines
• You’ll be completely responsible to ensure the timely submission of your payroll inputs to our third party payroll provider
• You’ll partner with your Lead to recommend new approaches, policy and procedure changes towards continuous improvement within the team
• You’ll ensure your payrolls balance to your inputs - always
• You’ll be responsible for all documentation within your historical payroll files
• Continue to increase subject matter expertise on your allocated locations, on all payroll and legislative matters, providing support, as needed, to others
• Work with the Payroll team and the Payroll Lead to provide additional processing/transaction support, as needed

Compliance:
• You’ll ensure compliance across local payroll tax laws, while meeting applicable timelines effectively and efficiently
• Stay current with regulation changes affecting your payrolls to ensure accuracy and service to our customers
• Partner to complete and respond to regulatory agency inquiries

Financials, Audits, and Reporting:
• Responsible for outputs of your payrolls, such as payroll journals, GL files, and ad-hoc reporting
• You’ll ensure all reporting and data is completed timely 

 

Your challenges
• We’re evolving our payroll model - you’ll have the chance to bring your brainpower and prior experience to help us build an outstanding payroll team as we continue to grow and scale
• You’ll assist to create efficiencies in our current ways of working and help us develop new ways of payroll processing

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst - CRM Analytics
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced data analyst to join our CRM Analytics team, supporting both Personal and Business customer segments. As a key member of the Marketing Analytics organisation, you will report to the Manager of CRM Analytics and play a critical role in driving our lifecycle marketing capabilities through rigorous data analysis and actionable insights.

This is a high-impact role where you'll collaborate closely with our CRM, Product, Data Science, and Growth teams. You will help define and execute the measurement framework for CRM initiatives, ensure data quality is top-notch, and provide analytical expertise to truly optimise customer engagement strategies. Your work will directly influence how we acquire, engage, and retain customers by building and running data-driven CRM programs.

Key

Responsibilities:
• Translate complex business questions into clear analytical frameworks, delivering insights that directly drive strategic decisions.
• Design and execute in-depth analyses to evaluate campaign performance, customer segmentation, and engagement patterns across the customer lifecycle.
• Apply advanced testing methodologies (A/B testing, incrementality) to measure and significantly improve the effectiveness of CRM campaigns.
• Develop and maintain critical dashboards and reporting tools that track key CRM metrics and provide actionable insights for marketing teams.
• Collaborate closely with Analytics Engineering, CRM technology, and Product teams to ensure data integrity and help define requirements for new initiatives.
• Build and optimise customer segmentation models to enhance targeting and personalisation strategies.
• Contribute to the development of the overall CRM analytics strategy and measurement framework.

Required

Qualifications:
• Proven, hands-on experience in marketing analytics, specifically within CRM or lifecycle marketing domains.
• You'll need a strong technical skillset, especially advanced SQL proficiency to handle complex data manipulation in a modern data warehouse (like Snowflake).
• Experience with data modeling (dbt) and visualisation tools to create insightful and easy-to-digest dashboards and reports.
• Comfortable with a programming language such as Python or R for data analysis.
• Solid understanding of experimental design and statistical testing methodologies.
• Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable business recommendations.
• Experience working cross-functionally with marketing and product teams.

Preferred

Qualifications:
• Knowledge of marketing automation platforms and CRM tools.
• Familiarity with various customer segmentation techniques and personalisation frameworks.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re currently hiring for a Global Payroll Specialist based in São Paulo to join our global Payroll Team.

As Wise continues to expand its global footprint—both by entering new regional locations and rapidly increasing headcount within existing entities—our payroll complexity is growing. To safeguard compliance, protect employee experience, and scale efficiently, we are looking for a payroll superstar with a keen eye for accuracy, attention to detail, and a desire to share your expertise.

In this role, you will act as a critical operational anchor, helping to manage increased vendor complexity and mitigate heightened audit and legislative risks. By owning these foundational components, you will allow our leadership team to focus on macro-level expansion strategy. Reporting to the AMER Payroll Lead, you’ll bring a strong understanding of North American and Latin American Payroll alongside international payroll experience, ensuring the accurate, effective, and timely processing of multiple countries each pay period.

Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Our customers can also manage their hard-earned money with the world’s first platform to offer true multi-currency banking. We’re 5000+ Wisers strong, with over 90 nationalities working in 25+ locations around the globe! We’re looking for a professional who lives our values, will help grow our culture, and drive our mission forward.

Your Mission

This exciting role joins a team responsible for overall global payroll, including process, compliance, audit, and reconciliation across multiple countries. To safeguard our scaling operations, you will manage increased vendor complexity, mitigate heightened audit and legislative risks, and act as an operational anchor to allow the Payroll Lead to focus on macro-level expansion strategy.

The Specifics

Team Governance & Operations
• Operational Oversight: Help manage the regional payroll team, enforce strict payroll cutoffs, and serve as the final approval authority for standard pay runs.
• Leadership Back-up: Serve as the designated regional lead and approval authority when the Payroll Lead is out of office.
• Cross-Functional Gatekeeping: Act as the primary point of contact for Tax, Finance, and People Operations (POps), ensuring clear boundaries and deflecting out-of-scope work to protect team capacity.

Vendor & SLA Management
• Partner Accountability: Track Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and monitor the operational performance of key regional payroll partners (including Deel, CloudPay, RSM, and OSV).
• Vendor Execution: Partner to develop robust and detailed processes to ensure execution of payroll in an accurate, effective, efficient, and timely manner.

Audit, Risk, & Quality Assurance
• Audit Ownership: Lead and manage comprehensive audit walkthroughs with both internal and external audit teams.
• Risk Mitigation: Proactively monitor and manage logged risk items to ensure swift resolution and compliance.
• Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply advanced problem-solving skills to identify, analyze, and resolve payroll discrepancies or process bottlenecks at their root.

Core Processing & Stakeholder Collaboration
• Prepare, double-check, cross-check, review, and analyze payrolls according to established deadlines.
• Manage first- and second-line queries from employees, other teams, and external providers, ensuring that SLAs are met and issues are resolved efficiently.
• Build strong, trust-based relationships with internal and external stakeholders through clear, transparent, and timely communication.
• Contribute to and lead payroll-related projects, such as system implementations, process automation, and regional expansions.

Compliance, Financials, & Reporting
• Legislative Tracking: Monitor and track regional legislation updates impacting Wise, ensuring all changes are successfully implemented through to production.
• Regulatory Alignment: Ensure compliance across all locations globally, including International, Federal, State, and local payroll tax laws while meeting applicable timelines and responding to regulatory agency inquiries.
• Financial Outputs: Maintain responsibility for outputs of your payrolls, such as payroll journals, GL files, historical payroll documentation, and ad-hoc reporting.

Your Challenges
• We’re evolving our payroll model – you’ll have the chance to bring your brainpower and prior experience to help us build an outstanding payroll team as we continue to grow and scale.
• You’ll assist in creating efficiencies in our current ways of working and/or develop new ways while we implement payroll processing using our new global system.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst - Marketing Science
jobs.description:
We are looking for an analytical and curious Senior Marketing Data Analyst to join our Marketing Science team. Our mission is to fuel sustainable growth by measuring marketing effectiveness - building a unified measurement framework based on experimentation, Marketing Mix Models and tracked attribution.

Your Mission

In this role, you will help us build our best representation of marketing effectiveness by enhancing and maintaining our attribution model. You will partner with our Lead Analyst to own the code and define our attribution logic while partnering with marketing teams to ensure every £ is spent efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
• Maintain and enhance our attribution model logic. Use dbt to maintain data pipelines, refine attribution rules, and implement new logic as our channel mix and marketing effectiveness understanding evolves.
• Ensure the accuracy of marketing data integrity in our attribution model.
• Work with the Data Science, Acquisition and marketing teams to evolve our model.
• Build dashboards that allow marketing stakeholders to self-serve daily performance metrics.
• Translate complex datasets and modelling results into clear, non-technical narratives for marketing stakeholders.
• Execute detailed, in-depth analyses to identify improvement opportunity areas in our current measurement capabilities and propose solutions.
• You will help us improve our measurement confidence level by identifying certainty gaps and proposing ways to bridge those gaps.
• You will contribute defining impactful OKRs to work throughout the half of the year.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, or other relevant fields.
• 2+ years of experience in a marketing analytics or data analytics role.
• Advanced SQL skills, Python/R and dbt are advantageous.
• You are able to demonstrate that you can tell a story with data and proactively give guidance on strategy based on insights.
• Experience working with attribution models/MMP data is advantageous.
• Experience with data visualisation tools (example, Looker, Power BI, LightDash).
• Understanding of performance marketing is advantageous.

 

Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead - AUP (Acceptable Use Policy)
jobs.description:
Team you will be working with: AUP (Acceptable Use Policy) team! 🎉

The AUP team designs, builds, and operates the preventative and detective controls that monitor transactions and customer activity. If someone tries to use Wise for prohibited activities, we detect it, review it, and take action.

Join us as we shift our strategy from "Policy-First to Risk-Driven" to drive growth. We want to enable all legal activities and minimize friction for legitimate customers, while surgically targeting and neutralizing genuinely illicit, high-risk behaviors.

As the Engineering Lead, you will lead a highly collaborative, cross-functional squad, alongside data scientists, analysts, compliance managers, and designers. 

How we work:

We operate with high autonomy, low control, and a belief that the best ideas win. We don’t just hand you a roadmap; you will partner directly with your Product Manager, Compliance Lead, and Lead Data Scientist to define both the product and technical vision for the team.

What will you be working on?
• Risk Detection: Close coverage gaps and scale our detection systems by integrating advanced Machine Learning models and building robust controls to spot AUP violations.
• Supercharge Operations: Architect automated workflows and intuitive internal tooling to reduce the cost per case and median handling times for our operations analysts.
• Own the Architecture: Keep our services highly available, resilient, and secure. You’ll ensure we have the right monitoring, observability, and decoupled architectures to scale alongside Wise's massive global volume.

jobs.title: Thailand Country Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Country Manager to lead our business in Thailand. This is not a traditional hands-off executive role. 

Based in Bangkok, you will be responsible for Wise’s overall success in the country, enabling Thailand customers to experience the best way to move and manage their money across borders. You will be expected to grow the business by orchestrating appropriate go-to-market strategies while also improving and expanding our product offering and customer experience. 

Reporting to the Head of Southeast Asia Expansion, you will have regulatory accountability as a resident Director on our local boards, represent us with key regulatory bodies, and act as the chief spokesperson for Wise in local media and public forums. You will partner closely with global and regional product, engineering, compliance, risk, marketing and operations teams to expand our presence in the market.

What will you be doing?
• Risk, Compliance & Subsidiary Governance
• Entity Governance & Board Management: Serve as the resident Board Director for Wise’s licensed Thailand subsidiaries. Direct and prepare local board materials, and ensure subsidiary governance standards meet both regulatory expectations and Wise’ global standards.
• Regulatory Compliance Oversight: Own risk, compliance, and governance for our Thailand entities, partnering with global Product, Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure absolute compliance with local regulations through robust product design, systemic controls, and oversight.
• Regulator Relationships: Manage our key relationships with the Bank of Thailand (BoT) and any relevant regulatory or government bodies. Lobby these organisations for progressive regulatory changes to achieve our mission, including advocating for direct non-bank integration into local payment systems.
• Operational Resiliency: Collaborate with Risk and Compliance teams to develop, implement, and maintain robust Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to handle unexpected operational or systemic service disruptions in the local market.
• Operational Leadership: Have oversight on the day-to-day operations of Wise in Thailand. Guide strategy and provide cross-functional leadership to colleagues supporting Thailand operations, many of whom are based in our regional or global offices.
• Commercial Growth & Product Delivery
• Financial Partner & SLA Management: Lead commercial and operational negotiations with our partners and the national payment network. Hold both external financial institutions and internal global service providers accountable to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Licensing Strategy & Acquisition: Proactively assess expansion roadmaps and future commercial strategies to identify regulatory licensing requirements; own and lead the end-to-end strategy, preparation, and application process for any new local licenses required to unlock and scale these opportunities.
• Product Prioritisation & Execution: Collaborate closely with global product and engineering squads to prioritise and execute new product or feature launches.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Senior Application Security Engineer, you will focus on finding and responding to security vulnerabilities across the Brex platform. In this role, you will perform code reviews, design reviews, penetration testing, and vulnerability management. You will develop and maintain tooling to perform static and dynamic testing of the Brex platform and tooling which supports secure developer workflows. Application Security is part of our wider Financial Scale organization, which means you will work closely with Security Operations, GRC, Product Security, Front End Platform, IT Infrastructure teams.

We’re looking for individuals with a strong background and interest in penetration testing. You should have a demonstrated ability to find vulnerabilities in complex systems and craft exploits to demonstrate business impact. This role is highly cross functional and collaborative, you will have the opportunity to work with every engineering team across Brex. You should be enthusiastic about working with a variety of backgrounds, roles, and needs. Building a world-class financial service requires world-class security. 

Brex is pioneering the next wave of AI-driven financial services for dynamic, high-impact companies like Coinbase, Robinhood, and Anthropic. We're at the early stages of integrating AI across our product suite, this role will have the opportunity to influence and secure the future of AI Security at Brex. You'll be at the forefront of securing our novel AI implementations, identifying attack vectors in agentic-powered features, and partnering with product and engineering teams to build AI capabilities that our customers can trust with their critical financial operations.

Responsibilities
• Identifying vulnerabilities, demonstrating business impact, and articulating the risk of specific vulnerabilities to drive prioritization efforts
• Perform penetration testing and design reviews, looking for vulnerabilities and insecure designs, work with engineering and product to design secure product features
• Maintain and build internal tools to automate security efforts, perform SAST and DAST testing of the Brex platform, and support secure development practices
• Build and contribute to a culture of collaborative security excellence through technical leadership, learning sessions, and mentorship within the team and wider organization

Requirements
• 5+ years work experience in an Application Security or related role
• Ability to find vulnerabilities in complex systems, demonstrating business impact through custom attack chains
• Experience with a wide range of secure development activities including— threat modeling, developer education, and incident response
• Knowledge of Python, scripting languages, and AI/agentic workflows to automate tasks, build tools and improve productivity
• Collaborative mindset paired with strong written and verbal communication skills

Bonus points
• Proficiency with Kotlin, gRPC, GraphQL, Kubernetes
• Previous experience as a software engineer
• Consultancy experience performing web application security reviews
• Experience with securing distributed systems in AWS and cloud environments
• Experience with pentesting and securing agentic features and systems
• Contributions to the wider technical community— open source, public research, mentorship, community organizing, blogging, CVEs, presentations, etc
• Experience submitting to bug bounty programs or responsible disclosure programs

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $192,000 - $240,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Security Operations is part of our wider Trust IT organization which means you will have the opportunity to work closely with Application Security, Corporate Engineering, GRC and IT and to improve security configurations, drive positive employee behaviors and generally work to prevent events from becoming incidents. Most importantly, you should be enthusiastic about working with a variety of backgrounds, roles, and people across Brex. Building a world-class financial service requires world-class security.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities
• Work on a highly cross-functional team to prevent, detect and respond to security threats across Brex's corporate and cloud environments
• Perform security incident response, investigation, remediation, and documentation, participate in periodic threat hunting and security exercises
• Leading, scoping and building features, participate in designing, and maintaining tools and systems which support the team’s domains – corporate security, detection response and infrastructure security
• Collaborating and partnering with engineering and operations teams to drive remediation of security issues, while balancing prioritization of those security issues within SLA and teams’ respective backlogs
• Caring about secure system design, valuing building things correctly, an understanding of a MVP approach and an empathetic mindset when working with others

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field OR equivalent training / fellowship OR 5+ years work experienceExperience working in a corporate security, detection response or infrastructure security role with responsibilities for security alert triage and security incident response
• Familiarity with CI/CD systems and DevOps workflows (e.g. Buildkite, Flux, Git, Terraform) in cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)
• Experience with deploying and maintaining some of the security services and tools owned by the team (e.g. - SIEM, data pipelines, SOAR, domain monitoring, endpoint tooling, email protection tooling, cloud security tools)
• While not primarily a development role, the team develops and maintains tools written in Go and Python, so experience with coding is required
• You thrive in a collaborative environment filled with a diverse group of people with different expertise and backgrounds. We currently have around 30 nationalities represented with more than ½ the company working in a country different from the one they grew up in.

• Proficiency with Go and other programming languages
• Experience with securing distributed systems in AWS, cloud and Kubernetes environments

We are looking for a senior leader to head our newly formed Trading Risk team. This is a critical leadership role created as part of a strategic reorganization to consolidate all business-risk-related functions across our trading verticals into a single, dedicated team. The Head of Trading Risk will own end-to-end business risk operations and logic design across multiple product lines, reporting directly to senior leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Team Leadership Strategy
• Lead and grow the Trading Risk team, setting the strategic vision for business risk management across the organization
• Build a high-performing, risk-focused culture with strong accountability and ownership

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to embed risk thinking into product development

 

Risk Coverage — Multi-Product Line Oversight

• Spot Trading — market risk, counterparty exposure, and trading anomaly detection
• Derivatives (Futures, Options, CFD, Perps) — margin risk, liquidation logic, settlement risk, and position limits
• Loan / Earn — collateral risk, interest rate risk, and protocol-level exposure management
• Design and maintain risk control frameworks, alert systems, and escalation protocols for each product line
• Conduct ongoing risk assessments for new product launches and feature changes
• Provide risk-related logic design recommendations and improvement proposals for all business units

 

Operational Risk Management
• Oversee real-time risk monitoring systems and ensure timely incident response

• Work with the Engineering/Tech team to ensure risk control systems are robust, scalable, and properly maintained

• Experience with multi-product risk management covering at least 3 of: spot, derivatives, lending, earn/yield products

jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint is a global fintech building modern financial services for millions of people and businesses across high-growth markets. We provide payments, banking, credit, and financial management tools - reliable products that people and businesses use every day to run their lives, grow their companies, and move money safely.

Our mission is simple: to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere. And this is day one. We’ve grown rapidly in Nigeria and the UK, and we’re now expanding our product, engineering, and analytics teams. Our work ranges from building financial infrastructure to designing intuitive customer experiences for emerging markets - solving real, meaningful problems at scale.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on India-based Data Science Manager to lead our consumer credit data science efforts in a high-growth environment. This role is pivotal in building and scaling a team responsible for pricing, credit limit modelling, and production credit model deployment, with direct ownership of decisions that impact millions of customers.

You’ll work closely with our Consumer Credit, Product, and Engineering teams to shape how we assess and price risk, design credit products, and measure outcomes across the credit lifecycle. Sitting at the intersection of data science, credit risk, and product, you’ll build the analytics and modelling foundations that inform underwriting, customer acquisition, retention, and portfolio performance at scale.

jobs.title: Head, Innovation Hubs
jobs.description:
About us

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

Moniepoint is building innovation hubs at three of Nigeria’s leading universities: Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU), University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), and Ahmadu Bello University (ABU). Each hub is a cross-disciplinary platform, open to students from every faculty. The model is cohort-based, industry-connected, and built to produce technical talent ready for the job market, across software engineering, AI, product, data science, robotics, and design. The hubs train students in applied technical skills, connect them to working engineers, product leaders, and founders, and provide a path into industry at Moniepoint, at other technology companies, or through ventures of their own.

This is a building role. The hubs are entering their operating phase, and you will own the design of how they run and the teams that run them.

What you will own
• Programme design. You will design the operating model for all three hubs from the ground up: how cohorts are structured, how learning is sequenced, what “job market-ready” means at each level, and how graduates are assessed and certified. This is not adapting someone else’s playbook. It is writing one.
• University relationships. You will be the primary relationship owner with the Vice-Chancellors, deans, faculty leads, and student bodies at OAU, UNN, and ABU. These are institutional relationships that require both strategic seniority and sustained presence.
• Cross-faculty engagement. The hubs are not engineering faculty initiatives. They are open to students across every faculty: engineering, sciences, humanities, business, design. You will design the engagement model that brings students from across each university into the hub and keeps them in it through the full cohort.
• Industry and mentorship pipeline. The hubs derive their value from the connection between classroom and industry. You will build and manage the network of engineers, product leaders, and founders, inside Moniepoint and beyond, who mentor, assess, and hire from the hubs.
• Facilitators and standard. You will design the facilitator model, recruit the people who teach and assess, and own the standard those facilitators hold the cohort to. A single standard across all three hubs is non-negotiable; how it's delivered locally is yours to design.
• Infrastructure and operations. You will own the physical footprint of each hub, whether that means a buildout from scratch or working within an existing campus structure, and manage the timelines, vendor relationships, and hub-level budgets across three sites. You will define the staffing model for each hub and recruit the on-ground team that runs them day to day.
• Outcomes and accountability. You will set and own the metrics: graduate output, job placement, programme completion, cohort quality, employer satisfaction.
• Pipeline integration. The hubs are upstream of Moniepoint Academy and other talent programmes. You will design the connective tissue between hub graduates and Moniepoint’s internal pathways, so the strongest talent has a clear next step.

Who you are
• 10+ years of experience overall, with at least 5 in leadership roles owning programmes, teams, and budgets end to end.
• You have built or led a technical training or workforce development programme at scale, ideally across multiple sites. You have taken something from zero to one - designed the model, hired the team, and held the standard yourself.
• You have held institutional relationships at senior level across universities, government bodies, and industry partners. You know how to navigate Nigerian university administration, or you have done it elsewhere and can credibly do it here. You have hired and managed technical educators, and you know what separates someone who can teach from someone who can teach to a standard.
• You understand what good engineering education looks like and what employers in software, AI, product, and data science actually hire for. You don't need to write code, but you need the technical fluency to design a programme that produces hireable engineers, not credentialed graduates.
• You are rigorous about outcomes and impatient with programmes that look good in announcements but cannot prove what they produce.
• Experience in edtech, developer education, university-industry partnerships, or workforce development is a strong signal. Building something from scratch and owning it through to measurable outcomes is essential.

What success looks like
• Year one. Operating model live across all three hubs. Cohorts running on a common standard. The facilitator team hired and held to the same expectations regardless of site. First graduate cohort exited, with a clear placement record into Moniepoint and into industry.
• Year two. The hubs are recognised within Nigeria as the most credible cross-disciplinary technical training environment available to undergraduates. Employers, including Moniepoint, actively hire from the hubs. Cohort demand outstrips supply.
• Year three. Hubs producing technical talent into Moniepoint at a cost-per-hire that justifies the investment, and into the wider industry at a scale and quality that defines what a corporate-funded university programme can look like in Nigeria. Model documented and ready to expand if leadership chooses.

What Moniepoint can offer you
• The opportunity to shape one of the most consequential talent infrastructure investments in Nigerian technology.
• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative environment where every team member's voice is recognised and valued.
• Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.
• Competitive salary, individual performance bonuses, and firmwide performance bonus.
• Company-covered health insurance plans. Pension plans.

What to expect in the hiring process
• A preliminary conversation with one of our recruiters.
• An interview with the hiring manager, our Head of Corporate Affairs.
• A case study or written exercise on operating model design for the hubs.
• An interview with our Group COO.
• A final conversation with our CEO.

Job Title: Customer Support Officer (Offline State Support)

About this role

The Customer Support Officer provides high-quality, timely, and professional support to walk-in customers nationwide and customers in WhatsApp Groups. The role focuses on resolving customer enquiries, technical issues, and service-related concerns while delivering a consistent customer experience aligned with the Bank’s standards and values.

The officer serves as the first point of contact, collaborating with internal teams to ensure prompt issue resolution and offering insights to improve customer experience based on logged issues and customer feedback.

Skills Competencies
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (specifically for handling walk-ins and managing WhatsApp group communications).

• Ability to collaborate effectively with internal cross-functional teams.

What success looks like in this role

• Accurate and thorough logging of all customer interactions to prevent unresolved gaps.
• Strong operational discipline with minimal escalations due to unresolved baseline issues.
• Proactive collection of customer feedback that leads to actionable internal service improvements.

Why join us

• Support for professional development.
